chapters.title: Chapter 801 - 440: Go, Give It a Slap_2
paragraphs: The Legendary Giant Bear steadied its form and looked at Bear Spirit Gangtu with a hint of fear in its eyes.
This time, it didn’t talk back but replied honestly, "In Crystal Mountain, it’s not just our Crystal Violent Bear Race, there’s also the Crystal Saber-toothed Tiger Race!"
"However, our Crystal Violent Bear Race and the Saber-toothed Tiger Race are enemies, having clashed in Crystal Mountain for thousands of years!"
"I thought you guys were hired reinforcements by the Saber-toothed Tiger Race!"
Han Xing frowned slightly after hearing this, "I’m not concerned about the feud between your two tribes, nor am I a hired reinforcement for the Saber-toothed Tiger Race."
"My goal this time is to take the Divine Format within Crystal Mountain."
Han Xing stated his intent simply and directly, unwilling to engage further with this Violent Bear.
Upon hearing the words ’Divine Format’.
The Crystal Violent Bear’s body suddenly trembled,
"You actually know there’s a Divine Format in our Crystal Mountain?"
Han Xing replied speechlessly, "Your bodies, and even the nearby Sky Island, are almost turning into crystals. It’s clearly the influence of that Divine Format."
"Anyone could figure that out, right?"
The Crystal Violent Bear was stunned, then flipped its body and sat directly on the giant pit.
"I suggest you give up. You know that Divine Format has transformed us into this state, affecting even the entire Crystal Mountain region."
"Merely approaching the area where that Divine Format resides would subject you to its terrifying Divine Power erosion."
"Moreover, this Divine Power erosion doesn’t just affect the Divine Body, it will corrode our consciousness."
"Stay too long within the range of that Divine Power’s influence, and you’ll fully become an Earth Crystal, devoid of awareness and life force."
"Our Crystal Violent Bear Race has attempted countless times to retrieve that Divine Format but ended up failing each time."
Everyone nodded in realization after hearing this.
It seems this is the sealing effect of the Earth Divine Format.
It can transform any approaching life into that kind of crystal existence and obliterate awareness.
Until you become a real stone, disappearing from this world forever.
Seeing the expressions on everyone’s faces, the Crystal Violent Bear assumed they were frightened.
It casually extended its bear claw, picked up a crystal stone from the ground, and stuffed it into its mouth.
"Crack! Crack!"
The sound of crunchy, ice-breaking chewing echoed.
"I see your strength can’t resist that kind of Divine Power erosion; you’d just be sending yourself to death if you go over."
Han Xing didn’t respond but said, "You mean, your Crystal Bear Race also wants someone to take that Divine Format?"
The Crystal Violent Bear nodded, "Of course!"
"Without that Divine Format, our bodies wouldn’t have turned into this ghastly appearance!"
"In the past, when the Barbaric God created our tribe and the Saber-toothed Tiger Race, we were beings of flesh and blood with perfect bodies."
"However, ever since that Divine Format descended, it not only destroyed the altar but also prevented us from receiving any Divine Blessing from the Barbaric God anymore!"
"It even ruined our living environment."
"Forcing our Violent Bear Race to sustain on gnawing these Earth Crystals."
Everyone exchanged glances with one another.
From the mouth of this Crystal Violent Bear, they heard the name of a Divine Spirit.
Barbaric God.
Han Xing recalled something about this Barbaric God. There’s a statue of him in his territory.
Moreover, when he obtained the blueprint for the statue, the system specifically noted.
"[Barbaric God is one of the four oldest Divine Spirits from the Age of Ten Thousand Gods. His statue holds miraculous Mighty Power!]"
The four oldest Divine Spirits.
According to Han Xing’s estimates, the Barbaric God was at least on par with the Elemental God.
Thus, Han Xing asked, "Are you saying that the Crystal Mountain area once had an altar to the Barbaric God?"
"And that you all communicated and interacted with the Barbaric God through this altar?
The Crystal Violent Bear nodded, "Exactly! Every hundred years, the Barbaric God would bestow a Divine Blessing upon us, granting our tribe a new Demigod!"
"However, since the Elemental God’s Divine Format descended and destroyed the Divine Master’s altar, we haven’t been able to communicate with the Divine Master anymore."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing showed a look of realization in his eyes.
"So you mean both the Violent Bear Race and the Saber-toothed Tiger Race are creations of the Barbaric God."
"Then why did you previously say the Saber-toothed Tiger Race are your enemies?"
The Crystal Violent Bear, upon hearing this, immediately got angry, "Isn’t it because they want to snatch the altar fragments from us!"
"The Divine Master’s altar always belonged to our Violent Bear Race before."
"However, since that Divine Format shattered it into fragments, the Saber-toothed Tiger Race saw an opportunity."
"They want to collect all the fragments and rebuild the altar!"
Startled, Han Xing asked, "Are you saying the altar can be reassembled?"
The Crystal Violent Bear nodded, "Of course it can!"
"But you need to gather all the fragments."
"Some fragments are in the hands of the Saber-toothed Tiger Race, some are with our tribe."
"And some altar fragments are in the central region of that Divine Format, where no living being can approach."
After hearing this, Han Xing nodded and then said, "Let’s make a deal."
"Let me take that Divine Format, and as for the altar fragments inside, you can handle them as you wish."
"How about that?"
Han Xing was not interested in the altar fragments; anything involving these Divine Spirits seemed too ominous.
Moreover, this altar was connected to an ancient, powerful Divine Spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 802 - 440: Go, Give It Two Slaps_3
paragraphs: The Crystal Violent Bear stood dumbfounded on the spot and asked in confusion, "You mean, you have a way to remove that Divine Format?"
Han Xing nodded.
Upon hearing this, the Crystal Violent Bear’s eyes filled with ecstatic joy.
The Divine Format of Crystal Mountain, unlike those in other regions, didn’t rely on the Divine Power it emitted for survival.
To the Violent Bear Race, this Divine Format was more like a curse.
If someone could take it away, they would not only not stop them, but also be immensely grateful!
The Crystal Violent Bear was just about to agree.
However, as if suddenly remembering something, it became wary and said, "That Divine Format contains extremely powerful prohibitive forces; even a Middle-tier Demigod can’t approach it."
"You humans only have a Legendary Level aura, are you trying to trick me?"
Han Xing rolled his eyes at it, knowing it wouldn’t believe him.
So he said to Zhang Lianmeng, "Lian’Er, show it."
Zhang Lianmeng understood.
In the next moment, five shimmering and varied-colored Divine Formats appeared in front of her.
The instant these five Divine Formats appeared.
The surrounding elements for tens of miles seemed to be stirred.
Fiery flames, icy frost, wild thunder, light and dark!
The Power of Elements from the five elements formed a terrifying elemental tide!
In the eyes of these Violent Bears, it seemed as if the sky was falling!
The small bear cubs huddled under the giant bear’s feet, trembling.
Zhang Lianmeng only took them out for less than a second before she put all five Divine Formats back.
At this moment, the Crystal Violent Bear was utterly stupefied.
It exclaimed in shock, "It really is the other Divine Formats of the Elemental God, and so many of them!"
"Humans, how on earth did you do this?"
Han Xing did not answer, instead he directly said, "Don’t worry about how we did it.
"Just take us to the area where the Divine Format is located."
The Crystal Violent Bear now completely believed them, and it said excitedly, "I can take you there!"
"However, before that, I need to take you to meet our Clan Leader first!"
Han Xing nodded after hearing this.
For such a big matter, it’s normal to go through their Clan Leader first.
As the speech ended, the Crystal Violent Bear leaped and flew out of the Sky Island.
The group looked at each other and followed.
As a creature of High-tier Legendary Level, the Crystal Violent Bear naturally had the ability to fly.
Han Xing and the others also manipulated Divine Power, floating in mid-air.
As for the Demon God Battleship, Han Xing switched it to follow mode, trailing the group from afar.
Ten minutes later.
The group crossed multiple Crystal Sky Islands.
Sensing their aura, the crystal Violent Bears on those islands awoke.
They curiously watched Han Xing and the others.
It’s clear this Crystal Violent Bear Race has considerable strength.
And the number of powerful individuals is also not small.
Along the way, Han Xing’s group encountered at least a dozen Legendary Level Crystal Violent Bears.
However, the scope of Crystal Mountain seemed too vast, not losing out even to a large race like the Elf Realm.
The group walked for nearly an hour and still hadn’t reached the third residence mentioned by the Crystal Violent Bear.
At this point, Han Xing couldn’t help but ask, "Xiong Da, how much longer?"
The Crystal Violent Bear was taken aback, seemingly surprised by Han Xing suddenly calling it this name.
But it still replied, "We’re almost there. Our Crystal Mountain territory is vast. Even for a Legendary Violent Bear like me, it takes a long time to reach."
Han Xing replied speechlessly, "Didn’t you say you still have enemies in the Saber-toothed Tiger Race?"
"Being so scattered, aren’t you afraid of being picked off one by one?"
The bear scratched its head in response, seemingly not quite understanding Han Xing’s point.
But it still replied, "The Saber-toothed Tiger Race, though vicious, wouldn’t attack ordinary Violent Bears of our race without reason."
"Our goal is the Altar Fragment in each other’s possession."
Han Xing asked no more questions and continued to follow the Violent Bear.
Half an hour later, the group finally reached their destination.
Before them appeared a significantly large Crystal Sky Island, as smooth as a mirror, showing no traces of plant life.
In the distance, the Violent Bears on that island seemed to sense Han Xing and his group’s aura.
One by one, they awoke from their previously dormant state.
"Rumble!"
Han Xing felt the Sky Island tremble violently.
Then, before them appeared a massive group of at least a million Crystal Violent Bears.
Their sizes ranged from thousand-meter-tall adult bears to bear cubs only a few dozen centimeters tall.
A multitude of round eyes curiously fixed on Han Xing and the others.
As for Bear Spirit Gangtu, it had disappeared with the end of its duration.
On this Sky Island, there were many Legendary Level auras present.
There were also many ordinary Violent Bears from Tier One to Tier Five.
At the same time, Han Xing and the others sensed an ancient aura coming from the center of the distant Sky Island, heading their way.
The intensity of that aura seemed to have reached the Middle-tier Demigod level.
The Sky Island began to shake slightly.
A creature at the Demigod Level naturally had the ability to fly.
Before long, a colossal figure, reaching ten thousand meters and comparable to Bear Spirit Gangtu, arrived beside the group.
At this moment, over a million Violent Bears looked at Han Xing and the others, letting out threatening growls.
At this time, Xiong Da immediately jumped down, approaching the Demigod-level giant bear, seemingly communicating something.
The Demigod-level giant bear listened while curiously watching Han Xing and the others.
Moments later, the Demigod-level giant bear seemed to understand Xiong Da’s intentions, and its pupils suddenly contracted.
The Demigod giant bear looked at Han Xing with mixed suspicion and doubt.

chapters.title: Chapter 803 - 441: Demonized Saber-toothed Tiger
paragraphs: After receiving confirmation from Xiong Da, the demigod-level giant bear appeared even more excited.
It quickly came to the front of Han Xing and the others, and a fluctuation of divine power appeared.
"Friends of the Human Race, I heard that you have a way to retrieve that Elemental God’s divine format?"
Han Xing nodded, "That’s right."
"As I told Xiong Da before, we will take the divine format."
"As for the altar fragment inside, we’ll leave it to you. Is that okay?"
Xiong Da should have conveyed Han Xing’s request to this demigod giant bear.
Upon hearing this, the other party immediately agreed: "No problem!"
"If you young friends can retrieve the Elemental Divine Format, our Violent Bear Race will remember your help for generations!"
Han Xing shook his head, "There’s no need for that, we each take what we need."
Pausing for a moment, Han Xing continued, "Time is of the essence, should we resolve this matter now at the location of the divine format?"
The demigod-level Violent Bear was slightly stunned.
So urgent?
However, what it didn’t know was, to prevent the Abyss Realm from suddenly invading at this time.
Han Xing also had to hurry to the Monsoon Islands.
For him, time was very tight now.
The demigod-level Violent Bear said, "Please wait a moment, the divine format is not far from here."
"I’ll have my clansmen near the divine format return first."
Han Xing nodded.
Because they indeed sensed that the divine format was not far from this Crystal Continent.
They could wait for this short period.
The demigod-level Violent Bear said, "Friends of the Human Race, I’ll be right back."
"You may rest on our mainland for now."
Having said that, the Violent Bear transformed into a stream of light and disappeared on the spot.
Meanwhile, the Crystal Bear Race learned that this group of the Human Race was here to help them.
One by one, they let go of their vigilance and looked at Han Xing and the others with a trace of gratitude.
"Let’s go, we’ll wait on that Sky Island," Han Xing said.
The team members immediately smiled with delight.
Their eyes showed they had long wanted to go to the Violent Bear Race’s Sky Island.
As for the reason, it was simple.
Just the thousands upon thousands of bear cubs below.
The five of them just landed.
Nearby, a group of bear cubs immediately surrounded them, looking at Han Xing and the others with curious eyes.
The five of them had not walked far.
Already, hundreds of bear cubs were following.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, the two women, their eyes already filled with longing,
At this time, couldn’t resist temptation, directly picking up a bear cub, caressing it excitedly.
Initially, the nearby Crystal Bears were instantly on guard upon seeing their actions,
But when they realized the two women did not harm the cubs, they let down their guard.
"Woo... woo..."
The bear cub being held flailed its short limbs in the air, looking adorably silly.
"Ah! So cute!"
"Sister Lian Meng, look, all those bear cubs are gathering around!" Su Xiaoyang exclaimed.
Zhang Lianmeng also looked excitedly at the Crystal Bear cubs.
Watching the growing number of Crystal Bear cubs around them.
In no time, tens of thousands of cubs appeared nearby.
The scene was quite impressive.
Other bear cubs were still scrambling to get Zhang Lianmeng and the others’ attention.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t resist his curiosity either.
He directly picked up two bear cubs and placed them on his shoulders.
Those bear cubs were not shy at all, sitting steadily on Cheng Jianyong’s shoulders, occasionally making sounds.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, "These little things are quite cute."
When the bear cubs realized these humans wouldn’t harm them, they scrambled over.
It wasn’t long before even Han Xing and Shen Yun were covered with Crystal Bear accessories.
Of course, with their current constitution, this weight was not an issue at all.
Just then.
The five of them suddenly stopped simultaneously.
Then, a terrifying aura emanated from them.
The five of them, without any discussion, simultaneously entered a combat state.
Tens of thousands of bear cubs and the adult Violent Bears around them were all stunned in place, seemingly unaware of what happened.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "Something’s coming, prepare for battle."
Only then did the Crystal Violent Bears sense it, a powerful divine power fluctuation emerged from behind them.
Within this divine power, there was a feral aura.
Although the Crystal Violent Bear Race also had this aura,
It was completely different from what Han Xing and the others sensed now.
It was an even more ferocious, more aggressive divine power.
And just then.
The sky around them suddenly filled with black fog.
The fog rapidly expanded in an instant, reaching a diameter of thousands of kilometers!
Only then did the Crystal Violent Bears realize what was happening.
All the adult Violent Bears stood upright, opened their massive mouths, and howled into the sky.
"Roar! Roar, roar!!"
The sound echoed for hundreds of kilometers, the entire enormous Sky Island resounding with the roars.
This was the signal of enemy invasion!
However, before the Violent Bears could prepare for battle,
Several gigantic black figures emerged from the fog, each exceeding a kilometer in height.
Like black lightning, they leaped onto the Violent Bear Race’s Sky Island in an instant.
"Boom! Boom!"
The gigantic bodies caused a violent tremor as they landed.

The bear cub being held flailed its short limbs in the air, looking adorably silly.
"Ah!
So cute!"
"Sister Lian Meng, look, all those bear cubs are gathering around!" Su Xiaoyang exclaimed.
Zhang Lianmeng also looked excitedly at the Crystal Bear cubs.
Watching the growing number of Crystal Bear cubs around them.
In no time, tens of thousands of cubs appeared nearby.
The scene was quite impressive.
Other bear cubs were still scrambling to get Zhang Lianmeng and the others’ attention.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t resist his curiosity either.
He directly picked up two bear cubs and placed them on his shoulders.
Those bear cubs were not shy at all, sitting steadily on Cheng Jianyong’s shoulders, occasionally making sounds.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, "These little things are quite cute."
When the bear cubs realized these humans wouldn’t harm them, they scrambled over.
It wasn’t long before even Han Xing and Shen Yun were covered with Crystal Bear accessories.
Of course, with their current constitution, this weight was not an issue at all.
Just then.
The five of them suddenly stopped simultaneously.
Then, a terrifying aura emanated from them.
The five of them, without any discussion, simultaneously entered a combat state.
Tens of thousands of bear cubs and the adult Violent Bears around them were all stunned in place, seemingly unaware of what happened.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "Something’s coming, prepare for battle."
Only then did the Crystal Violent Bears sense it, a powerful divine power fluctuation emerged from behind them.
Within this divine power, there was a feral aura.
Although the Crystal Violent Bear Race also had this aura,
It was completely different from what Han Xing and the others sensed now.
It was an even more ferocious, more aggressive divine power.
And just then.
The sky around them suddenly filled with black fog.
The fog rapidly expanded in an instant, reaching a diameter of thousands of kilometers!
Only then did the Crystal Violent Bears realize what was happening.
All the adult Violent Bears stood upright, opened their massive mouths, and howled into the sky.
"Roar!
Roar, roar!!"
The sound echoed for hundreds of kilometers, the entire enormous Sky Island resounding with the roars.
This was the signal of enemy invasion!
However, before the Violent Bears could prepare for battle,
Several gigantic black figures emerged from the fog, each exceeding a kilometer in height.
Like black lightning, they leaped onto the Violent Bear Race’s Sky Island in an instant.
"Boom!
Boom!"
The gigantic bodies caused a violent tremor as they landed.

chapters.title: Chapter 804 - 441: Demonized Saber-toothed Tiger 2
paragraphs: In front of Han Xing, several tiger-shaped creatures appeared, entirely pitch-black, as if made from black crystal, with two ten-meter-long fangs protruding from their mouths.
Then, they saw the attributes of these creatures.
[Divine Creation: Saber-toothed Tiger (Demonized)]: High-tier Legendary Level
[Level]: 59
[Attributes]: Power 37155, Agility 46231, Spirit 31923, Constitution 33291
[Skills]: Sword Tooth Form, Lightning Strike, Tearing Claw, Demonized Crystal Domain, Storm Nebula Split (Legendary Skills)
[Divine Power Value]: 3724
Note: A creation of the Divine Spirit, eroded by the Elemental God’s divine format, and invaded by an unknown force, causing peculiar changes in its body!
Seeing the information on the system prompt, the group exchanged glances.
Shen Yun asked doubtfully: "Is this the Saber-toothed Tiger race that the Violent Bears mentioned?"
"Invaded by an unknown force, is this why they’ve transformed into this demonized state?"
The group shook their heads; they weren’t quite sure either.
However, as soon as the demonized saber-toothed tigers appeared, they locked their gaze on the Crystal Violent Bears, their eyes showing a savage red glow.
"Roar!!"
In the next moment, the group of demonized saber-toothed tigers rushed into the midst of the Crystal Violent Bears and started a massacre!
The demonized saber-toothed tigers moved extremely quickly, like flashes of black lightning.
With each flash, they appeared near a Crystal Violent Bear, opened their bloody mouth, and bit towards it!
"Crack! Crack!"
Sickening sounds filled with teeth-clenching sourness arose.
One by one, the bodies of the Crystal Violent Bears were bitten into fragments.
These few demonized saber-toothed tigers possessed high-tier legendary strength, while most of the Crystal Violent Bears only had Tier Four and Tier Five strength.
They had absolutely no power to resist.
And just then.
A group of Crystal Violent Bears over a thousand meters in size, with a legendary-level aura, arrived.
They roared in fury.
"Damn saber-toothed tigers!
"Warriors of the Violent Bear race, follow me into battle and tear them apart!"
"Roar!!"
With those words, they all charged at the legendary-level demonized saber-toothed tigers.
The two sides instantly clashed.
This was, after all, the territory of the Violent Bear race.
With more legendary-level Violent Bears charging in.
Soon, the demonized saber-toothed tigers were surrounded completely.
It looked like they were about to be besieged to death by the group of Crystal Violent Bears.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled: "Are these saber-toothed tigers out of their minds?"
"With just a few high-tier legends, they dare to charge into the stronghold of the Crystal Violent Bears?"
Han Xing and the others couldn’t help but feel doubtful.
However, just as he finished speaking.
Thousands of black shadows suddenly darted out from the black mist.
These black shadows moved extremely fast, transforming into streaks of lightning.
Moreover, their numbers continued to increase.
In the blink of an eye, a legion of saber-toothed tigers with strength ranging from Tier Five Lord to Legendary Level appeared on the Sky Island of the Crystal Violent Bear race.
Shen Yun asked in confusion: "Brother Xing, does this tactic seem familiar to you?"
"We seem to have encountered it before?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s expression turned thoughtful.
"Roar! Roar!!!"
The group of Crystal Saber-toothed Tigers opened their bloody jaws, continuously letting out roars.
They possessed terrifying strength that rivaled the Crystal Violent Bear race.
Both sides knew the opponent’s power, so no rash moves were made.
However, the purpose of these saber-toothed tigers was to wage war.
The stalemate lasted for less than a second.
As a legendary saber-toothed tiger kicked off with both legs, it suddenly lunged at the Crystal Violent Bear race.
The two sides began a full-scale slaughter.
The little bear cubs let out low whimpers, then immediately lay on the ground, merging with the entire continent.
This seemed to be their camouflage color, their means to avoid danger.
Though, in Han Xing and the others’ eyes, this method was somewhat silly and endearing.
The battle between the saber-toothed tiger army and the Crystal Violent Bear army was extremely brutal, filled with wildness.
Both sides had simple attack methods, either using teeth or sharp claws to destroy the opponent’s body.
"Snap!"
A Crystal Giant Bear smacked down with its paw, directly smashing its opponent’s body!
Black crystals scattered all over the ground.
Han Xing and the others, watching from the side, noticed.
After landing on the ground, these crystals quickly turned into black smoke and dissipated in place.
Including those fallen giant bears, it was the same.
"Crack! Crack!"
Since both sides had crystal-like bodies, during the battle, one could hear glass shattering-like sounds.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong asked: "Brother Xing, should we help?"
Han Xing nodded, "Let’s do it, take out this group of saber-toothed tigers, and don’t waste too much time."
However, just as Han Xing and the others were about to take action, a transmission suddenly appeared in their ears.
"Friends of the Human Race, this is our struggle with the Saber-toothed Tiger race, no need for your intervention."
"Please wait a moment, we’ll resolve it soon."
Upon hearing this transmission, Han Xing and the others knew it was sent by that demigod-level Violent Bear.
The five of them exchanged looks and paused in place.
With that demigod-level Violent Bear joining the battle.
The situation started to tilt into a one-sided crushing defeat.
A legendary-level demonized saber-toothed tiger was about to attack when it suddenly saw a fierce gaze appear behind it.
In the shocked gaze of the saber-toothed tiger.
The demigod-level Violent Bear’s massive bear paw slammed down, directly smashing it to pieces in one blow!
Then, the demigod-level Violent Bear completely entered a berserk mode.
"Roar!"

chapters.title: Chapter 805 - 441: Demonized Saber-toothed Tiger 3
paragraphs: It charged straight into the army of Saber-toothed Tigers, its Bear Paws slapping down again and again.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
Everywhere it passed, all the Demonized Saber-toothed Tigers shattered like porcelain at the slightest touch!
Before their eyes, the invading Saber-toothed Tiger army had already lost nearly half its numbers.
Right at this moment—
A massive shadow suddenly sprang out from that clump of darkness.
And the aura of this shadow didn’t lose out at all to that Crystal Violent Bear.
This was a Demonized Saber-toothed Tiger at Demigod Level!
The moment it appeared, it pounced at that Demigod Level Violent Bear in a completely berserk posture!
The two gigantic beasts, each over ten thousand meters tall, tangled together on the spot.
"Crack!"
The Demonized Saber-toothed Tiger clamped down hard on the Crystal Violent Bear’s shoulder.
The Crystal Violent Bear kept slapping the Saber-toothed Tiger’s head with its massive Bear Paws.
The two Demigod Level behemoths kept Rolling and raging against each other on the ground, fighting like mad!
The ground shook continuously, even crushing quite a few Saber-toothed Tigers and Violent Bears underneath.
The surrounding Saber-toothed Tigers and Violent Bears proactively cleared out a battlefield for them.
Han Xing and the others were still watching from the side, but the more they looked, the more familiar that shadow seemed.
Cheng Jianyong suddenly said, "I remember now!"
"This shadow seems like a method of the Shadow Legion!"
"Those guys just suddenly appeared out of the shadows!"
Everyone realized something.
Han Xing nodded and said, "It is indeed a method of the Shadow Legion."
"But I haven’t sensed the aura of the Shadow Monarch."
Speaking of which, Han Xing hadn’t seen the Shadow Monarch in a long time.
Ever since that battle with the Witch Race, the Shadow Monarch had practically vanished.
Only last time, when Han Xing almost took down the God of Tricks, had he appeared together with that woman.
Han Xing pondered, "Still, even without the Shadow Monarch’s aura, these Demonized Saber-toothed Tigers are very likely related to him."
"Take action. Forget what that Violent Bear said about this being a Race war."
"Capture this Saber-toothed Tiger and see if we can force out the Shadow Monarch’s whereabouts.
The team members nodded at the same time.
The next moment.
The five of them gripped their weapons simultaneously.
Then Shen Yun cast two Blessings, instantly causing everyone’s aura to skyrocket!
Sensing the sudden appearance of five Demigod Level auras, both the Crystal Violent Bear and the Demonized Saber-toothed Tiger were startled.
And when they discovered that the sources of these auras were those humans, the two sides reacted very differently.
Before the Crystal Violent Bear could speak.
Han Xing said directly, "We have questions for this Saber-toothed Tiger. You go handle the other enemies and finish this quickly."
Han Xing’s words were extremely concise and to the point.
After hearing this, the Crystal Violent Bear abandoned the opponent in front of it and charged toward the other Saber-toothed Tigers.
The next moment.
Han Xing loosed an Arrow, directly striking the body of a Legendary Saber-toothed Tiger.
"Boom!"
After a deafening explosion—
This Saber-toothed Tiger was blasted to pieces on the spot.
[Successfully killed Divine Creation: Saber-toothed Tiger (Demonization). Gained 2.137 billion Experience Value. Automatically absorbed the Divine Power on the target. Divine Power Value +5.]
Seeing Han Xing make a move—
The Crystal Violent Bear Race was utterly astonished.
This was their first time having outside support while fighting the Saber-toothed Tiger Race.
On the other side, the Demonized Saber-toothed Tigers were in complete panic.
"Roar!"
They let out low growls from their throats, clearly sensing the threat posed by these humans.
They could even feel waves of fear rising within them!
However, in their Demonization State, the already brutal Saber-toothed Tigers forcibly suppressed their fear.
Ignoring the threat from Han Xing and the others, they actually chose to engage head-on!
But their actions were nothing more than eggs thrown against a boulder.
"Swish!"
"Boom!"
The Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill and Chain Fireball kept bursting forth.
Wave after wave of explosions rang out.
The Saber-toothed Tiger legion was slaughtered in swathes by Han Xing and the others, and even that Demigod Level Saber-toothed Tiger was being suppressed by Su Xiaoyang alone.
On this continent, all the giant Bears watched Han Xing’s group of five in shock.
Just the terrifying combat strength they were showing now would be enough to wipe out every Violent Bear on the entire Sky Island.
Even that Demigod Level Violent Bear wouldn’t stand a chance!
At this point, the Violent Bears seemed quite relieved that these humans weren’t their enemies.
Meanwhile, the bear cubs lying on the ground all scrambled to their feet after seeing Han Xing and the others’ performance.
They mimicked the adult Bears by standing upright, their round eyes staring at Han Xing’s group of five as they let out excited roars.
"Awoo! Awoo!"
Each one looked extremely happy, even dancing in place.
Two minutes passed.
The number of Demonized Saber-toothed Tigers around them grew thinner and thinner.
They stared in terror at those humans, low growls rumbling from their throats in a final attempt at intimidation.
However, when an Arrow from Han Xing came flying—
This group of Saber-toothed Tigers finally followed their instincts and fled madly toward the rear.
They seemed to want to escape back into that black mist.
Han Xing and the others naturally wouldn’t give them the chance.
Thirty seconds later, every Demonized Saber-toothed Tiger on the field had been blasted apart.
Only the last Demigod Level Saber-toothed Tiger was left struggling alone.
By now, that Saber-toothed Tiger seemed to have recovered its rationality.
It realized that at this rate there was no way it could be a match for those humans.
Rather than die a meaningless death here, it would be better to preserve itself and fight again another day.
With that thought—
The Saber-toothed Tiger let out a furious roar, then whipped its tail at the Violent Bear with a sudden lash.
The Demigod Level Violent Bear was caught off guard, clearly not expecting such a move from the Saber-toothed Tiger.
The Crystal Violent Bear couldn’t help complaining in its heart, "Damn it, I’m not even hitting you anymore and you still Attack me!"
It instinctively tried to Dodge.
And right then—
The Saber-toothed Tiger planted all four limbs on the Violent Bear’s body and then kicked off with a powerful push!

chapters.title: Chapter 806 - 442: The Whereabouts of the Shadow Monarch
paragraphs: The saber-toothed tiger pressed all four limbs against the violent bear, then suddenly sprang off!
The two sides separated in an instant.
The saber-toothed tiger seized the opportunity, turning into a black light and fleeing, seemingly about to dive into the dark mist.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang shot an arrow.
Thousands of vines suddenly appeared and completely entangled the saber-toothed tiger.
Meanwhile.
Zhang Lianmeng immediately launched more than ten ice spears.
After acquiring a new legendary passive skill, even ordinary ice spear attacks can now stack their freezing effect.
Even a demigod-level saber-toothed tiger was instantly half-frozen into an ice block.
Under dual constraints.
It crashed directly to the ground.
"Boom!"
The massive body smashed a ten-thousand-meter crater into the ground.
This sight left the adjacent crystal violent bears stunned.
They actually managed to control a demigod-level creature!
These humans are truly terrifying!
At this time, Han Xing suddenly said, "Watch this saber-toothed tiger, I’ll go check the dark mist."
"I want to see how these creatures came through!"
However, when Han Xing entered the dark mist, he didn’t sense any spatial fluctuations, nor did it have teleportation capabilities.
Han Xing quickly surmised the reason, "Only specific creatures can merge into the dark mist?"
"This method is somewhat troublesome, and I can’t locate the Shadow Monarch through the dark mist."
Han Xing couldn’t help but shake his head in disappointment.
Previously, in the Witch Race Territory, whenever the shadow army launched a raid, masses of dark mist would also appear.
Those shadow monsters emerged from the mist, and among them were many creatures whose bodies resembled black crystals.
It seems that the Shadow Monarch hasn’t started his encroachment on Crystal Mountain just recently.
He must have targeted the saber-toothed tiger clan many years ago.
Thinking of this, Han Xing stepped out of the dark mist.
Simultaneously, the dark mist seemed to sense Han Xing and the others’ presence and became even thinner.
On the Sky Island around Crystal Mountain, the violent bears, seeing the battle end, also gathered around.
Han Xing’s figure flashed, arriving directly beside the saber-toothed tiger.
"Tell me the location of the Shadow Monarch, and I can spare your life."
However, the saber-toothed tiger seemed not to understand Han Xing’s words and continued to roar madly.
"Roar! Roar!"
It also continued to struggle frantically.
Su Xiaoyang’s vines were instantly snapped in thousands, and even Zhang Lianmeng’s freezing effect was forcibly broken.
Controlling a demigod-level creature isn’t easy, so Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng kept casting various skills.
Han Xing furrowed his brows.
He knew these demigod-level creatures could communicate.
But clearly, this saber-toothed tiger was unwilling to cooperate.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the violent bear and asked, "Is there a way to make it speak?"
The violent bear was momentarily stunned, then nodded and said, "Yes."
"The saber-toothed tiger clan values its fangs as treasures, more precious than their own lives."
"You could try this method."
On the ground, the saber-toothed tiger’s body trembled immediately, looking at the crystal violent bear with extreme anger, "Di Riao! You despicable creature!"
"How dare you tell an outsider!"
The crystal violent bear looked indifferently at the saber-toothed tiger.
We were enemies from the start; what outsiders?
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong suddenly wielded a massive molten rock pillar.
It was the weapon of that Abyss Demon.
He sinisterly eyed the saber-toothed tiger’s two fangs, saying slyly, "These should be quite valuable, right?"
"If demigod-level saber-toothed tiger fangs were placed on Blue Star, it would probably cause a global sensation!
The saber-toothed tiger trembled all over, but it still gritted its teeth, "Humans, don’t expect me to speak!"
Cheng Jianyong said nothing and lifted the molten rock pillar, touching the saber-toothed tiger’s fangs, the attached high heat making a hissing sound instantly.
The fear in the saber-toothed tiger’s heart grew stronger,
Han Xing’s voice appeared, "Ask you again, where is the Shadow Monarch?"
However, the saber-toothed tiger stubbornly bit its lower lip, refusing to speak.
It also felt extremely humiliated in its heart.
This was the first time in its life it was treated like this by a group of legendary-level humans!
Seeing it still refused to speak.
Cheng Jianyong didn’t hesitate, he swung the molten rock pillar in his hand and smashed it down forcefully.
"Bang!!"
After the terrifying impact sound, came a sound like glass shattering.
"Growl!!!"
After a scream echoed throughout the Sky Island, one of the saber-toothed tiger’s fangs suddenly disappeared.
And on the ground several hundred meters away, appeared a curved black fang.
The bear cubs gathered again, curiously trying to touch the fang.
However, being a demigod-level creature, even the broken fang had extremely strong divine power.
The cubs were jolted back as if struck by electricity, rolling several times on the ground before stopping.
This scene made everyone want to laugh.
At this moment, the saber-toothed tiger, missing a fang, looked quite disheveled.
The fangs in its mouth were their weapons and also their honor.
Even if they die in battle, they must not let their fangs be damaged; this is the saber-toothed tiger clan’s consensus.
Han Xing looked at the saber-toothed tiger, saying coldly, "This is your last chance."
"If you refuse to speak, I will break your last fang and make your corpse into a specimen."

chapters.title: Chapter 807 - 442: The Whereabouts of the Shadow Monarch (2)
paragraphs: "For tens of thousands of years in the future, creatures will see you, unaware that you are a saber-toothed tiger."
"They will think you are just an ordinary tiger."
Upon hearing these words, the saber-toothed tiger trembled all over and rapidly retorted, "I am not one of those lowly tigers!"
"I am a noble saber-toothed tiger!"
Han Xing glanced at it and then said, "Who the hell cares if you are a saber-toothed tiger or a tiger."
Seeing its apparent unwillingness to speak.
Han Xing exchanged a look with Cheng Jianyong.
Cheng Jianyong immediately understood.
He raised the molten rock pillar, prepared to smash it fiercely!
A fierce wind sound reached the saber-toothed tiger’s ears!
Its eyes showed a terrified expression.
Finally, it spoke: "I’ll talk!"
Simultaneously.
Cheng Jianyong’s molten rock pillar stopped about half a meter from the saber-toothed tiger’s fangs.
Cold sweat poured from the saber-toothed tiger.
Under Han Xing’s gaze, it finally said, "I don’t know who the Shadow Monarch you mentioned is!"
"I only know that hundreds of years ago, a mysterious man found me and said he could give me more powerful power, helping our saber-toothed tiger clan to seize all altar fragments."
"I believed him!"
"Then I found that after that power entered our bodies, it indeed greatly enhanced our strength."
"However, we were affected by that power, occasionally becoming incredibly violent and irritable."
"As a demigod-level creature, I can barely resist the influence of this chaotic energy!"
"However, my clan members gradually lost their reason!"
"That man threatened us to work for him, or he would bury all saber-toothed tigers here!"
"So, we don’t know the man’s whereabouts. He only appears when he seeks us out."
After hearing the saber-toothed tiger finish, the crowd nodded in realization.
The mysterious figure it mentioned should be the Shadow Monarch.
And the fact that he knew about the grudge between the saber-toothed tiger clan and the violent bear clan was because he wanted to seize the altar fragments from them.
The Shadow Monarch and that mysterious woman, they shouldn’t engage in meaningless actions.
Thinking of this, Han Xing said, "Elder Xiong.
"Could I take a look at your clan’s altar fragment?"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s request, a look of hesitation appeared in the eyes of the demigod-level violent bear.
But thinking of these humans’ strength.
And their recent assistance.
The demigod-level violent bear eventually nodded.
At the next moment, a black metal fragment appeared in its hand, with the lower half of a snake-like creature engraved on it.
On this black metal fragment, Han Xing and his companions felt a familiar aura.
Just as the demigod-level violent bear was about to hand the metal fragment to Han Xing.
The demonized saber-toothed tiger nearby angrily exclaimed, "Di Riao! You’re actually giving the altar fragment of the Divine Master to these humans!"
Crystal Violent Bear said speechlessly, "Smart, haven’t you also accepted that dark guy’s power?"
"You’re the one who betrayed Lord God’s side, aren’t you?"
Hearing this, the demonized saber-toothed tiger was left speechless.
But it seemed still uncontent.
Han Xing ignored it and after taking the fragment, the attributes of this item appeared before him.
[Fragment of the Barbaric God’s Altar]: Special Artifact
[Artifact Effect]: Gather all altar fragments to assemble a complete altar and receive the blessing of the Barbaric God.
Upon seeing this system prompt, Han Xing nodded in realization.
This effect, indeed matches what Xiong Da told them.
Could it be, the Shadow Monarch’s goal was to obtain the blessing of the Barbaric God?
However, subconsciously, Han Xing felt it wasn’t that simple.
This guy surely had other motives.
But Han Xing couldn’t guess it.
Thinking of this, Han Xing shook his head, deciding not to concern himself with whatever goals the Shadow Monarch might have.
The urgent task now is to retrieve that Earth Divine Format.
Thus, Han Xing said, "Elder Xiong, you can deal with this saber-toothed tiger.
"We have other things to do, please take us to retrieve that Earth Divine Format."
Crystal Violent Bear looked at the black saber-toothed tiger on the ground, then nodded.
"Roar!!"
Crystal Violent Bear roared towards the Sky Island.
The legendary-level crystal violent bears understood.
They walked into this Sky Island, beside a mountain range tens of thousands of meters high.
Then a group of legendary-level violent bears placed their paws on the mountain.
"Boom, boom, boom!"
The ground began to tremble violently.
In the surprised eyes of the bear cubs, this mountain tens of thousands of meters high was actually lifted by this group of legendary violent bears.
"Thud! Thud! Thud!"
The group of violent bears worked together, the giant mountain started to move.
Then, they slowly lifted it over the saber-toothed tiger’s head.
The saber-toothed tiger crouched on the ground, seeing the giant mountain overhead, its eyes showing fear.
"What do you guys intend to do to me?"
The Crystal Violent Bear clan did not answer, the tasks they needed to do were clear.
"Boom!"
The giant mountain crashed down.
Directly sealing this saber-toothed tiger.
After these were done, that demigod violent bear nodded and then looked at Han Xing and others, saying.
"Let’s go, I’ll take you to where the Divine Format is."
As the words fell, five people and one bear flew from their spot, directly heading into the distance.
Half an hour later.
They had completely left that enormous Sky Island.
Arriving here, the divine power wave emitted by the Divine Format was even more intense.
Everyone clearly felt that some changes seemed to occur to their bodies,
Fingers becoming stiff, skin growing darker and more yellow.

chapters.title: Chapter 808 - 442: The Whereabouts of the Shadow Monarch_3
paragraphs: At this moment, Cheng Jianyong stretched out five yellowing fingers and said in surprise, "Oh my... Is the eroding ability of this Divine Format really that fierce?"
"We haven’t even approached the 10,000-meter area, yet I feel like I’m about to turn into those stones."
Everyone was also amazed, observing their body’s reactions.
Han Xing said at this moment, "Release Divine Power to resist."
Upon hearing this, everyone complied.
With the release of everyone’s Divine Power, the erosion effect caused by that Divine Format quickly disappeared.
The areas on their bodies, which had already turned yellow and were gradually transforming into crystals, returned to their original state.
Soon, under the lead of the Violent Bear, they entered the 10,000-meter area of the Earth Divine Format.
Here, the power of erosion was even more terrifying.
Moreover, with every step forward, they could feel a tingling sensation all over.
Even their Divine Power Domains were struggling to hold up.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said in surprise, "Oh my... This doesn’t feel right, Brother Xing."
"The power of erosion from this Earth Divine Format is much more terrifying than those Divine Formats we encountered before!"
Han Xing nodded, having realized this too.
Compared to when they collected the previous Divine Formats, although those Divine Powers were terrifying, it wasn’t to this extent.
At that time, it was a change every thousand meters.
Now, with almost every step, they could feel the tingling getting worse,
as if the Earth Divine Format was frantically releasing its own Divine Power.
Turning everything around them into a crystalline state!
Even more bizarre was that the power had started invading their Spirits.
The team members felt as if half of their consciousness was frozen, making thinking particularly difficult.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but complain, "It’s really strange, feels like I’ve suddenly developed Alzheimer’s!"
The team members also kept shaking their heads to keep themselves awake.
After they advanced another kilometer.
The Divine Power Domains on the team started to gradually be breached, and that eroding Divine Power began to cover their entire bodies.
At this time, the Crystal Violent Bear suddenly spoke, "Human friends, I can only accompany you this far."
"If I go further, I feel like I might stay here forever...
The Crystal Violent Bear’s eyes showed a look of helplessness.
It realized that these few humans were really a bit terrifying.
Even it, a demigod, was struggling to hold up, yet these legendary level humans could persist until now.
Han Xing nodded and said, "That’s fine, we can handle the rest on our own."
"Elder Xiong, you should leave first."
The Crystal Violent Bear immediately felt relieved and quickly left from where it was.
It transformed into a stream of earth-yellow light, disappearing into the horizon.
Meanwhile, everyone else arrived at an area approximately 9000 meters away from the core of the Divine Format.
Except for Han Xing, the other four already had a faint yellow sheen on their bodies, gradually evolving into that crystalline state.
This transformation left everyone extremely shocked.
They needed to know, although they weren’t demigods now,
just based on their attributes, they were not far from a regular demigod.
Yet despite this, they still struggled to resist that terrifying power of erosion.
Subsequently, they almost had to push through that terrifying energy to advance.
Han Xing was relatively fine, as his Divine Power Value was almost ten times more than the team members’.
At this distance, the Divine Power erosion emitted by the Divine Format couldn’t break through his Divine Power Domain.
After moving forward another kilometer.
Cheng Jianyong looked at his own body, his eyes filled with a look of astonishment.
At this moment, the bodies of the four underwent a strange transformation,
the front half of their bodies turned into a transparent crystalline luster.
While the back half of their bodies remained flesh and blood.
At the same time, they also felt their consciousness becoming increasingly rigid.
Cheng Jianyong said with difficulty, "This is really paranormal."
"In the past, when we were level 50, we could force our way into the Divine Format’s 5000-meter range."
"Now, after reaching level 60 and equipping an entire set of Divine Artifact Equipment, yet at 8000 meters, it’s almost impossible.
Shen Yun remained silent, but from his stern face, it was evident his state was very good.
Han Xing also noticed their state and said with a frown, "Everyone stop."
"If you continue forward, you might all turn into that crystalline state."
"Just to be safe, I’ll proceed alone."
Hearing these words, the gaze of everyone was somewhat resigned.
But they also knew, there was no other choice.
After all, the erosion effect of the Divine Power from this Divine Format was extremely terrifying and irreversible.
Once turned into crystalline life, it would be difficult to restore to a fleshly state again.
Therefore, the team members turned around and left one after another.
Han Xing glanced at the chaotic Divine Power fluctuations ahead.
Directly released golden Divine Power, shrouding his body, and a golden Divine Power Shield appeared.
"Buzzing!"
The Divine Power aura emitted by the Earth Divine Format continuously canceled out with Han Xing’s Divine Power Shield.
Ripples appeared on the surface of the shield.
However, Han Xing’s ample Divine Power completely ignored this kind of Divine Power erosion.
He faced no hindrances, directly charging toward the area where the Earth Divine Format was located.
In a blink, he arrived at the 7000-meter mark.
Once here, the fluctuations on the Divine Power Shield grew even more intense.
But Han Xing did not stop; instead, he began to accelerate.
By the time he reached the 6000-meter mark, the Divine Power Shield had already become somewhat transparent.
It was almost on the brink of collapse.
Han Xing couldn’t help but show a look of astonishment in his eyes.
He needed to know that his Divine Power Value was as high as 130,000!
This was almost at the level of an average high-tier demigod.
Meaning, even a high-tier demigod at this position would have their Divine Power Shield unable to withstand it!

He faced no hindrances, directly charging toward the area where the Earth Divine Format was located.
In a blink, he arrived at the 7000-meter mark.
Once here, the fluctuations on the Divine Power Shield grew even more intense.
But Han Xing did not stop; instead, he began to accelerate.
By the time he reached the 6000-meter mark, the Divine Power Shield had already become somewhat transparent.
It was almost on the brink of collapse.
Han Xing couldn’t help but show a look of astonishment in his eyes.
He needed to know that his Divine Power Value was as high as 130,000!
This was almost at the level of an average high-tier demigod.
Meaning, even a high-tier demigod at this position would have their Divine Power Shield unable to withstand it!

chapters.title: Chapter 809 - 443: Two Supreme Hidden Professions
paragraphs: Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh.
This divine format is truly terrifying.
However, fortunately, due to his human identity,
Han Xing only needs to reach the 5000-meter area, and the divine power seal here will automatically be lifted.
Thinking of this, Han Xing continued to charge forward without hesitation.
And upon reaching the 5000-meter area, the divine power fluctuations here became as violent as the sea waves rising up in a storm.
If it weren’t for Han Xing constantly releasing divine power, maintaining the presence of the divine power shield,
his body would’ve long been eroded by the divine format.
However, what puzzled Han Xing was that he didn’t hear the usual system prompt.
"Strange, why hasn’t the divine power seal been lifted?"
Just as he finished speaking, the system prompt appeared.
[Target detected, verifying identity.]
[Race: Human Race (matching), Strength: Legend (matching), lifting earth element seal...]
Hearing this prompt, a look of joy appeared on Han Xing’s face.
"Finally, it’s lifted."
However, before Han Xing could truly celebrate, a second system prompt appeared.
[Due to unknown reasons, lifting the seal failed...]
[Please proceed to the divine format location manually to retrieve it.]
"Seal lifting failed? What is going on?"
Han Xing was utterly confused.
This was something he had never encountered when gathering other divine formats.
"What exactly happened to this divine format?"
"Does it mean I have to force my way to the divine format location?"
Han Xing frowned, starting to calculate in his mind the strength of his divine power to see if he could withstand this terrifying power of erosion and reach the core region.
A moment later, Han Xing had made a decision.
And that is, to go!
He wanted to know what exactly had happened in the core region of the divine format, why the seal lifting failed.
Moreover, even if he couldn’t withstand it in the end, Han Xing could manipulate the Oracle Throne to instantly teleport and escape!
With this thought in mind, Han Xing began advancing towards the core region of the divine format.
Four thousand meters...
Three thousand meters...
At this point, Han Xing’s golden shield gradually began turning into an earthy yellow color.
This erosion effect was too eerie.
It could erode not only the flesh body and consciousness but now even his divine power.
Fortunately, Han Xing’s divine power was abundant, allowing him to repeatedly release divine power shields.
Whenever the divine power showed signs of erosion and corruption, Han Xing would unhesitatingly release a new divine power shield.
Thirty seconds later, Han Xing had rushed several thousand meters.
This, now was approximately two thousand meters away from the core of the divine format.
Seeing around the almost tangible earthy yellow divine aura fluctuation,
Han Xing had a premonition.
Even an ordinary initial-tier demigod wouldn’t be able to withstand for a second at this location, turning into a crystal stone.
At this time, Han Xing focused his attention, looking towards the core region of the divine format.
Yet what puzzled him was, according to Han Xing’s perception,
from his position, he was less than two thousand meters away from the divine format!
With his current vision, he should be able to see through the divine power to the divine format’s location.
However, that area seemed to be shrouded by some powerful force, even Han Xing couldn’t see what was happening inside.
Han Xing shook his head and sighed, "Forget it, let’s move forward."
"I refuse to believe that getting right up next to the divine format, I still won’t see what’s inside!"
With these words, Han Xing gritted his teeth, braving the terrifying erosion of divine power, and rushed forward.
And when Han Xing reached the one-thousand-meter line,
the divine power in front of him had solidified completely into substance.
Han Xing felt as if he was in a sea of earthy yellow jelly.
Each step was grueling!
The strength of divine power here far exceeded the endurance limit of a middle-tier demigod.
Only a high-tier demigod could barely endure for a while.
Han Xing was forging ahead with gritted determination, ready to escape at any moment.
And when he was three hundred meters away from the divine format,
Han Xing finally vaguely saw the scene inside.
There seemed to be two figures!
"Someone?"
Han Xing was puzzled.
He focused his spirit, staring intently.
At this moment, he was sure, those were two figures.
The two figures seemed to be in a standoff, both facing away from Han Xing, their exact features unclear.
One was dressed in dreary earth-yellow silk, and under the light of divine power, her graceful figure was faintly visible.
With straight shoulders, a slender waist, and below, a pair of long and well-proportioned beautiful legs.
Just a back view could stir endless imagination in the heart.
Adding to it, that absolutely powerful aura, it’s as if this was the most perfect woman in the universe!
And anyone who could confront such a woman was certainly not an ordinary person.
That was a robust, explosively muscular male figure.
In front of this male, there was an oppressive aura felt deep in the soul!
It was a suppression from the depths of the bloodline!
Han Xing was extremely shocked.
Even he felt the cells all over his body were agitated.
It was as if this male was the creator of all life!
But soon, Han Xing suppressed the shock in his heart.
And he understood one thing clearly.
It was due to these two presences that the divine power fluctuations here were so violent, leading to the failure of the divine power seal lift,
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly heard a female voice.
"Unexpectedly, a human has reached here..."
This voice was extraordinarily ethereal, as if coming from the Nine Heavens.
Han Xing confirmed that it was the most beautiful voice he had ever heard in his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 810 - 443: Two Supreme Hidden Professions (2)
paragraphs: The woman still hadn’t turned around.
But Han Xing knew it was her speaking.
"Barbaric Wilderness, you seem to have lost..."
The female voice continued.
Opposite, the robust figure trembled and sighed, "Why do you always mess with me, woman?"
"I just placed an altar in the Holy Spirit Realm without doing anything, and you had to destroy it."
The female voice continued, "According to the rules."
"Holy Spirit Realm does not allow the appearance of divine spirit power..."
The other party responded disdainfully, "Divine power isn’t allowed, yet you still cast your divine format into the Holy Spirit Realm."
Listening to this, the female voice shook her head and said, "My purpose is different from yours."
"I aim to find the new Master of the Human Race and have him inherit my power..."
However, the robust figure spoke up, "I also want my power to be inherited, why can’t I do it?"
The female voice did not speak again.
The male voice echoed, "Forget it, I don’t want to argue with you."
"This generation’s Master of the Human Race is much better than those before."
"Element, let’s make a bet?"
"We’ll leave our power inheritance and see who he ends up inheriting from?"
The female voice remained silent but continued, "Barbaric Wilderness, your power inheritance is not allowed to appear in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"I won’t let you leave anything behind."
The other party, hearing this, became anxious, "Why are you more domineering than me, woman?"
"My altar was destroyed, the two races I used for experiments disappeared, and I haven’t troubled you yet, but you continue to pressure me?"
Nevertheless, that female figure seemed unwilling to continue the conversation with him.
A fierce burst of divine power emanated from her.
The male figure was unwilling to be outdone, as an invisible wave appeared from him.
Han Xing could feel that this wave was not divine power, but a type of power he had never seen before.
Two completely different forces, as if from different worlds, began clashing.
"Buzz!"
The area was once again plunged into an extremely intense upheaval.
Even the entire Crystal Mountain area felt the sensation.
Fortunately, both forces deliberately avoided Han Xing.
Otherwise, he would have controlled the Oracle Throne and escaped immediately.
At this moment, he seemed to be watching a slideshow.
How these two terrifying beings made their moves, Han Xing was completely unaware.
Let alone seeing clearly their battle scene.
And just a few seconds later, Han Xing suddenly felt a huge thundercloud engulfing the entire Crystal Mountain.
Whirr... Whirr whirr...
Terrorizing energy fluctuation continued to brew.
Han Xing, looking up in shock, muttered, "Damn! This might is even more terrifying than when the Demon Emperor appeared last time."
At this moment, a strong sense of crisis arose in his heart.
Because, last time, the lightning struck the Demon Emperor back directly.
This time, if the thundercloud aims at these two.
Then Han Xing standing beside would certainly be affected.
He had no confidence to survive under such terrifying thunder strikes!
"No, I have to run!"
"If I watch any longer, I might get struck too!"
Just as Han Xing was preparing to run away.
He suddenly heard the male voice say, "Element, stop."
"This is just a consciousness of ours, it’s meaningless to continue fighting. Let’s see how this human race chooses instead."
As the words fell, the female figure opposite gradually emerged.
She looked at the top, realizing she couldn’t continue the confrontation.
"Alright then, let this human race make his own choice..."
The two auras gradually dissipated.
Even the agitated divine power fluctuations around also calmed instantly.
As if they had never appeared.
Han Xing stared blankly at all before him.
Meanwhile, everything nearby returned to normal.
Han Xing could finally see the surrounding scenery clearly.
At the place where the two figures had stood off, two items were left behind.
A rhombus item emitting an earth-yellow light, like a crystal.
Beside it was a rusty broken key.
"Key?"
Han Xing’s eyes showed a strange expression.
"Is this key the power inheritance that muscular man mentioned?"
Han Xing directly picked up both items.
System notification appeared.
[Acquired Elemental God’s Divine Format - Earth, acquired Barbaric God’s Inheritance Palace Key...]
Han Xing looked curiously at the two items in his hand.
No need to look further at the Earth Divine Format attribute, it’s like the other five Elemental Divine Formats.
What piqued Han Xing’s curiosity was the other item.
[Barbaric God’s Inheritance Palace Key]: Special artifact

[Artifact Effect]: Holding this key, one can find Barbaric God’s Inheritance Palace in the Endless Void and accept trials. After completing the inheritance trial, one can change profession to Supreme Hidden Profession: Barbaric God!
At the sight of the latter described attribute, Han Xing’s pupils shrank.
Wow!
Another Supreme Hidden Profession!
So, this is the power inheritance Barbaric God spoke of!
Han Xing couldn’t help but swallow.
This opportunity... is a bit terrifying!
At the same time, the teammates noticed the divine power seal lifted, realizing Han Xing’s success.
They raced towards Han Xing at full speed.
Seeing Han Xing unharmed, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong excitedly asked, "How was it, Brother Xing, did you get the stuff?"

chapters.title: Chapter 811 - 443: Two Supreme Hidden Professions_3
paragraphs: Han Xing nodded his head, "I got it."
After speaking, he directly handed the Earth Divine Format to Zhang Lianmeng.
Zhang Lianmeng took it with a look of joy on her face.
Other team members couldn’t help but marvel.
"It’s not easy, after going to so many places and dealing with so many races, we’ve finally collected the sixth Divine Format."
"Now, only the last Divine Format is missing, and Sister Lian Meng will be able to break through to demigod, becoming the legendary Supreme Hidden Profession!"
The team members were genuinely happy for Zhang Lianmeng.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed excitedly, "Brother Xing, let’s not delay and head directly to the Monsoon Islands to get the last Divine Format, right?"
However, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Don’t rush."
"Besides this Divine Format, I have something else. Take a look."
After speaking, Han Xing posted the [Inheritance Palace Key] to the team channel.
Upon seeing the item description, everyone’s pupils dilated, and there was a look of astonishment in their eyes.
"Oh my... Barbaric God! Another Supreme Hidden Profession?"
At this moment, everyone turned their gaze to Cheng Jianyong.
Clearly, as the only Strength Type Profession on the scene, the Supreme Hidden Profession of Barbaric God was undoubtedly meant for Cheng Jianyong.
And Cheng Jianyong realized this as well.
He said almost excitedly, "This is great!"
"I, Old Cheng, can finally change profession to a hidden profession!"
"Brother Xing, I love you so much!"
Cheng Jianyong was excitedly about to jump onto Han Xing.
However, Han Xing shook his head at this time and said, "Don’t get too happy too soon, this is just a quest item."
"We still need to go to the Void to find the Trial Palace of the Barbaric God and complete the trial before we can become the Supreme Hidden Profession."
"Moreover, this trial quest might be very difficult."
Cheng Jianyong said indifferently, "It’s okay, it’s just a trial, right?"
"No matter how hard it is, at least I have hope now!"
Han Xing nodded.
This journey to the Crystal Mountain had some twists and turns, but the final result satisfied everyone.
Not only did we successfully acquire the Earth Divine Format, but we also obtained the inheritance power of another Supreme Hidden Profession.
As for the final words said by those two beings, letting Han Xing choose.
Han Xing smiled.
Only kids make choices, of course, I want them all!
Those two definitely wouldn’t expect.
These two Supreme Hidden Professions weren’t prepared for himself.
His purpose wasn’t just to become a hidden profession!
Obviously, without Han Xing, there are few in the Holy Spirit Realm who could make it to the end.
After all, even an average high-tier demigod doesn’t have such strong Divine Power as Han Xing.
Even if they do, they haven’t completed the transcendence of Divine Power, making it impossible to reach the last few hundred meters of the zone.
Meanwhile.
The entire Crystal Mountain, all living beings felt that the Divine Power had vanished.
They simultaneously stood up, looking far in the direction where the Divine Format once exuded power.
"Roar... Roar..."
A series of deep roars came.
It was the Crystal Violent Bear race.
They seemed incredibly happy.
A problem that had troubled them for thousands of years had finally been resolved today.
How could they not be happy about that?
Han Xing looked at the distant Divine Demon Battleship and said, "Alright, let’s all return to the battleship."
"Prepare to teleport directly to the Monsoon Islands."
The team members heard this and nodded with smiles.
At the same time, a hint of anticipation appeared in their eyes.
They flew together towards the Divine Demon Battleship.
And just at this moment.
Han Xing suddenly sensed that something was amiss.
He gazed into a certain area in the distance beyond the Crystal Mountain.
In the next moment, Han Xing’s face suddenly changed.
He shouted, "Everyone, enter battle readiness, summon the Oracle Throne!"
"Xiaoyang, activate teleportation, target northwest direction, 600,000 kilometers away!
As soon as Han Xing finished speaking, everyone realized something was off and felt a chill in their hearts.
Although they didn’t know what happened, they almost instinctively chose to obey.
When under Su Xiaoyang’s feet, the Gem Throne appeared, then a white light enveloped everyone!
In the next moment, the figures of the five people vanished from where they stood.
When they reappeared, they were already in a region 600,000 kilometers away.
Just when everyone felt confused.
They suddenly saw a large area of black smoke appear before them.
Seeing this familiar technique.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "It’s the Shadow Legion’s method, have monsters appeared again?"
However, Han Xing didn’t speak.
Instead, he was watching that mass of black fog.
Different from what everyone expected.
No shadow monsters appeared inside.
But a man clad in black armor, enveloped in black fog, walked out.
Seeing that familiar figure, everyone exclaimed, "Shadow Monarch!"
Yes, that figure was the Shadow Monarch!
And Han Xing, it was because he sensed the opponent’s aura, he rushed over immediately.
Clearly, the Shadow Monarch also noticed Han Xing and his team, somewhat surprised, he said, "It’s you guys?"
"I was wondering about the Divine Power fluctuations at the Crystal Mountain, even the Saber-toothed Tigers I had meticulously set up have died in large numbers."
The last two times, the Shadow Monarch suffered heavy losses in Han Xing’s hands.
As a result, when he came to rescue the God of Tricks last time, the Shadow Monarch didn’t dare to make direct contact with Han Xing, opting instead to rescue and flee.
But today, the Shadow Monarch’s aura seemed to have undergone a subtle change.
Han Xing said somewhat surprised, "Shadow, you see me and don’t flee?"
The Shadow Monarch shook his head upon hearing this and said, "Flee? Why should I flee?"
Han Xing scrutinized the figure, and after a moment, he discovered the problem.
Compared to a year ago.
The Shadow Monarch’s strength had grown stronger, having risen from the original middle-tier demigod level to the high-tier demigod level.
Han Xing said with interest, "Interesting, you’ve actually broken through to high-tier demigod."
"Is this your confidence?"

Han Xing nodded.
This journey to the Crystal Mountain had some twists and turns, but the final result satisfied everyone.
Not only did we successfully acquire the Earth Divine Format, but we also obtained the inheritance power of another Supreme Hidden Profession.
As for the final words said by those two beings, letting Han Xing choose.
Han Xing smiled.
Only kids make choices, of course, I want them all!
Those two definitely wouldn’t expect.
These two Supreme Hidden Professions weren’t prepared for himself.
His purpose wasn’t just to become a hidden profession!
Obviously, without Han Xing, there are few in the Holy Spirit Realm who could make it to the end.
After all, even an average high-tier demigod doesn’t have such strong Divine Power as Han Xing.
Even if they do, they haven’t completed the transcendence of Divine Power, making it impossible to reach the last few hundred meters of the zone.
Meanwhile.
The entire Crystal Mountain, all living beings felt that the Divine Power had vanished.
They simultaneously stood up, looking far in the direction where the Divine Format once exuded power.
"Roar...
Roar..."
A series of deep roars came.
It was the Crystal Violent Bear race.
They seemed incredibly happy.
A problem that had troubled them for thousands of years had finally been resolved today.
How could they not be happy about that?
Han Xing looked at the distant Divine Demon Battleship and said, "Alright, let’s all return to the battleship."
"Prepare to teleport directly to the Monsoon Islands."
The team members heard this and nodded with smiles.
At the same time, a hint of anticipation appeared in their eyes.
They flew together towards the Divine Demon Battleship.
And just at this moment.
Han Xing suddenly sensed that something was amiss.
He gazed into a certain area in the distance beyond the Crystal Mountain.
In the next moment, Han Xing’s face suddenly changed.
He shouted, "Everyone, enter battle readiness, summon the Oracle Throne!"
"Xiaoyang, activate teleportation, target northwest direction, 600,000 kilometers away!
As soon as Han Xing finished speaking, everyone realized something was off and felt a chill in their hearts.
Although they didn’t know what happened, they almost instinctively chose to obey.
When under Su Xiaoyang’s feet, the Gem Throne appeared, then a white light enveloped everyone!
In the next moment, the figures of the five people vanished from where they stood.
When they reappeared, they were already in a region 600,000 kilometers away.
Just when everyone felt confused.
They suddenly saw a large area of black smoke appear before them.
Seeing this familiar technique.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "It’s the Shadow Legion’s method, have monsters appeared again?"
However, Han Xing didn’t speak.
Instead, he was watching that mass of black fog.
Different from what everyone expected.
No shadow monsters appeared inside.
But a man clad in black armor, enveloped in black fog, walked out.
Seeing that familiar figure, everyone exclaimed, "Shadow Monarch!"
Yes, that figure was the Shadow Monarch!
And Han Xing, it was because he sensed the opponent’s aura, he rushed over immediately.
Clearly, the Shadow Monarch also noticed Han Xing and his team, somewhat surprised, he said, "It’s you guys?"
"I was wondering about the Divine Power fluctuations at the Crystal Mountain, even the Saber-toothed Tigers I had meticulously set up have died in large numbers."
The last two times, the Shadow Monarch suffered heavy losses in Han Xing’s hands.
As a result, when he came to rescue the God of Tricks last time, the Shadow Monarch didn’t dare to make direct contact with Han Xing, opting instead to rescue and flee.
But today, the Shadow Monarch’s aura seemed to have undergone a subtle change.
Han Xing said somewhat surprised, "Shadow, you see me and don’t flee?"
The Shadow Monarch shook his head upon hearing this and said, "Flee?
Why should I flee?"
Han Xing scrutinized the figure, and after a moment, he discovered the problem.
Compared to a year ago.
The Shadow Monarch’s strength had grown stronger, having risen from the original middle-tier demigod level to the high-tier demigod level.
Han Xing said with interest, "Interesting, you’ve actually broken through to high-tier demigod."
"Is this your confidence?"

chapters.title: Chapter 812 - 444: The Collapse of the Shadow Monarch
paragraphs: Han Xing laughed, "Dark Shadow, do you really think that just because you’ve broken through to a High-tier Demigod, you can deal with us?"
The Shadow Monarch chuckled, "Can’t I?"
"I know you have some skills, you almost killed Trick."
"But don’t think I don’t know, your power relies on that High-tier Defense Tower on Sky Island."
"This time, you didn’t even bring the Sky Island. Just you few legends think you can deal with me?"
At this moment, the team members exchanged glances without speaking.
Looking at the Shadow Monarch, they all had expressions as if they were looking at a fool.
The Shadow Monarch laughed, "Have you realized it?"
"Master of the Human Race, let me teach you a lesson."
"The power you gain from external objects is ultimately not your own."
"Only when those forces are transformed into your own might is it the only true way!"
As he finished speaking, the Shadow Monarch’s divine power surged.
He slowly extended his withered arm.
It seemed like he wanted to recreate the scene from the Witch Race Territory, crushing everyone to pieces directly!
However, when he clenched his fist hard.
The humans were still standing there, looking at him somewhat confusedly.
The Shadow Monarch’s hand in mid-air felt a bit awkward.
A moment later, he snorted coldly, "It seems I just broke through to a High-tier Demigod and am not used to this power yet."
"Then, let’s try again!"
With those words, the Shadow Monarch extended his arm again, gripping fiercely!
"Buzz!"
The divine power surged, stirring the hair of the crowd.
But Han Xing and the others still stood their ground, not moving an inch!
"Impossible!"
The Shadow Monarch was terrified!
"I am a High-tier Demigod! How can you mere beings with only legendary power block my attack?"
Having said that, a black great sword appeared in the Shadow Monarch’s hand.
He directly slashed at the group with the sword!
"I don’t believe you can block it again!"
A strike from a High-tier Demigod was still very strong.
The Shadow Monarch believed that this sword would definitely cut this group of humans in two.
And at this moment, Shen Yun’s figure suddenly appeared, holding a gray shield, abruptly blocking in front of the Shadow Monarch.
Clang!
After a heavy sound, the Shadow Monarch was surprised to find that his sword hadn’t caused any harm to this human!
This guy has such strong defense!
When the Shadow Monarch wanted to raise the great sword and strike at Shen Yun again.
"Dark Shadow, have you had enough fun?"
Han Xing’s calm voice floated over.
However, this sentence made a sense of humiliation rise in the Shadow Monarch’s heart.
Fun?
I’ve been trying with all my strength, who’s playing with you?
Han Xing shook his head.
The next moment, he directly declared, "Restrain him."
The team members understood in an instant and unleashed various control skills!
"Whoosh!"
"Crash!"
The Shadow Monarch was immediately entangled by countless vines, as if trapped in a quagmire.
His eyes showed astonishment.
After the initial panic, the Shadow Monarch quickly regained his composure.
He swung his longsword forcefully, cutting the vines one by one!
At this time, Han Xing asked, "Where is that woman?"
The Shadow Monarch completely ignored Han Xing’s words.
However, as Zhang Lianmeng’s Ice Cone Technique continuously shot out, the terrifying icy aura enveloped him, the Shadow Monarch felt his mobility was greatly reduced.
Han Xing spoke again, "I’ll ask you again, where is that woman?"
"Otherwise, if we resort to extreme measures, we won’t be able to hold back."
Even though they could defeat a High-tier Demigod with their current power,
it was clearly impossible to capture him alive like that Saber-toothed Tiger.
By then, Han Xing’s burst might directly annihilate the Shadow Monarch.
However, the Shadow Monarch still refused to answer.
Han Xing sighed, "Forget it, then I’ll take you down first, then I’ll go find that woman."
As he said this, Han Xing drew the bowstring.
"Take me down? You do..."
Before he could finish, a crescent moon suddenly appeared behind the Shadow Monarch.
At that instant, when the crescent moon appeared, the Shadow Monarch felt a fierce sealing power.
His movements were instantly sealed!
Even more terrifying, the Shadow Monarch discovered that even space was frozen!
The crescent moon appeared for less than half a second, and the Shadow Monarch was completely sealed inside.
Han Xing said, "Finish him off!"
Though until now, they didn’t know the Shadow Monarch’s purpose.
But since he was following that woman, he must not be up to any good.
Now that there was an opportunity, they might as well finish him off directly.
Hearing this, everyone didn’t hold back.
Various attacks were launched simultaneously.
It’s imaginable that once the Shattered Moon’s control skill ended, the Shadow Monarch would undoubtedly die!
And at this moment.
The Shadow Monarch, trapped in the crescent moon, also felt a crisis of death.
Although he couldn’t move now, his mind was still clear.
He realized that if he couldn’t escape this situation, he would probably fall here, fall into the hands of these humans!
At the edge of life and death, a determined look appeared in the Shadow Monarch’s eyes.
The next moment, from the Shadow Monarch’s body, a strong black aura surged out.
This black aura, just like the one they encountered before, could block most of the damage.
Their attacks sank like stones in the sea, disappearing without a trace.
Han Xing clearly felt the Shadow Monarch’s aura dissipating.
He frowned, "Increase the attack rhythm."
As he spoke, Han Xing had already fired the Sun-Destroying Arrow, causing the Shattered Moon Skill to explode together.
