chapters.title: Chapter 813 - 444: The Collapse of the Shadow Monarch (2)
paragraphs: Plus the other team members’ attacks.
Boom!
After a strong explosion.
That area experienced a terrifying energy vibration.
Even the Crystal Violent Bear Race, located tens of thousands of miles away, felt a tremor in their hearts.
It’s imaginable that any ordinary High-tier Demigod would be severely injured if not killed by such a concentrated attack.
After a wave of attack, everyone stopped and stood where they were.
They all stared at the black mist.
That place had been blasted into a void region by everyone’s attacks, and due to the chaotic energy, none of them could see inside.
However, when the black mist dispersed, the Shadow Monarch was nowhere to be found.
Han Xing shook his head in disappointment, "Did this guy manage to run away?"
The team members also felt quite frustrated.
Cheng Jianyong complained, "This Shadow Monarch is really hard to kill; he can escape even under these circumstances."
Han Xing nodded and said, "This guy indeed has many secrets on him."
"But never mind, since he ran away, we’ll leave him be. We’ll stick to the original plan and head to the Monsoon Islands."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
The escape of the Shadow Monarch no longer felt regrettable.
After all, compared to Zhang Lianmeng’s upcoming breakthrough to Demigod, what’s a Shadow Monarch?
"Buzz buzz!"
In the distance, the Divine Demon Battleship had already actively flown over.
Before using the Oracle Throne to teleport over to deal with the Shadow Monarch.
Han Xing had set the Divine Demon Battleship to follow them.
But since the battleship was in automatic mode.
It took some time to catch up.
Looking at the enormous silhouette of the battleship not far away.
They flashed together and returned to the top of the Divine Demon Battleship.
As for this area, they also sensed the presence of many Demonized Saber-toothed Tigers, and their strength was formidable.
But all of this had nothing to do with Han Xing.
He directly activated the teleportation function of the battleship.
"Initiating battleship teleportation mode."
"Countdown: Five seconds..."
"Five..."
"Four..."
When the countdown ended, the enormous battleship instantly vanished from its location.
A strong spatial fluctuation appeared.
Everyone entered that magical teleportation state again, surrounded by countless black-and-white lines.
A few seconds later, all the black-and-white lines disappeared.
And they had already left the Crystal Mountain area.
"This teleportation function is really terrifying!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Even after experiencing it many times, crossing over ten million kilometers instantly still left everyone in awe.
Han Xing thought aloud, "We’re still several billion kilometers away from the Monsoon Islands, which means we need to teleport seven or eight more times to reach it."
Thinking of this, Han Xing didn’t hesitate and let the battleship move forward at maximum power.
"Buzz!"
"Buzz!"
Every five hundred seconds, the Divine Demon Battleship performed an ultra-long-distance teleportation.
Thanks to its energy core being a Demon God’s heart, it had the ability to automatically absorb Heaven and Earth Energy.
Otherwise, according to the law of energy conservation, this level of teleportation energy would definitely consume a lot of Spirit Cores.
By then, not even Han Xing’s wealth could afford such unrestrained teleportation.
Time passed, and two hours later.
The scene before everyone changed again.
From vast wastelands, they arrived at a place roaring with wild winds.
In front of them, thousands upon thousands of mountains, tens of thousands of meters tall, could be seen.
Occasionally, groups of purple-red winged figures floated by.
"Caw... Caw..."
Shrill screams constantly echoed around them.
The large birds were advancing against the howling wind.
System prompt appeared.
[You have discovered a new area: Monsoon Islands, World Influence +728, Legendary Points +5]
Everyone’s faces showed an excited expression.
"We’ve finally arrived, at the place where the last Divine Format is located."
Shen Yun looked at the large birds flying against the wind in the distance and asked, "Brother Xing, are those big birds the creatures within the Monsoon Islands?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, those birds are called Omaya, a very ferocious species."
Shen Yun was surprised, "Ferocious?"
Han Xing nodded, "Exactly, they have extremely strong territorial awareness and will drive out all outsiders from their territory."
"The entire Monsoon Islands belong to the Omaya."
Shen Yun frowned, "So, these Omaya cannot be communicated with?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, the Omaya Race is even more closed off than the Crystal Violent Bears, refusing to communicate with any civilization and will tear apart any enemy."
Upon hearing this, everyone fell into contemplation.
"It’s a bit troublesome to deal with creatures that cannot be communicated with..."
Han Xing shook his head and said,
"Forget it, let’s just proceed, although Omaya is a fierce bird, there are quite a few strong individuals in this group."
"There should still be communicable creatures."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
They together stepped into the region of the Monsoon Plains.
At the same time, as they approached, they felt a strong wind force appear.
Whoosh—Whoosh—
Roaring wind sounds echoed in their ears.
Everyone knew this was the effect caused by the Wind Divine Format, the closer to the Divine Format’s location, the stronger the wind force became.
And, aside from the howling wind.
They also saw in the distance massive towering peaks floating in mid-air like sharp tips.
Immense winged figures, covering the sky and sun, perched on the mountains, occasionally emitting piercing explosive sounds.

chapters.title: Chapter 814 - 444: The Collapse of the Shadow Monarch (Part 3)
paragraphs: "Screech!!"
Not long after Han Xing and the others moved forward, those massive figures noticed them.
Several Omaya flapped their wings and flew out from those spire-like mountains.
And then swiftly headed towards Han Xing and the others.
Soon, several creatures with huge fleshy wings appeared in front of everyone, marked with red and green stripes, resembling mutated winged dragons.
The sharp long beaks, claws gleaming with cold light, and those bird-like eyes filled with murderous intent.
From their appearance alone, it was clear that this was an extremely ferocious creature.
At this moment, those Omaya sensed the aura from the group, and immediately emitted a sharp shriek.
"Screech!"
In the next moment, without any pause, they charged towards Han Xing and the others.
Cheng Jianyong was startled in his heart, "Damn, so aggressive?"
These Omaya, at most, had only the strength of a Five-star Elite Level, yet they dared to initiate an attack against their group of Legends.
Truly filled with ferocity.
Han Xing, seeing the Omaya charging, did not attack.
Instead, he tried to release divine power to communicate with them.
However, these monstrous birds ignored it, directly charging madly towards the group.
They tried to extend their claws, to tear apart the flesh of these humans,
At this moment, the group of Omaya discovered that they seemed to have caught an invisible energy shield.
Their attacks landed on it, causing no effect at all.
Yet, this group of Omaya persisted, continuously scratching with their claws, attacking the Divine Power Shield with their beaks.
"Hiss! Hiss hiss!"
Those Omaya emitted anxious cries.
Han Xing still did not attack, but maintained the Divine Power Shield, resisting the attacks of these Omaya.
After all, relying on the strength of these Omaya, they couldn’t even break their defense.
However, the group of Omaya continued their relentless assault on them.
Cheng Jianyong frowned, then asked, "Brother Xing, did the communication succeed?"
Han Xing shook his head, "No, this group of Omaya completely rejected communication."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong said, "Why don’t we just ignore these guys, grab the Divine Format and leave?
Han Xing pondered for a moment, and after trying again, nodded and said, "Let’s go, head straight to the depths of the Monsoon Islands."
With those words, everyone proceeded together towards the depths.
However, this action seemed to completely stir up the Omaya.
They opened their terrifying mouths, crazily lunging, as if trying to swallow everyone along with the Divine Power Shield.
"Gah!"
Seeing this scene, everyone was shocked in their hearts.
Because looking at the size of these Omaya, they truly might be able to accomplish it.
The thought of being swallowed by such monstrous birds sent chills down everyone’s spine.
And at the moment these Omaya lunged, Cheng Jianyong instinctively slashed out a Sword Qi.
"Swish!"
"Puff!"
Blood flowers burst forth.
The bodies of these Omaya were all sliced into two pieces, falling down from the sky.
However, Cheng Jianyong’s action was like poking a hornet’s nest.
In an instant, hundreds of thousands, even millions of Omaya flew out from the nearby Sky Islands!
Their figures varied in size.
The smaller ones were five or six meters, while the larger ones reached over a hundred meters!
They ranged from Four-star Elite Monsters to Five-star Legends.
Millions of Omaya, like tides, flew towards them.
"Whoosh!"
The Monsoon Islands were already constantly filled with the sound of whistling wind.
Now, with the fluttering sounds of so many Omaya wings, it felt incredibly chaotic.
Their avian pupils emitted a compelling glow.
At this moment, Han Xing sensed a few colossal creatures over a kilometer in size, exuding ferocious momentum.
Those were a few Legendary Level Omaya.
Han Xing continued to release divine power, attempting to communicate.
But clearly, he still failed.
Neither the Monsoon Islands nor the Crystal Mountain sent strong support to aid the Elf Race.
But Crystal Mountain was due to inter-racial conflicts, and the group of Crystal Violent Bears was unaware of the events happening outside.
Yet the Monsoon Islands seemed more like a Barbaric Wilderness, where those Omaya with Legendary Level strength showed no desire for communication.
They acted entirely on their innate instincts.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing knew that the final hope was also shattered.
He sighed and said, "Take action, charge through and take the Wind Divine Format."
Everyone nodded.
Though many Omaya were charging, creating a somewhat shocking scene.
However, the group was long accustomed to various grand scenarios, and these Omaya couldn’t stir any emotional ripple within them.
Meanwhile, Zhang Lianmeng slowly raised her Magic Staff.
A large amount of Power of Elements in the air was instantly aroused.
Zhang Lianmeng directly initiated with a Meteor Technique,
In the sky, a meteorite over ten thousand meters in diameter, burning with flames, descended straight down.
The area seemed as if a nuclear bomb was dropped.
The terrifying impact immediately crushed tens of thousands of Omaya bodies!
Red and green fluids splattered.
Next was Cheng Jianyong.
He actively charged into the midst of Omaya, wielding the Divine Artifact Sword, slaughtering madly.
"Swish! Swish swish!"
Sword Qi sliced through.
Bodies of Omaya like paper, directly slashed by him, then fell towards mid-air.
At this moment, Han Xing released Coal Ball.
Coal Ball, as per usual, entered the Escape into the Void state the moment it appeared.
Next moment.
Coal Ball appeared silently beside a Legendary Level Omaya.
"Swish! Swish!"
After several claw strikes.
The Legendary Omaya suddenly saw blood marks appearing within its body.

sentences.text: "Screech!!"
Not long after Han Xing and the others moved forward, those massive figures noticed them.
Several Omaya flapped their wings and flew out from those spire-like mountains.
And then swiftly headed towards Han Xing and the others.
Soon, several creatures with huge fleshy wings appeared in front of everyone, marked with red and green stripes, resembling mutated winged dragons.
The sharp long beaks, claws gleaming with cold light, and those bird-like eyes filled with murderous intent.
From their appearance alone, it was clear that this was an extremely ferocious creature.
At this moment, those Omaya sensed the aura from the group, and immediately emitted a sharp shriek.
"Screech!"
In the next moment, without any pause, they charged towards Han Xing and the others.
Cheng Jianyong was startled in his heart, "Damn, so aggressive?"
These Omaya, at most, had only the strength of a Five-star Elite Level, yet they dared to initiate an attack against their group of Legends.
Truly filled with ferocity.
Han Xing, seeing the Omaya charging, did not attack.
Instead, he tried to release divine power to communicate with them.
However, these monstrous birds ignored it, directly charging madly towards the group.
They tried to extend their claws, to tear apart the flesh of these humans,
At this moment, the group of Omaya discovered that they seemed to have caught an invisible energy shield.
Their attacks landed on it, causing no effect at all.
Yet, this group of Omaya persisted, continuously scratching with their claws, attacking the Divine Power Shield with their beaks.
"Hiss!
Hiss hiss!"
Those Omaya emitted anxious cries.
Han Xing still did not attack, but maintained the Divine Power Shield, resisting the attacks of these Omaya.
After all, relying on the strength of these Omaya, they couldn’t even break their defense.
However, the group of Omaya continued their relentless assault on them.
Cheng Jianyong frowned, then asked, "Brother Xing, did the communication succeed?"
Han Xing shook his head, "No, this group of Omaya completely rejected communication."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong said, "Why don’t we just ignore these guys, grab the Divine Format and leave?
Han Xing pondered for a moment, and after trying again, nodded and said, "Let’s go, head straight to the depths of the Monsoon Islands."
With those words, everyone proceeded together towards the depths.
However, this action seemed to completely stir up the Omaya.
They opened their terrifying mouths, crazily lunging, as if trying to swallow everyone along with the Divine Power Shield.
"Gah!"
Seeing this scene, everyone was shocked in their hearts.
Because looking at the size of these Omaya, they truly might be able to accomplish it.
The thought of being swallowed by such monstrous birds sent chills down everyone’s spine.
And at the moment these Omaya lunged, Cheng Jianyong instinctively slashed out a Sword Qi.
"Swish!"
"Puff!"
Blood flowers burst forth.
The bodies of these Omaya were all sliced into two pieces, falling down from the sky.
However, Cheng Jianyong’s action was like poking a hornet’s nest.
In an instant, hundreds of thousands, even millions of Omaya flew out from the nearby Sky Islands!
Their figures varied in size.
The smaller ones were five or six meters, while the larger ones reached over a hundred meters!
They ranged from Four-star Elite Monsters to Five-star Legends.
Millions of Omaya, like tides, flew towards them.
"Whoosh!"
The Monsoon Islands were already constantly filled with the sound of whistling wind.
Now, with the fluttering sounds of so many Omaya wings, it felt incredibly chaotic.
Their avian pupils emitted a compelling glow.
At this moment, Han Xing sensed a few colossal creatures over a kilometer in size, exuding ferocious momentum.
Those were a few Legendary Level Omaya.
Han Xing continued to release divine power, attempting to communicate.
But clearly, he still failed.
Neither the Monsoon Islands nor the Crystal Mountain sent strong support to aid the Elf Race.
But Crystal Mountain was due to inter-racial conflicts, and the group of Crystal Violent Bears was unaware of the events happening outside.
Yet the Monsoon Islands seemed more like a Barbaric Wilderness, where those Omaya with Legendary Level strength showed no desire for communication.
They acted entirely on their innate instincts.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing knew that the final hope was also shattered.
He sighed and said, "Take action, charge through and take the Wind Divine Format."
Everyone nodded.
Though many Omaya were charging, creating a somewhat shocking scene.
However, the group was long accustomed to various grand scenarios, and these Omaya couldn’t stir any emotional ripple within them.

A large amount of Power of Elements in the air was instantly aroused.

Next moment.

"Swish!
Swish!"
After several claw strikes.
The Legendary Omaya suddenly saw blood marks appearing within its body.

chapters.title: Chapter 815 - 445: Subjugating Omaya
paragraphs: When it was still unaware, waves of sharp pain appeared.
"Poof!"
Blood splattered, this Legendary Level Omaya was instantly killed by Coal Ball.
It didn’t even see clearly who its enemy was.
Next, such eerie scenes kept occurring.
Each Omaya clearly didn’t sense any enemy around.
Yet their bodies suddenly displayed blood streaks, by the time they reacted, they’d already been torn into pieces.
The notifications of Omaya killings kept coming.
Han Xing did not stop; once he decided to act, there would be no respite.
"Boom!"
"Poof, poof, poof!"
Omayas were killed in large numbers.
Three minutes later.
This batch of over a million Omaya was completely annihilated by Han Xing and his team.
Meanwhile.
From afar, more Omaya launched from mountain peaks in droves.
They didn’t feel terror due to their companions’ deaths, but rather, it inflamed their desire to kill.
More Omaya charged towards Han Xing and his team.
Seeing this, Han Xing said, "Let’s get on the battleship, let’s charge directly ahead."
The group nodded in agreement.
Then, together they rushed onto the deck of the Divine Demon Battleship.
At this moment, Han Xing set the battleship to full-auto mode, targeting the strongest wind area of the Monsoon Islands.
"Buzz!"
The Demon God’s Heart was activated at full power,
The battleship transformed into a light streak, rushing forward.
"Splash!"
A large group of Omaya appeared head-on.
Seemingly about to collide with the battleship.
The five members attacked simultaneously.
"Whip!"
"Kaboom!"
After a terrifying energy surge.
This group of Omaya was torn apart by everyone’s attack.
The battleship didn’t pause at all, continuing to dash forward.
Under terrifying acceleration, every Omaya brushed by the battleship had their flesh body shattered instantly.
Even Legendary Level Omaya would be gravely injured.
However, the Defense Value of the battleship didn’t decrease much.
Han Xing’s eyes sparkled with delight.
He thought that hitting those Omaya would damage the battleship’s hull.
Now it seems, although there was some damage, it wasn’t as severe as Han Xing expected.
This Divine Demon Battleship consumed a vast amount of resources, and was the most expensive construction Han Xing had ever built.
And likewise, high input brought high returns.
This battleship not only possesses formidable Attack Power but its Defense is also remarkable.
"Whoosh!"
With the speed of an arrow loosed, the Divine Demon Battleship surged into the depths of the Monsoon Islands.
All around, dense groups of Omaya flew in.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "Jeez... the number of this group is enormous!"
"This is just the outer edge of the Monsoon Islands, and yet we’ve encountered so many big birds."
"Judging by the size of the Monsoon Islands, the number of Omaya here might not be fewer than the large tribes in the Holy Spirit Realm."
The group nodded collectively.
The large tribes Cheng Jianyong spoke of were, of course, the Beastman Kingdom, Ogre Kingdom, and similar forces,
These large tribes have populations in the tens of billions, quite massive.
The sheer number of the Omaya tribe truly exceeded everyone’s expectations.
However, regardless, Han Xing and his crew wouldn’t show any mercy.
"Keep moving forward!"
Buzz!
The Divine Demon Battleship bullheadedly tore a path through the overwhelming hoards of Omaya monsters.
With its High-tier Demigod Level Movement Speed, the Omaya here couldn’t catch up to them.
Swarms of large birds were left behind.
They traversed peak after peak shaped like bamboo shoots.
Ahead Omaya kept flying up to intercept the team.
Whenever this happened, the team would unleash a concentrated attack.
"Boom!"
Large numbers of Omaya were blasted away by the team, these terrifyingly shaped birds couldn’t halt them for even a second.
A dozen minutes later, Han Xing and crew had crossed over a million kilometers.
Here, they were already in the center region of the Monsoon Islands.
From ahead, terrifying winds appeared, even the battleship’s speed was compelled to slow down.
"Hoo—hoo—"
"Oh my... so exaggerated..."
Cheng Jianyong swallowed and gazed at the scene ahead in awe.
All the other team members also stood still.
They saw, at the very center of the Monsoon Islands, there was a colossal Storm Corps!
The diameter of that Storm Corps wasn’t less than tens of thousands of kilometers!
They were on the outskirts, already feeling they might be swept away by the terrifying whirlwind!
Yet, with their current power, they could effortlessly withstand the wind force.
Including those Omaya birds, living in the Monsoon Islands year-round, they had long adapted to the terrifying wind here.
Around, there were even many Omaya speeding towards the team with the help of wind.
Only those at least possessing Tier Five Dominator Level strength could perform airborne here.
"A large group of Omaya behind the battleship, be cautious."
Upon Han Xing’s words, the team immediately recalibrated their firepower angle.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang entered a state of High Altitude Flight, with extreme speed.
She instantly reached the stern, her back straight, pulling the bowstring in a perfectly standard archery posture.
The arrow tip unleashed dazzling green light.
Under the roar of the gale, even her silhouette looked like a Saintess of salvation from the apocalypse.
However, her arrows weren’t born for salvation, but to slay enemies.

chapters.title: Chapter 816 - 445: Subjugating Omaya (Part 2)
paragraphs: "Whoosh! Whoosh whoosh!"
Arrows shot out one by one, each able to precisely hit the head of an Omeia.
"Puff! Puff puff puff puff!"
Even though Su Xiaoyang didn’t possess Han Xing’s [Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill] for mindless bombardment, she had the [Elf’s Eye] and a series of Archer skills to enhance her accuracy.
Furthermore, the terrifying attack speed at Legendary Level.
As a Hunter profession least adept at handling mobs, at this moment she could single-handedly face an army!
"Wow! Little Sister Xiaoyang is really impressive!"
Zhang Lianmeng, who originally intended to help, sincerely praised after seeing that Su Xiaoyang’s side was unaffected.
Han Xing nodded, continuing to maneuver the battleship, charging towards the center of the Storm Corps.
Omeia coming from all directions were easily taken care of by everyone.
After advancing tens of thousands of kilometers further.
The wind’s intensity abruptly increased several folds.
The strong winds even started causing the massive Demon God Battleship to sway.
Here lay the endurance limit for those Omera.
Even the Legendary Level Omera couldn’t withstand such terrifying winds to pursue the group.
Cheng Jianyong looked at the back, that crowd repeatedly attempting to come over but being blown away by the fierce winds, laughing loudly.
"Hahaha! A bunch of silly birds, and you think you can chase after me?"
"Can’t come over, can you?"
Cheng Jianyong stood on the deck, making faces at the Omera bird flock behind.
With the eyesight of those Omera, they could clearly see his actions.
Feeling Cheng Jianyong’s provocation, this group of Omeia appeared extremely angry, each almost rushing in recklessly, like moths to a flame.
"Caw! Caw!!!"
A group of Omeia formed a goose-shaped V formation, approaching at an incredibly fast speed.
Seeing this, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed: "Damn! Are these silly birds so fierce?
He instinctively lifted his weapon, preparing to attack.
However, the wind here was just too strong; even if those Omeia formed a formation, they couldn’t last more than three seconds, getting blown away immediately.
Cheng Jianyong breathed a sigh of relief, indicating he was startled for nothing.
At this moment, Han Xing’s voice resonated from behind, "Cheng Jianyong, come back."
Cheng Jianyong hadn’t realized anything yet.
While suddenly feeling a vast shadow above his head.
He lifted his head, witnessing a colossal entity with wings measuring tens of thousands of meters, descending swiftly from the sky.
"Whoosh! Whoosh!"
The huge wings flapping could actually rival the roaring storm here!
Meanwhile, this Omeia’s attributes appeared before everyone.
[Mother of Omeia]: Middle-tier Demigod Level
[Level]: Level 66
[Attributes]: Power 134821, Agility 157621, Spirit 128313, Constitution 115230.
[Skills]: Hurricane Body, Core of the Storm, Bird Attack, Omaya Domain, Ultimate Skill—Tearing Heaven and Earth
[Divine Power Value]: 13024
A Middle-tier Demigod Level existence!
Everyone was shocked.
This Omeia was staring at them with a savage gaze.
Its size that could rival a battleship, Han Xing and others seemed like insignificant bugs before it.
"There’s actually a Demigod-level Omeia?"
Han Xing was a bit surprised.
He thought the most there could be here were Legendary-level Omeia.
Demigod-level should be unlike those Legendary Omeia right?
Moreover, this Omeia didn’t launch an attack immediately on them. It appeared to be a communicable existence?
With this thought, Han Xing tried to send out a divine power ripple to the other side.
"I am the current Master of the Human Race, can we talk?"
Moments later, Han Xing received a wave of intent.
"Human Race? Why have you come to my Monsoon Islands, slaughtering my kin?"
Han Xing froze for a moment, then replied helplessly: "It’s not us wanting to kill your kin; your kin attacked us first, leaving us no choice but to fight back."
The Omeia emitted an angry screech upon hearing.
"You lie! It’s because you invaded our territory that my kin attacked you!"
Han Xing furrowed his brows but patiently said: "I did try to communicate with your kin, but they refused to engage and launched an attack directly."
"As for the invasion you mentioned, in the Holy Spirit Realm, a clan leader visiting another tribe doesn’t count as an invasion."
The Omeia continued angrily: "I’ve told you before! That area is their hunting ground, your entry is an invasion!"
"External rules don’t apply in our Monsoon Islands; here, once you enter the hunting ground, you become our prey!"
Hearing this, Han Xing realized this entity was just the same, impossible to communicate with.
Thus, Han Xing simply stated: "If you say so, then let it be."
"I don’t want to argue these matters with you."
"Since you can communicate, I’ll tell you my objective."
"I’m here to take the divine format from Monsoon Islands."
Upon hearing this, the Demigod-level Omeia grew even angrier!
"Not only did you target my kin, but you want to take our divine format?"
"In your dreams!"
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but say beside him: "Damn, these damn birds all have the same traits, stupid and stubborn, can’t understand human language at all!"
Upon hearing Cheng Jianyong’s insult, the Demigod bird instantly turned its head.
Its enormous bird head locked onto Cheng Jianyong.
It emitted a furious screech.
"Caw!! Human, you dare insult the Omeia race, I will tear you and your comrades apart to feed my children!"

chapters.title: Chapter 817 - 445: Subjugating Omaya (Part 3)
paragraphs: A voice dropped, and this Omeia had already charged in.
Of course, Han Xing and the others knew that this Omeia thought they only had the aura of a legend and would be easy to handle, so it was trying to strike first.
But obviously, Han Xing wouldn’t put up with it.
"Take action."
The moment Han Xing finished speaking, the team’s attacks simultaneously burst forth.
Su Xiaoyang’s arrow was the fastest, piercing Omeia’s body in an instant.
Then came Zhang Lianmeng’s meteorite and Han Xing’s Gale·Break.
This was a combined strike by everyone.
It’s known that even a high-tier Demigod like the Shadow Monarch, when faced with their siege, was forced to use escape tactics and almost got instant-killed.
Replacing it with a middle-tier Demigod like Omeia, there was simply no chance to resist at all.
When a few attacks landed, fear appeared in the avian eyes of this Omeia.
It severely underestimated the strength of these humans, shouting angrily.
"You guys aren’t legends at all!"
"Tweet!!"
Thud!
The five attacks descended directly, covering this Demigod-level Omeia’s body.
After a terrifying wave of energy.
In the sky, a plume of thick tail smoke appeared, resembling a crashed airplane.
In the last moments, Han Xing held back and didn’t actually kill this Omeia.
Because he had other motives.
At this moment, this Demigod-level Omeia regained consciousness, hurriedly stabilized its position, and floated weakly in the air.
However, deep fear had appeared in its eyes.
It knew clearly it almost got instant-killed by these humans!
Having passed through the ghost’s gate directly, this made the Omeia look at Han Xing with fear.
Han Xing looked at the dying Omeira on the ground and asked, "Want to live or die?"
At this moment, this Omeira still appeared very unyielding.
It glared and said, "Of course I want to live!
Han Xing nodded and then threw a yellowed scroll toward Omeira.
"Two choices, either sign the contract or die."
Seeing this scroll, the Demigod Omeia’s eyes widened, "You actually want to enslave me?"
Han Xing nodded, "Creatures like you, even if you obey now, secretly probably won’t comply."
"So, making you sign a contract is the simplest and most direct method."
Hesitation flashed in this Demigod Omeia’s eyes.
Han Xing continued, "I think the Elf Race should have delivered the message to you, but you rejected it."
"Now, the demons of the Abyss Realm are invading in great numbers, and every creature in the Holy Spirit Realm has a duty to defend."
"So, as the price for sparing your life, you now take half of the Omeia army to the Elf Race to join the battle."
Yet, the Demigod-level Omeia still said unyieldingly, "Why should I help the Elf Race?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing raised an eyebrow, his gaze flashing with killing intent.
"Are you saying you are unwilling?"
The Demigod-level Omeira angrily said, "Our tribe has never left the Monsoon Islands; this has been an Omeira clan rule for thousands of years!"
"You asking me to break this rule is worse than letting me die!"
Han Xing heard and glanced at it, saying, "Alright, I respect your choice."
As his words fell, he drew his bowstring,
his heart already filled with killing intent.
In the war against the Abyss Realm, a middle-tier Demigod couldn’t change much of the situation,
What Han Xing valued was this guy’s ability to command other Omeia.
In the Monsoon Islands, the number of Omeia is also a powerful force.
However, since it chooses to rather die than obey, Han Xing will also fulfill this Omeia’s wish.
Just as Han Xing prepared to instant-kill the opponent.
This Omeia suddenly exclaimed, "I’ll sign!"
Han Xing was slightly stunned, his hand about to draw the bowstring also stopping in mid-air.
"You damn?
If it had said that one second later, Han Xing would have already directly eliminated the opponent.
At this moment, Omeia still had a face full of defiance.
Han Xing felt very speechless.
Are all these guys this troublesome?
Both fearful of death and unwilling to give up the dignity in their hearts.
However, ultimately, this Omeia still signed the contract with Han Xing.
[Successfully signed the contract, Mother of Omeia: Demigod-level creature has joined your camp, Camp Fortune Value +5000.]
After the prompt ended.
The ferocity in Omeia’s eyes faded, and the gaze toward Han Xing carried a hint of complexity and apology.
"Mas... Master..."
Calling someone like this for the first time seemed to make it feel very uncomfortable, its birdface blushing.
Han Xing’s gaze was strange, but he still nodded and said, "Tell me, how many are there in your Omeia clan?"
Upon hearing this, the Mother of Omeia reported the number of strong warriors in the clan.
Han Xing listened and nodded.
Throughout the Monsoon Islands, all Omeia had numbers reaching tens of billions.
Besides this Demigod-level Omeia, the Monsoon Islands had one Initial-tier Demigod-level Omeia.
This was their peak power.
The Omeia clan didn’t have many Demigod-level numbers, but there were plenty of Legendary-level Omeira.
From Initial-stage Legend to High-tier Legend Omeia, numbering over a thousand.
This was even more than some large clans in terms of Legendary powerhouses.
If Han Xing’s Camp Fortune Value wasn’t full, he would want to contract all these Omeia and bring them into his camp.
But now, just signing a contract with this Mother of Omeia was sufficient.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Like I told you before."
"Now the Elf Race is facing an invasion from the Abyss Realm, and it requires the entire Holy Spirit Realm to unite to possibly withstand this crisis."
"Go convey the message; after I come back, lead half of the Legendary Omeia to wait here for me."
"Understood?"

chapters.title: Chapter 818 - 446: Gathering the Seven Elements Divine Format
paragraphs: Upon hearing Han Xing’s command, the demigod-level Omaya seemed a bit hesitant.
However, under the influence of the Lord Contract, it still nodded respectfully.
A ripple of divine power swept through.
"Yes, master."
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction, finding it convenient to sign contracts.
No matter how unruly these creatures are, once the contract is signed, they become fully compliant.
His plan was to use the Divine Demon Battleship to take a batch of these Omaya to the Elf Race first.
After all, the Monsoon Islands are too far from the Elf Realm.
With the traveling speed of this group of Omaya, it would take them at least several months to get there.
By that time, the war in the Abyss Realm might have been over.
After finishing these tasks.
Han Xing continued to maneuver the Divine Demon Battleship, charging toward the terrifying hurricane storm ahead.
A few minutes later,
everyone found themselves completely engulfed within the storm.
The sky above turned dark, with no sign of sunlight.
Within the hurricane, countless Sky Island fragments and some hard objects were carried along.
Driven by the high-speed wind, these Sky Island fragments possessed extremely strong lethality, making it impossible for creatures below tier five to reach this position.
Due to its enormous size, the Divine Demon Battleship was instantly hit by thousands of fragments.
Seeing the dents and pits on the ship’s hull, Han Xing felt a pang of heartache.
Building a Divine Demon Battleship was already extremely challenging.
Repairing it would require quite a lot of materials as well.
With that in mind,
Han Xing said directly, "Let’s leave the Divine Demon Battleship outside and go in ourselves."
"If we go any further, the Divine Demon Battleship will be completely destroyed."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
They knew they couldn’t continue like this.
In a flash, the five figures left the warship’s control room and appeared in midair.
After leaving the warship, they summoned the Oracle Throne.
Meanwhile, under Han Xing’s command, the Divine Demon Battleship sailed away from the hurricane storm.
Before long, it disappeared from everyone’s sight.
At this moment, the five of them stood amidst the howling gale, as insignificant as grains of sand.
Looking at the terrifying storm in the distance, Han Xing said, "Let’s go, but keep the speed moderate and try to dodge those fragments."
Everyone nodded.
Undoubtedly, the upcoming journey was a tremendous challenge to their reflexes.
They had to withstand the intense hurricane while avoiding the flying Sky Island fragments.
Like five lonely boats,
they ventured deeper into the storm’s central area.
A few minutes later, they had reached an area approximately 150,000 kilometers away from the storm’s center.
"Whoosh whoosh whoosh!!"
The wind here was even stronger.
They could no longer hear any other sounds.
Their communication relied solely on divine power.
Those Sky Island fragments, empowered by the intense wind, exhibited even more horrific lethality.
They struck upon everyone’s Divine Power Shield, sending ripples through it.
At this point, even a random fragment had the power to severely injure a middle-tier Legend.
"If you can’t hold on, just say it," Han Xing reminded.
No one spoke.
Shen Yun jested, "Xiaoyongzi, can you handle it? If not, just tell Bro, and I’ll use the Holy Light Barrier to protect you."
Cheng Jianyong glared, "Who are you underestimating?"
"Watch me charge straight into the storm’s core in one go today."
Shen Yun chuckled.
Then, they continued forward.
At this distance, large fragments of Sky Island were no longer visible.
Only thumb-sized stones of varying colors could be seen around.
As a green stone flew by, Cheng Jianyong reached out and grabbed it.
A system notification appeared.
[Acquired Jade Heart Gem *1.]
[Jade Heart Gem]: Can enchant equipment, increasing maximum Life Value by 20,000 points.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "Whoa, treasure!"
"Brother Xing, look what I caught!"
He then posted the attributes of the Jade Heart Gem.
Seeing the [Jade Heart Gem] attributes in the group channel, Han Xing paused.
"There are such gems here?"
After a moment, he understood the reason.
"This hurricane storm has existed for thousands of years, and its mighty winds must have swept away countless Sky Islands."
"On those Sky Islands, the ores and metals of insufficient quality have long disintegrated, even the Constant Gold Ore, Purple Gold Ore, and such couldn’t withstand."
"Thus, what appears in this region are the extremely hard gems with special effects."
Hearing this, everyone nodded in realization.
Yet, the next moment, they realized something.
If what Han Xing said was true, the wealth contained in this area was astonishing!
The number of precious gems here was extremely overwhelming!
With that thought, Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, should we stay a bit longer and gather all these gems before leaving?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment and nodded.
Besides those gems,
he also noticed a significant number of Philosopher’s Stones and Terrastones here.
Clearly, this was a huge gain.
Moreover, his material reserves were running low, and he urgently needed to restock.
With that in mind, Han Xing said, "Let’s stay a bit longer and intercept all these stones."
They began excitedly grabbing the gems whizzing by through the air!

chapters.title: Chapter 819 - 446: Collecting the Seven Elements Divine Format_2
paragraphs: System prompts kept popping up.
[Obtained Keystones*1, Extreme Ice Divine Stone*1, obtained Philosopher’s Stone*1, obtained Waveless Metal*1...]
Joy flashed in Han Xing’s eyes.
It was a strange feeling, like they were picking up money inside a hurricane.
Every gem they grabbed meant a chunk of precious wealth.
In just over ten minutes, the five of them together had already collected several million stones.
Of course, not all of those stones were those precious gems.
Some were Sky Island Keystones, which apart from being extremely hard, had no other use.
Still, even though these stones were attributeless, just their hardness alone made them great materials for building large structures.
Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
He hadn’t expected that a trip to the Monsoon Islands would come with this kind of haul.
Everyone started working even harder, intercepting those flying stones.
That stopover lasted two full hours.
All together, the five of them took in close to twenty million various gems.
After filtering out those attributeless [Keystones], the usable ones still made up a full tenth!
That ratio was already quite good.
You had to know, this Hurricane Corps was unbelievably huge.
If they could scoop up every floating gem inside, the profit wouldn’t be any less than looting the God of Tricks’ treasure vault.
Of course, that would cost them quite a lot of time.
But for materials this precious, it was obviously worth it.
On Cheng Jianyong’s side, he directly pulled out that hundred-meter-long Molten Rock Pillar to block the surrounding flying gems.
"Ding ding ding!"
The stones clinked crisply against the Molten Rock Pillar.
At those moments when the stones’ momentum slowed, Cheng Jianyong would use Divine Power to scoop them into his backpack.
"Wuhu! This feels amazing!" Cheng Jianyong shouted excitedly.
Compared to him, Han Xing’s speed was even faster.
To ramp up efficiency, he directly released his Divine Power outward!
The upside was that the number of gems collected simultaneously shot up dramatically.
Every sweep brought in a huge haul.
The downside was that the frequency of attacks Han Xing suffered also spiked dozens of times over!
Thankfully his Divine Power was strong enough—if an ordinary High-tier Legend tried the same stunt, they wouldn’t last a single second before their Divine Power Domain backlashed and killed them.
[Obtained Philosopher’s Stone*172, Shadow Crystal*312, Extreme Ice Divine Stone*113, Waveless Metal*107...]
System prompts kept appearing.
They spent nearly twelve hours on this.
Roughly several hundred million various gems had been harvested.
Subtracting the common Keystones, the remaining materials still added up to over twenty million.
Among them, Philosopher’s Stones and Shimmering Terra Stones accounted for half.
The remaining ten-plus million were various elemental Divine Stones and metals, plus those gems that boosted Attributes or Armor.
Still a pretty solid gain.
Han Xing silently did the math in his head.
With these materials, he had enough to build another few hundred Calamity Defense Towers.
"Nice, nice. Didn’t expect a trip to the Monsoon Islands to come with a bonus like this."
Joy also appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
Then he took the team and continued forward.
Soon, they were within about a hundred thousand meters of the Storm Corps.
At this distance, the terrifying winds were almost strong enough to sweep them away as well.
Cheng Jianyong joked, "Xiaoyunzi, still holding up?"
Shen Yun laughed. "Who are you looking down on?"
"I’m a Radiant Knight, ever heard of ’steady as a rock’?"
As he spoke, a Holy Light Barrier surged out from Shen Yun’s body.
This Power of Holy Light even spread out to cover the whole team.
He stood in the raging gale, not budging an inch.
At the same time, everyone felt the wind around them weaken a bit.
After casting that move, Shen Yun looked smugly at Cheng Jianyong. "Well, Xiaoyongzi? Impressed by Brother Yun?
Cheng Jianyong rolled his eyes. "Show-off."
"Just wait till I transfer to a Supreme Hidden Profession—I’ll definitely be stronger than your Radiant Knight!"
Hearing that, Shen Yun burst out laughing.
The group continued pushing deeper into the Storm Corps.
Ninety thousand meters...
Eighty thousand meters...
Seventy thousand meters...
When they reached fifty thousand meters into the Storm Corps—
The wind here became insanely terrifying again!
Even Shen Yun’s Holy Light Shield was starting to struggle.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help saying, "Damn, it really does get harder the further in we go."
"The difficulty of getting these last two pieces of Divine Format is way crazier than the first five."
Everyone nodded in firm agreement.
Still, they had already collected six pieces of Divine Format.
They were at the final step now; there was no way they were turning back.
Forty thousand meters...
Thirty thousand meters...
Ten thousand meters!
They came to a halt.
Under the endless howling winds, Shen Yun’s Holy Light grew gradually dim; the intense consumption of the Power of Holy Light left his face a bit pale.
Han Xing said, "Xiaoyunzi, put away your Holy Light Barrier. We’ll use our own Divine Power Values to tank the rest."
Everyone could see that protecting so many people was pushing Shen Yun to his limit, so they all nodded one after another.
Shen Yun didn’t force it; he directly retracted the Holy Light Barrier.
Instantly, they all felt the wind around them amplify more than tenfold!
The slender Su Xiaoyang almost got blown away.
Just then, Han Xing’s figure flickered and appeared beside Su Xiaoyang.
Golden Divine Power Value wrapped around her, and she instantly steadied herself.
At the same time, Su Xiaoyang felt a warm Power envelop her.

Everyone nodded in firm agreement.
Still, they had already collected six pieces of Divine Format.
They were at the final step now; there was no way they were turning back.
Forty thousand meters...
Thirty thousand meters...
Ten thousand meters!
They came to a halt.
Under the endless howling winds, Shen Yun’s Holy Light grew gradually dim; the intense consumption of the Power of Holy Light left his face a bit pale.
Han Xing said, "Xiaoyunzi, put away your Holy Light Barrier.
We’ll use our own Divine Power Values to tank the rest."
Everyone could see that protecting so many people was pushing Shen Yun to his limit, so they all nodded one after another.
Shen Yun didn’t force it; he directly retracted the Holy Light Barrier.
Instantly, they all felt the wind around them amplify more than tenfold!
The slender Su Xiaoyang almost got blown away.
Just then, Han Xing’s figure flickered and appeared beside Su Xiaoyang.
Golden Divine Power Value wrapped around her, and she instantly steadied herself.
At the same time, Su Xiaoyang felt a warm Power envelop her.

chapters.title: Chapter 820 - 446: Gathering the Seven Elements Divine Format (3)
paragraphs: She also saw the man standing beside her.
In an instant, her face flushed red.
Especially after seeing the expression on Zhang Lianmeng’s face, she buried her head even lower.
However, Zhang Lianmeng did not say much, instead showing a smile of interest, quietly making an encouraging gesture to Su Xiaoyang.
Seeing this, Su Xiaoyang buried her head even deeper.
And at this moment.
Han Xing also arrived beside Zhang Lianmeng.
Pale golden divine power spread over, enveloping Zhang Lianmeng as well.
Before Zhang Lianmeng could speak, Han Xing said, "Don’t worry, my Divine Power Value is several times yours, protecting the two of you is more than sufficient."
In this regard, Han Xing wasn’t exaggerating.
Although the wind pressure here was terrifying, compared to the Power of Erosion from the last Earth Divine Format, it was much less.
After all, there were two terrifying existences clashing there, causing a divine power upheaval.
At that moment, Cheng Jianyong, seeing the situation, excitedly wanted to squeeze in as well.
Shen Yun pulled him and said, "You kid, you’d better come over to me."
With those words, Shen Yun’s Holy Light Barrier enveloped Cheng Jianyong.
If he only had to protect one person, Shen Yun was under much less pressure.
Cheng Jianyong, although obediently staying within Shen Yun’s Holy Light Barrier, still said somewhat gloomily, "I’m envious, I also want Brother Xing to protect me with divine power."
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun instantly felt goosebumps all over.
"Damn it! How can you, a grown man, say something like that?"
Cheng Jianyong rolled his eyes at him.
He knew that Shen Yun had misunderstood.
Afterward, the five of them divided into two groups and proceeded straight to the center of the Hurricane Corps.
Very soon, the group arrived within the 5,000-meter zone of the eye of the storm.
And this time, there were no accidents.
As they approached, a system prompt appeared.
[Target detected, verifying identity.]
[Race: Human Race (matched), Strength: Legend (matched), lifting wind element restriction...]
The next moment, the gale that could tear everything apart abruptly ceased.
It was as if the storm at sea had calmed.
Sunlight poured through the clouds, causing Tyndall effects to ripple.
Joy appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Because they could all see, in the sky ahead, a green rhombic crystal floating.
"It’s the Wind Divine Format! We finally see it!"
With those words, the five of them excitedly rushed to the Divine Format’s side.
This Wind Divine Format was currently radiating boundless divine power.
Everyone’s gaze was fixed on this beautiful divine power.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "Lian’Er, go and take down the Divine Format!"
"Mm-hmm!"
Zhang Lianmeng nodded enthusiastically.
It was evident that even Zhang Lianmeng was a bit excited.
After all, once she took this last Divine Format, she would be able to collect all the Elemental Divine Formats.
She could not only break through to the Demigod but also become the Supreme Hidden Profession: Elemental Mage!
When Zhang Lianmeng cautiously reached out with divine power to retrieve the green rhombic crystal.
The entire Holy Spirit Realm seemed to undergo some subtle changes.
It was as if the Power of Elements became a bit more active.
Especially for the Elemental Creatures, the feeling was more apparent.
Zhang Lianmeng said with a bit of excitement, "Brother Xing! It worked!"
Han Xing also smiled and nodded, "Good, but don’t rush to break through just yet."
"Wait a few minutes, I’ll summon the Divine Demon Battleship over."
"Then, we’ll go onto the Divine Demon Battleship to carry out the Demigod breakthrough."
Zhang Lianmeng nodded. "Okay, Brother Xing."
Han Xing turned around, sending out an instruction.
He intended to summon the Divine Demon Battleship, so he could ensure, to the greatest extent, Zhang Lianmeng’s safety during her breakthrough.
A few minutes later, the massive Divine Demon Battleship swiftly floated over.
Everyone together boarded the battleship.
On the deck of the battleship, Han Xing said, "Alright, none of us have prior experience with a Demigod breakthrough."
"Lianmeng is the first of all survivors to reach the Demigod level; I worry about unexpected events occurring."
"Therefore, we must do our best to ensure her safety."
"No matter what happens, nothing should interrupt Lianmeng’s breakthrough."
The group heard this and nodded heavily.
They also understood that Han Xing’s concern was not unfounded.
At this point, Han Xing looked at Zhang Lianmeng and said, "Lian’Er, you can begin."
Zhang Lianmeng nodded.
Then she took a deep breath and directly summoned the seven Divine Formats from her backpack.
Before her, seven differently colored, brilliantly radiant rhombic crystals floated.
The mighty fluctuations of divine power kept emanating, causing everyone to feel their hearts tremble,
even the Power of Elements throughout the Monsoon Islands reached an unbelievably active state,
the distant Omeiya Bird Swarm looked on in surprise at the surrounding changes.
Fierce thunder, scorching flame, piercing frost...
These elements were ones they rarely encountered on the Monsoon Islands before.
Meanwhile.
A system prompt appeared before Zhang Lianmeng.
[Detected survivor gathering all Elemental Mage Seven Elements Divine Formats, checking other conditions...]
[Level: 60 (matched)]
[Profession: Mage (matched)]
[Race: Human Race (matched)]
[All advancement conditions met, absorb the Rules of Power contained in the Seven Elements Divine Format to break through to Demigod level?]
[After breaking through to Demigod, you will automatically change profession to the Supreme Hidden Profession: Elemental Mage.]
After the long system prompt.
Zhang Lianmeng simply clicked confirm.
At the same moment.
Everyone heard the sound of crystals shattering in unison.
"Crack! Crack, crack!"
Under the gaze of Han Xing and the others, the seven Divine Formats all shattered instantly.
The next moment, they saw seven distinct energies, all pouring into Zhang Lianmeng’s body.
In an instant.
All the energy between heaven and earth fell into a wildly turbulent state!
"Rumble!"
"Whoosh! Whoosh!"

chapters.title: Chapter 821 - 447: Breaking Through to Demigod, Ascending the Divine Stairway!
paragraphs: The terrifying thunder fell like raindrops, interspersed with ice cones, flames...
Throughout the Monsoon Islands, those Omaya were affected, fleeing frantically under the dreadful natural disaster.
The Divine Demon Battleship constantly shook, and everyone watched in astonishment.
"My god... Sister Lian Meng’s breakthrough to Demigod level is truly terrifying!"
Everyone nodded in agreement.
If Han Xing had not felt it, Zhang Lianmeng’s aura was increasing at a horrifying speed.
He would have interrupted her directly.
Fortunately, Zhang Lianmeng’s aura gradually stabilized.
However, this was not the end.
Suddenly, seven energy pillars appeared between heaven and earth.
The whole Holy Spirit Realm was alarmed by these energy pillars!
Wills awakened from slumber.
They exclaimed in horror: "The aura of the Elements..."
"It’s that one!"
"Heavens! Are the gods going to return to the Holy Spirit Realm?"
"Quickly escape to the Void, if all gods return, it would be a disaster even more terrifying than an Abyss Realm invasion!"
The hidden existences panicked as if confronted with something terrifying.
They no longer hid their auras and quickly rushed out from their hiding places.
Even willing to risk being captured by the Holy Spirit Realm’s will, they frantically charged into the Void.
The demigods fighting in the Elf Realm simultaneously sensed these rising auras.
They looked with surprise at various places in the Holy Spirit Realm.
At this moment, not only the hidden divine spirits.
Even the ancient aura on the Path of the Giant Dragon felt restless.
"Supreme God... how could it be?"
It clearly knew how terrifying the owner of this aura was.
Once such an existence returns.
There will be no place in the Holy Spirit Realm that can escape its scrutiny!
The next moment, a streak of light rose from the Path of the Giant Dragon and rushed straight towards the Void.
On this day, due to the appearance of that aura, all hidden divine spirits in the Holy Spirit Realm were alarmed, escaping this world in unison.
Han Xing and others were unaware of the happenings in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Because he was now fully focused on watching Zhang Lianmeng’s transformation.
Zhang Lianmeng’s aura at this moment, was already no different from those demigod-level powerhouses.
In fact, the fluctuations of the Power of Rules on her body far exceeded some ordinary demigods.
Then, her transformation seemed far from over.
The next moment, the seven energy pillars from the sky simultaneously poured into Zhang Lianmeng’s body.
Everyone felt Zhang Lianmeng’s aura rising again at an extremely terrifying speed.
Her transformation from Legend to Demigod lasted a full half hour...
And her aura became increasingly ethereal.
Han Xing even vaguely felt Zhang Lianmeng’s temperament was transforming towards that woman.
Calm and indifferent towards all beings, with a knowing, goddess-like gaze...
Noticing something amiss, Han Xing furrowed his brows, thinking: "Are these seven Divine Formats going to cause a problem?"
"Should I interrupt Lian Meng’s breakthrough?"
After considering, Han Xing shook his head.
He cannot interrupt her.
Everything must wait for Zhang Lianmeng to complete her breakthrough.
At the same time, Zhang Lianmeng, with eyes closed, suddenly heard a system notification sound.

[Breakthrough completed. You have become a demigod-level creature, automatically transitioning to the supreme hidden profession: Elemental Law God, with All Attributes increased by 300%, Divine Power Value increased by 300%, Elemental Affinity unlocked.]

[You have automatically learned Skills: Ultimate Skill - Divine Shattering Storm, Ultimate Skill - Ice and Snow Apocalypse, Ultimate Skill - Burning Prison Flame, Ultimate Skill - Destruction Realm Thunder, Ultimate Skill - Erosion of All Things, Ultimate Skill - Light of Redemption, Ultimate Skill - Darkest Frequency.]
[Successfully learned the unique hidden combination Ultimate Skill - Seven Elements Disaster Burst...]
Seeing this long system notification.
Zhang Lianmeng, too shocked, suddenly awoke from that mysterious state.
Her small mouth agape, her eyes filled with intense shock!
"So... so terrifying..."
At the same time, the moment Zhang Lianmeng broke through to Demigod, a system notification appeared in everyone’s ears.

System Announcement: "Attention all survivors, Survivor Qing Meng, has fully completed Sixth Transformation, becoming the first demigod-level powerhouse among Blue Star People, Human Race Milestone: Ascend the Godly Steps unlocked."
"Let us congratulate this powerhouse for making a significant contribution to the rise of the Human Race!"
Upon hearing the system notification, Han Xing and others knew Zhang Lianmeng had successfully broken through to Demigod.
At this moment, the chat channel fell into complete chaos.
Advancing Tiny Wang: "Holy crap! Holy crap! Holy crap! Someone broke through to Demigod? Did I hear wrong?"
Daren Drinking Medicine: "What are you talking about, the upstairs message was a global announcement, how could it be wrong?"
Ginger Chocolate: "It’s unbelievable... that’s a Demigod, we are still so far from Legend, yet someone has already broken through to Demigod!"
At the current stage, most survivors’ Levels are around 40, the higher ones only at forty-six or seven.
And these last few Levels are the hardest to raise.
To reach Level 50 and break through to Legend would take a long time.
Other survivors then commented.
"But did you notice, this time the one breaking through to Demigod wasn’t Star God, but Qing Meng?"
"What’s strange about that, Qing Meng is also Star God’s friend; I heard she’s even Star God’s girlfriend?"
"Wow! Is that true? Star God doesn’t break through to Demigod first, letting his friend breakthrough instead, that’s too nice to his own people!"

chapters.title: Chapter 822 - 447: Breaking Through to Demigod, Ascending the Divine Steps! (Part 2)
paragraphs: "So jealous! I wonder if the Star God still needs a boyfriend?"
This time, the full-server announcement rang in the ears of every Survivor.
Even Zhou Huang and Boundless, who had long since vanished, heard the system notification.
At this moment, Zhou Huang was following behind that woman and the Shadow Monarch.
Ever since he was taken away by that woman last time, Zhou Huang had stayed with them.
Their current location didn’t seem to be within the Holy Spirit Realm; all around them was a stretch of Void.
The two of them looked somewhat worried as they stared at the Shadow Monarch, who was in the middle of healing.
Yesterday, when the Shadow Monarch returned, his Armor was covered with dense cracks, and his body was riddled with extremely severe injuries.
He was not far from falling.
Zhou Huang and that mysterious woman were both extremely shocked.
The woman immediately asked who had wounded the Shadow Monarch like this.
And when the Shadow Monarch said it was those few Humans, the two at the scene both jumped in fright.
They both knew exactly who those Humans the Shadow Monarch spoke of were.
Aside from that group, it was impossible for any other Humans to inflict such grievous wounds on the Shadow Monarch.
Compared to the Shadow Monarch being injured, they were even more shocked by how fast Han Xing and the others were growing stronger.
They knew that with the woman’s help, after the Shadow Monarch broke through to High-tier Demigod, his strength surpassed that of ordinary peers of the same tier.
Yet even so, facing those few Humans, he had almost lost his life.
That alone showed just how terrifying their Power was!
They were probably at least on the same top level as the Elf King.
Ever since he came back yesterday, the Shadow Monarch hadn’t said a single word.
Zhou Huang and that woman could both see the frustration in this man’s heart.
As if worried the Shadow Monarch would lose his drive from now on, the woman consoled him, "Dark Shadow, just focus on healing. It was only one failure; don’t take it too hard."
"Once we use Zhou Huang’s Human Emperor’s Sword to find the remaining pieces of the Human Emperor Set, a full Set of Holy Artifacts will be enough to instantly give you Godslaying Power."
"When that time comes, those few Humans will absolutely not be your match."
She didn’t care at all that Zhou Huang was right beside her, openly stating that she intended to take his Human Emperor Set.
Yet Zhou Huang didn’t mind either.
After all, his little life was completely in this woman’s hands.
The Shadow Monarch said nothing.
Just then, Zhou Huang’s expression suddenly changed, and that system notification rang in his ears as well.
Zhou Huang murmured in shock, "Already?"
The woman sensed Zhou Huang’s reaction and asked puzzled, "What is it?"
Zhou Huang slowly said, "One of them has broken through to Demigod."
"What!?"
The Shadow Monarch and the woman spoke in unison.
Strong shock flashed in both their eyes.
Because they had just been saying that once they found the other parts of the Human Emperor Set, they’d be able to deal with those Humans.
And now in such a short time, someone had already broken through to Demigod!
"Who broke through to Demigod?"
"Was it the one who uses Bow and Arrow?"
The two asked at the same time.
They knew that all those Humans had already reached High-tier Legendary Level, just one step away from Demigod.
So who exactly had broken through to Demigod mattered a great deal.
Zhou Huang took a deep breath, then shook his head. "No, it was the Mage beside him."
The Shadow Monarch and the woman exchanged a glance, then nodded simultaneously.
"If it’s not that man, then that’s still okay..."
The woman said, "But we still can’t let our guard down. Before we possess Power that can reliably defeat them, we must not show ourselves lightly before those Humans."
"This generation of the Human Race is growing at an increasingly terrifying pace."
"It hasn’t even been five years of development, and someone has already become a Demigod..."
"Give them a bit more time, and they might even break through the barrier of the Holy Spirit Realm and become true Divine Spirits!"
Meanwhile.
Boundless, who hadn’t appeared in a long time, was likewise in a strange space.
Everything here was dyed in blood-red.
A mountain of corpses and a Sea of Blood, with countless corpses floating within...
Boundless floated in the Sea of Blood along with those corpses.
If Han Xing and the others were here, they would be shocked to discover:
Boundless’s aura had, without them noticing, already reached the Legendary Realm.
At this moment, the sudden system notification abruptly pulled Boundless out of that State.
"Demigod..."
"How can it be this fast?"
"Ancestor said that a Demigod has to grasp the Power of Rules, didn’t he?"
Boundless’s entire body was soaking in the Sea of Blood, only half his head above the surface.
He gazed into the distance, eyes full of resentment. "I’ve given up so much, all for the sake of pursuing greater Power!"
"I originally thought that once I broke through to Legend, I’d finally be able to catch up to that guy’s footsteps."
"Now it seems I’m only getting left further and further behind..."
Center of the Monsoon Islands.
On the Divine Demon Battleship.
Han Xing looked at Zhang Lianmeng, feeling the cold aura around her dissipate, and finally let out a sigh of relief.
He’d really been worried that there might be some issue with these Divine Formats, and that using them to break through would have some kind of side effect on Zhang Lianmeng.
"Lian’Er, how do you feel?" Han Xing asked.
Zhang Lianmeng nodded excitedly. "I feel great, Brother Xing!"
"The boost from this metamorphosis is insanely strong."
Then she honestly told everyone about her gains.
When they finished listening to Zhang Lianmeng, everyone sucked in a sharp breath.
"Damn... All Attributes increased threefold, Divine Power Value increased threefold! And seven Ultimate Skills, plus one Combined Ultimate Skill!"
"Isn’t that way too terrifying?"

This time, the full-server announcement rang in the ears of every Survivor.

At this moment, Zhou Huang was following behind that woman and the Shadow Monarch.
Ever since he was taken away by that woman last time, Zhou Huang had stayed with them.
Their current location didn’t seem to be within the Holy Spirit Realm; all around them was a stretch of Void.
The two of them looked somewhat worried as they stared at the Shadow Monarch, who was in the middle of healing.
Yesterday, when the Shadow Monarch returned, his Armor was covered with dense cracks, and his body was riddled with extremely severe injuries.
He was not far from falling.
Zhou Huang and that mysterious woman were both extremely shocked.
The woman immediately asked who had wounded the Shadow Monarch like this.
And when the Shadow Monarch said it was those few Humans, the two at the scene both jumped in fright.
They both knew exactly who those Humans the Shadow Monarch spoke of were.
Aside from that group, it was impossible for any other Humans to inflict such grievous wounds on the Shadow Monarch.
Compared to the Shadow Monarch being injured, they were even more shocked by how fast Han Xing and the others were growing stronger.
They knew that with the woman’s help, after the Shadow Monarch broke through to High-tier Demigod, his strength surpassed that of ordinary peers of the same tier.
Yet even so, facing those few Humans, he had almost lost his life.
That alone showed just how terrifying their Power was!
They were probably at least on the same top level as the Elf King.
Ever since he came back yesterday, the Shadow Monarch hadn’t said a single word.
Zhou Huang and that woman could both see the frustration in this man’s heart.
As if worried the Shadow Monarch would lose his drive from now on, the woman consoled him, "Dark Shadow, just focus on healing.
It was only one failure; don’t take it too hard."
"Once we use Zhou Huang’s Human Emperor’s Sword to find the remaining pieces of the Human Emperor Set, a full Set of Holy Artifacts will be enough to instantly give you Godslaying Power."
"When that time comes, those few Humans will absolutely not be your match."
She didn’t care at all that Zhou Huang was right beside her, openly stating that she intended to take his Human Emperor Set.
Yet Zhou Huang didn’t mind either.
After all, his little life was completely in this woman’s hands.
The Shadow Monarch said nothing.
Just then, Zhou Huang’s expression suddenly changed, and that system notification rang in his ears as well.
Zhou Huang murmured in shock, "Already?"
The woman sensed Zhou Huang’s reaction and asked puzzled, "What is it?"
Zhou Huang slowly said, "One of them has broken through to Demigod."
"What!?"
The Shadow Monarch and the woman spoke in unison.
Strong shock flashed in both their eyes.
Because they had just been saying that once they found the other parts of the Human Emperor Set, they’d be able to deal with those Humans.
And now in such a short time, someone had already broken through to Demigod!
"Who broke through to Demigod?"
"Was it the one who uses Bow and Arrow?"
The two asked at the same time.
They knew that all those Humans had already reached High-tier Legendary Level, just one step away from Demigod.
So who exactly had broken through to Demigod mattered a great deal.
Zhou Huang took a deep breath, then shook his head.
"No, it was the Mage beside him."
The Shadow Monarch and the woman exchanged a glance, then nodded simultaneously.
"If it’s not that man, then that’s still okay..."
The woman said, "But we still can’t let our guard down.
Before we possess Power that can reliably defeat them, we must not show ourselves lightly before those Humans."
"This generation of the Human Race is growing at an increasingly terrifying pace."
"It hasn’t even been five years of development, and someone has already become a Demigod..."
"Give them a bit more time, and they might even break through the barrier of the Holy Spirit Realm and become true Divine Spirits!"
Meanwhile.
Boundless, who hadn’t appeared in a long time, was likewise in a strange space.
Everything here was dyed in blood-red.
A mountain of corpses and a Sea of Blood, with countless corpses floating within...
Boundless floated in the Sea of Blood along with those corpses.
If Han Xing and the others were here, they would be shocked to discover:
Boundless’s aura had, without them noticing, already reached the Legendary Realm.
At this moment, the sudden system notification abruptly pulled Boundless out of that State.
"Demigod..."
"How can it be this fast?"
"Ancestor said that a Demigod has to grasp the Power of Rules, didn’t he?"
Boundless’s entire body was soaking in the Sea of Blood, only half his head above the surface.
He gazed into the distance, eyes full of resentment.
"I’ve given up so much, all for the sake of pursuing greater Power!"
"I originally thought that once I broke through to Legend, I’d finally be able to catch up to that guy’s footsteps."
"Now it seems I’m only getting left further and further behind..."
Center of the Monsoon Islands.
On the Divine Demon Battleship.
Han Xing looked at Zhang Lianmeng, feeling the cold aura around her dissipate, and finally let out a sigh of relief.
He’d really been worried that there might be some issue with these Divine Formats, and that using them to break through would have some kind of side effect on Zhang Lianmeng.
"Lian’Er, how do you feel?" Han Xing asked.
Zhang Lianmeng nodded excitedly.
"I feel great, Brother Xing!"
"The boost from this metamorphosis is insanely strong."
Then she honestly told everyone about her gains.
When they finished listening to Zhang Lianmeng, everyone sucked in a sharp breath.
"Damn...
All Attributes increased threefold, Divine Power Value increased threefold!
And seven Ultimate Skills, plus one Combined Ultimate Skill!"
"Isn’t that way too terrifying?"

chapters.title: Chapter 823 - 447: Breaking Through to Demigod, Ascending the Divine Steps!
paragraphs: Zhang Lianmeng’s Basic Attributes were already close to an Initial-tier Demigod.
Now that she’s just broken through, she’s actually reached the level of a High-tier Demigod!
From this you can see just how terrifying her advancement is.
However, Han Xing also understood.
If it were an ordinary Profession breaking through to Demigod, there absolutely wouldn’t be such a huge increase.
This is because Zhang Lianmeng’s class change was to the Supreme Hidden Profession, Elemental Law God!
It directly boosted her Attributes by 300%.
And aside from the Attribute increase, Zhang Lianmeng also slotted in the eight Ultimate Skills she’d just learned.
Everyone stared, dumbfounded, at the string of Ultimate Skill stats.

[Ultimate Skill—Divine Shattering Storm]: Based on your own Spirit Attribute, summon a Storm Corps that inflicts continuous shredding damage on enemies at the core equal to [Spirit * 7800.24%], and applies different slow effects to all enemies within the Storm Corps...
[Ultimate Skill—Burning Prison Flame]: Stir up all Flame Elements in a certain area, igniting everything, causing all enemies to suffer continuous burning damage equal to [Spirit * 1224.4%].

[Ultimate Skill—Destruction Realm Thunder]: Condense all Thunder Elements to inflict a Thunder Element damage of [Spirit * 11700.3%] to enemies in every area; if the enemy is not instantly killed, they are put into a 5-second paralyzed State.
[Ultimate Skill—Erosion of All Things]: ...
After reading the Attributes of these seven Ultimate Skills, everyone swallowed hard at the same time.
Obviously, this is basically a miniature version of the Divine Format Restriction Effects they’ve encountered all along the way.
Of course, only the range is a bit smaller; the Attack Power hasn’t decreased at all—in fact, the might is even stronger than those Restrictions.
Because the damage values of these Skills all rely on Zhang Lianmeng’s Spirit Attribute.
And Zhang Lianmeng’s current Spirit is already close to 400,000!
Once these Ultimate Skills are cast, even if they don’t instantly kill, it’s more than enough to heavily wound a High-tier Demigod.
And besides these seven Ultimate Skills, Zhang Lianmeng also learned a Combined Ultimate Skill.
This Skill is actually the most powerful upgrade this time.
It’s even the strongest Skill Han Xing has seen since entering Sky Island Paradise.

[Combined Ultimate Skill—Seven Elements Disaster Burst]: Detonate all Elements within the area ahead, putting all Energy into a chaotic State; during the duration of the Element Disaster Burst, enemy creatures will be unable to use any Power, including Divine Power, Power of Rules, Magic Power, Power of the Void... and will suffer mixed-type damage from seven waves of elemental surges. Each wave of Element Disaster Burst has a value of 7000%~10000% (this Skill can affect True God Level creatures, but the Effect will decay based on the Attribute Values of both sides.)
After reading the description of this Skill, everyone’s eyes went wide.
Cheng Jianyong swallowed and couldn’t help saying, "This is way too broken..."
"Sealing all Power, even True God Level creatures can’t avoid it."
"And with such a high Damage Coefficient..."
"Terrifying!"
The other team members also nodded in deep agreement.
It was obvious that the boost from Zhang Lianmeng’s Demigod breakthrough this time was extremely powerful.
And they were all large-area Destruction Skills, letting her Elemental Law God Profession be unleashed to the fullest.
Of course, this doesn’t mean Zhang Lianmeng’s combat strength in other aspects hasn’t improved.
Because aside from these Skills, she also unlocked a [Elemental Affinity] interface.
On this interface, the Affinity of the Seven Elements is all 1400.
According to Zhang Lianmeng’s description, this Affinity increases her Magic strength, and her perception of the Power of Elements in the air becomes much more pronounced.
It’s basically about a 140% enhancement.
Han Xing listened and fell into thought.
Because this Elemental Affinity might be what’s called the Power of Rules.
The higher the Affinity, the stronger the Power of Rules you control, and the more terrifying the combat strength you can exert.
After figuring this out, joy appeared on everyone’s faces.
"Great, with Sister Lian Meng paving the way for us, we shouldn’t run into any problems when we break through to Demigod next." Shen Yun said sincerely.
Han Xing nodded.
"Alright, since Lian Meng has broken through as well, we should head back now."
With that, he controlled the Divine Demon Battleship to speed forward.
The battleship kept accelerating, quickly breaking past Middle-tier Legendary Level speed and reaching High-tier Demigod.
Like a streak of flowing light, so fast it left people unable to track it.
A few minutes later, they rushed out of the central area of the Monsoon Islands.
In the distance, they could see the overwhelming silhouettes of the Omaya flock.
"Gaa! Gaa!!"
The cries of these Omaya carried over from far away.
Han Xing also sensed the auras of those Omaya at the first instant.
Over a thousand Omaya, each with at least Legendary Level strength—this was quite a massive Power.
At the moment they were all opening their beaks wide, looking especially ferocious.
Since Han Xing had only made a contract with the Mother of Omeia, the other Omaya, the moment they saw the Divine Demon Battleship, were ready to rush over and tear it apart.
"Gaa!!"
However, after a single enraged cry from the Mother of Omeia, all these Omaya obediently stayed where they were.
At this moment.
The Divine Demon Battleship slowly flew over and hovered beside the Omaya flock.
These big birds seemed like they still wanted to rush up and Attack them, but with the Mother of Omeia holding them back, all the Omaya could only suppress the killing intent in their hearts.
Han Xing glanced at the flock of Omaya, then nodded and said.
"Alright, have them all come back and stay on the Divine Demon Battleship."
The Mother of Omeia nodded after hearing this.
Then it turned its head and issued commands to the other Omaya.
"Gaa! Gaa!"
After a series of strange bird calls, the Omaya flock looked at one another.
Its orders seemed to catch this Omaya group completely off guard, and a commotion swept through the flock.
Those Omaya cried to the heavens, seemingly in defiance of the Mother of Omeia’s command.
