chapters.title: Chapter 824 - 448: High Priest, Xiao’s Desire
paragraphs: Seeing this scene, Han Xing furrowed his brows.
However, he understood that this group of Omaya had a violent temperament and a strong proclivity for aggression.
To put it bluntly, they were like a bunch of uncivilized beasts.
At this time, sending them on battleships to wage war against the Elf Race.
Was akin to having a herd of wild boars board a car.
Mother of Omeia saw that her orders had no effect and was also extremely angry.
She opened her blood-red maw, continually roaring.
"Screeeee!!!"
The terrifying sound wave instantly spread out over several hundred thousand meters.
It also made the group of Omaya quiet down.
However, although the Omaya no longer made chaotic noises,
they remained standing there, seemingly unwilling to come aboard Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship.
Seeing this, Cheng Jianyong said from the side, "What do we do, Brother Xing? These stubborn birds are too fierce, it’s impossible to relay commands to them."
Han Xing furrowed his brows and said, "Let’s see how things go. If we really can’t command them, forget it."
Though the Omaya had many strong warriors, which could play a significant role in combating the Abyss Realm,
the current situation showed that even the Mother of Omeia couldn’t command them.
Unless Han Xing resorted to a killing spree to force them all into signing a contract with him.
After thinking it over, Han Xing felt it wasn’t necessary.
And just then,
a larger Omaya flew over from a distance.
It was covered with fierce spikes, and while its aura was only at the Initial-tier Demigod, its appearance was even more terrifying than the Mother of Omeia.
This Omaya was clearly a male within the group.
Upon sensing the aura of these humans, it was taken aback for a moment.
Then its gaze rested on Zhang Lianmeng.
From her, the male Omaya sensed a strong threat!
Its eyes showed a trace of apprehension.
"Gah!!"
The Mother of Omeia let out a cry.
The male Omaya understood, and the two Demigod-level birds exchanged some communication.
Moments later, the male Omaya seemed to understand something.
It looked deeply at Han Xing and others, a complex expression in its avian eyes.
It pondered for a moment, then turned and called out to the other Omaya, seemingly conveying some instructions.
Those Legendary Level Omaya listened, each showing uncertain expressions in their eyes.
However, under the simultaneous commands of the two Demigod Omaya,
in the end, these Legendary Level Omaya had no choice but to comply obediently.
The flock started to move.
"Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!"
These Omaya flapped their wings and flew over, landing on the battleship’s deck.
Seeing this scene, smiles of relief appeared on everyone’s faces.
Getting this group of large birds to cooperate was the best outcome.
Then, Han Xing opened the hatch, allowing all the Omaya to enter the ship’s cabin.
The Mother of Omeia and the male Omaya exchanged a few more words.
The two great birds parted reluctantly.
The Mother of Omeia also boarded the battleship.
However, due to its large size, it could not enter the cabin and had to stand on the deck.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, "These big birds turned out to be quite sensible."
Han Xing nodded.
At this point, he addressed the Demigod Omaya on the deck, "Hold tight, I’m about to initiate the Teleportation mode."
The Mother of Omeia was stunned, seemingly not understanding Han Xing’s words.
A moment later, a mechanical broadcast voice emerged.
"Entering teleportation state, countdown 5 seconds..."
At this moment, the Mother of Omeia finally understood why Han Xing had told it to hold tight.
Its entire bird body felt like it was being tightly compressed by a terrifying energy, and the density of its flesh began to rapidly shrink.
Even more terrifying was that it felt as if it were being forced into a cramped space, even transforming into a line-like form.
The next moment, a terrible sense of impact hit.
"Buzz!"
At this moment, the Omaya on the battleship felt as if it had entered a space-time tunnel.
The surrounding scenes retreated rapidly.
Even with its Demigod-level physique, it almost couldn’t breathe!
"Gah! Gah gah!"
The Mother of Omeia began to panic.
Fortunately, this state didn’t last long.
Five seconds later, they exited that teleportation state.
However, the Omaya seemed to have taken a trip to the gates of hell, looking at its body in sheer terror.
Upon realizing it hadn’t lost any limbs, it let out a long sigh of relief.
At that moment, the Omaya also noticed the surrounding scene.
This was no longer its familiar area but had arrived outside.
In just a matter of seconds, they had traveled from the Monsoon Islands to the outside.
It was utterly terrifying!
The Mother of Omeia’s eyes showed intense shock.
Before it could recover, Han Xing’s voice sounded again: "There will be many more teleportations next, so be prepared."
The Mother of Omeia was startled, quickly grasping the battleship deck tightly.
Subsequently, Han Xing continued to activate the Teleportation mode.
In less than six hours, they had traveled from the Monsoon Islands back to the Elf Realm.
They had crossed hundreds of millions of kilometers, surpassing the Omaya tribe’s imagination.
At this point, a system notification appeared.
[You have returned to the Elf Realm.]
Seeing the system notification, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed with joy, "Wuhu, we’re back!"
Then, Han Xing piloted the battleship directly into the central area of the Elf Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 825 - 448: High Priest, Xiao’s Desire_2
paragraphs: In a few minutes, they returned to the vicinity of Hyfire Island.
From afar, they could see a large number of Thunder Beasts and Legendary Warships of the Witch Race.
These were Han Xing’s army.
Since Han Xing left, the task of defending this area was handed over to them.
Led and commanded by the High Priest Xiao of the Witch Race, suppressing and destroying the teleportation arrays of the Abyss Realm.
Under the suppression of three demigod-level Thunder Beasts and hundreds of legendary-level Thunder Beasts.
The Abyss Demons and teleportation arrays appearing here didn’t cause any waves.
At this moment, sensing Han Xing’s aura.
A red stream of light swiftly emerged from the distant Thunder Beast group.
That stream of light exuded the aura of a high-tier legendary level, just one step away from becoming a demigod.
It was indeed the High Priest Xiao.
"Let’s go, let’s go out to meet him."
Han Xing ordered.
Then, Han Xing and his five companions flashed and directly left the warship, appearing in mid-air.
Upon seeing Han Xing, the High Priest Xiao respectfully greeted, "Greetings, Saint Master."
"Greetings to the warriors of the Human Race."
Besides Han Xing, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others also held high prestige among the Witch Race.
After all, they all knew that these people were friends of Han Xing.
In several previous large-scale battles, Cheng Jianyong and others had appeared as well.
At this moment, the High Priest’s gaze lingered on Zhang Lianmeng, and he was instantly surprised, "This lord has already surpassed to a demigod?"
Han Xing nodded.
Upon hearing this, the High Priest was genuinely surprised, then respectfully said, "Congratulations, my lord, on the breakthrough!"
Zhang Lianmeng was a bit embarrassed by his formal greeting.
"I never expected that a demigod-level mighty figure would appear so quickly at Saint Master Han Xing’s side."
The High Priest’s tone carried undisguised envy and a bit of amazement.
It is known that when he first met Han Xing and others, Xiao already had high-tier legendary prowess.
Later, he watched these humans rise all the way, breaking through to legendary and high-tier legendary with a terrifying speed.
The momentum of their advance was unprecedented.
And now, how long has it been since they broke through to high-tier legendary?
Yet someone had already surpassed to a demigod!
Do you have no bottlenecks at all?
Moreover, Xiao could feel that Zhang Lianmeng’s breakthrough was not just an ordinary demigod.
In terms of aura alone, it was already more oppressive than some middle-tier demigods!
But after so long, Xiao was still at the high-tier legendary.
This made him feel a strong sense of frustration amidst his admiration...
Everyone could see the loneliness in Xiao’s eyes.
But there was nothing to be done about it.
After all, the natives of this world could only grow stronger by absorbing energy, unlike Han Xing and his companions, who could gain experience value by killing enemies.
No matter how extraordinarily talented you are, without reaching specific conditions, you simply cannot break through the barriers.
Han Xing seemed to see what Xiao was thinking, so he asked, "Xiao, you’ve been stuck at high-tier legendary for a long time, right?"
After thinking for a moment, Xiao nodded, "Yes, Saint Master, I have been at high-tier legendary for many years."
Han Xing nodded, "Are you just missing the last divine format to break through?"
Upon hearing this, Xiao replied, "Yes, Saint Master."
"If I had a divine format, I am confident I could break through to demigod within a week."
Hearing this answer, Han Xing nodded.
A week’s time, indeed, was quite fast.
This indicated that Xiao had long reached the demigod-level realm, only lacking the divine format.
Speaking of which, Han Xing indeed still had two divine formats.
One belonged to the God of Tricks, the other to the God of Justice.
Han Xing did not plan to use these on himself or his companions.
The reason was simple, as there were two deities living that locked their limits.
As for Zhang Lian Meng’s Elemental Law God profession.
Although Han Xing also knew that the terrifying existence was surely still alive.
But because its power level far exceeded that of ordinary deities.
So, Han Xing vaguely speculated that Zhang Lianmeng might not be restricted by this rule when trying to break through to divine spirit.
Han Xing mused, "These two divine formats are not of much use to me."
"Their only function is for direct absorption to enhance my divine power."
"Now I can give one to Xiao, let him break through to a demigod first."
Herr Han Xing looked at Shen Yun and said, "Xiaoyun, take out that Justice Divine Format."
Shen Yun nodded upon hearing this.
Without any hesitation, he took out the rhombic crystal exuding a majestic aura from his backpack.
"Buzz!"
The moment the rhombic crystal appeared, the surrounding divine power trembled.
While the High Priest’s pupils contracted suddenly!
"Is this... a divine format!?"
The High Priest’s tone was filled with strong shock.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, this is the Justice Divine Format; I can give it to you for the breakthrough."
"However, you have to think it over. Once you use this divine format, you will be trapped in the demigod realm until the deity governing the rules above perishes."
Nonetheless, Xiao excitedly replied, "A demigod is already sufficient for me!"
"Besides, I feel an aura more terrifying than Saint Master Helas from the power contained within this divine format!"
Han Xing was astonished for a moment, then understood.
Compared to them, Xiao naturally didn’t think that far.
Or rather, in the entire Holy Spirit Realm, apart from the three great kings, no other strong individuals ever thought they could break through to the divine spirit realm.
After all, demigod-level power was already the pinnacle in the Holy Spirit Realm, the goal they pursued all their lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 826 - 448: High Priest, Xiao’s Desire_3
paragraphs: Han Xing nodded, "Then I’ll leave this Divine Format to you."
Xiao was about to take it instinctively, then pulled his hand back.
"What’s wrong?" Han Xing asked.
He said a little embarrassedly, "Saint Master, the Divine Format is too precious for us, I can’t take your thing without earning it."
Han Xing laughed upon hearing this, "Alright, after you break through to a Demigod, just kill a few more Demons and assist Wu Ling’Er in managing the Witch Race."
Xiao was instantly thrilled and said, "Thank you, Saint Master Han Xing!"
"I will not disappoint your expectations and will break through to a Demigod within a week!"
Xiao spoke very sincerely, at this moment, a system alert appeared.
[Your actions have moved the High Priest of the Witch Race: Xiao, character affinity unlocked.]
[Current Affinity]: 77 (Trust)
Seeing this system alert, Han Xing was a bit stunned.
What? Xiao’s affinity is also unlocked?
And it suddenly soared this high.
Han Xing noticed that Xiao’s gaze towards him seemed to have changed.
It was a fiery look!
Han Xing quickly avoided the gaze and coughed twice.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "I brought back a batch of strange birds from the Monsoon Islands, called Omaya."
"They are here to help in dealing with the Abyss Realm."
"These Omaya, I leave them for you to manage."
With that, Han Xing waved his hand.
The hatch of the Divine Demon Battleship opened.
The sound of ’whoosh’ echoed.
One by one, large birds flew out of the Divine Demon Battleship like a fountain.
Although Xiao was inwardly shocked, not knowing where Han Xing got so many powerful creatures from.
But thinking of Han Xing’s past deeds, he wasn’t that surprised.
"Xiao, at your command!"
Han Xing nodded.
After bidding farewell to the High Priest, he took everyone back to Ten Thousand Stars City.
The Divine Demon Battleship was docked next to Ten Thousand Stars City, as its length of over a thousand kilometers was comparable to a third of Ten Thousand Stars City’s size.
Han Xing couldn’t hide it even if he wanted to.
But fortunately, other races had similar battleships and other war machines.
Though surprised by the design and size of Han Xing’s Demon God Battleship, they didn’t think too much about it.
When Han Xing and the others returned to the Elf Realm, they stayed above Ten Thousand Stars City without anything to do.
For three days straight, there wasn’t a single battle that needed their intervention.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong was lying in the territory, so bored that he was wrestling with Coal Ball.
Including the other team members, they were wandering casually around the territory.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing also understood why.
Since he killed the Fearful Limb Demon God last time, the Holy Spirit Realm has gained more experience in dealing with the Abyss Realm.
Although the frequency of Teleportation Arrays is still high, because all races’ armies have arrived.
There is no need for those hidden powerhouses to act, as the Holy Spirit Realm can already withstand the impact of the Abyss Realm.
Just like that, another three days passed...
Han Xing walked out of the Lord’s Mansion, looking at the bored crowd, and chuckled, "Isn’t it boring to be idle like this?"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong rolled up from the ground like a carp.
"Yeah Brother Xing! Ever since we came to this world, we’ve never been this idle, it feels too unusual."
Including the other team members, they all expressed the same feelings.
Speaking of which, since they came to this world, four years have passed.
In these four years, everyone has leveled up from level 1 to level 60, always in a state of sprinting, without a single day of rest.
Because they simply didn’t dare to stop.
Now suddenly being idle, it really feels a bit uncomfortable.
"Brother Xing, is there anything we can do?"
"Could we go to the Void and find the Inheritance Palace of the Barbaric God?"
Cheng Jianyong asked expectantly.
It can be seen that he is eager to break through to a Demigod.
At this, Han Xing laughed, "I know you can’t sit still, but we can’t go to the Void now."
"The Inheritance Palace of the Barbaric God, we don’t even know where it is.
"With the boundless range of the Void, without the teleportation function of a battleship, it would take us a long time just to find the palace."
"By then, if the Abyss Realm attacks, we wouldn’t be able to return in time."
After hearing this, Cheng Jianyong showed a look of disappointment.
But he also knew that Han Xing was right.
At this moment, Han Xing laughed, "However, although we can’t go to the Endless Void."
"But we can take some time to return to Xingyu City!"
"Anyway, with the High-Level Teleportation Array, we can come and go at any time."
Hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
Then, they were a bit puzzled.
"Brother Xing, what are we going back to Xingyu City for? There’s no monsters for us to fight there."
Han Xing laughed, "There are no monsters there, but there are your families."
Upon hearing the word "family," the team members were stunned.
Speaking of which, due to high-intensity battles, they have had very little contact with their families.
Of course, when they had time, they would often keep in touch with their families.
After all, with the system’s existence, calls and videos are very convenient.
Now hearing Han Xing mention it, their hearts stirred with a different kind of emotion.
They missed their families.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said, "Brother Xing, what about you?"
Han Xing laughed, "Of course, I have things to do too."
"I’ll go see how much Ancient Spirit Wood Lanlan and the others have collected for me, then take a look at the current operations of Xingyu City."
Upon hearing this, the team members all nodded in understanding.
Then, they all stepped into the High-Level Teleportation Array above Ten Thousand Stars City.
Five figures flashed.
In less than a second, the system alert appeared.
[You have arrived at the Witch Race Territory...]
Everyone couldn’t help but marvel at the speed...

chapters.title: Chapter 827 - 449: SS-level Talent: Human Emperor’s Destiny Loaded...
paragraphs: Han Xing said, "You all go reunite with your families, they are in the city center area, I’ll notify you if there’s anything."
The team members exchanged glances, then nodded one by one.
They indeed missed their families very much.
The next moment, the five of them vanished from where they stood.
As for Han Xing, he walked unhurriedly along the streets of Xingyu City.
Now, Xingyu City has already integrated into the Witch Race Continent.
On the Witch Race Continent, among the thousands of cities, Xingyu City is considered the most unique.
Because it’s built by all the Witch Race People, constructed by that man, with a large number of Human Race living here.
And Han Xing, looking at the tall buildings on both sides and the clean, tidy streets, nodded in satisfaction.
Today’s Xingyu City looks more and more like a city on Blue Star.
It’s filled with all sorts of modern architecture.
Moreover, what shocked Han Xing even more was seeing many humans carrying babies on the street.
If it were on Blue Star, this would be a very usual sight.
But to know, this is the Otherworld.
In these four years, the human population has shown no growth.
On top of that, it has been continuously declining.
You must know, Human Race Survivors exploring those Sky Islands have a chance of encountering those powerful monsters.
Once in battle, no one can guarantee that they won’t be injured or killed.
Following the Blood Tide disaster, the human population dropped to three billion.
After three years of exploration and development, it has dropped to over two billion.
If this pace continues, it won’t be long before there are very few humans left.
The appearance of infants represents the continuation of the Fire of Civilization.
At that moment, Han Xing felt something different in his heart.
Although his initial purpose for building Xingyu City was to gather player resources.
But now, it must be said, Xingyu City has indeed made an irreplaceable contribution to the continuation of human civilization.
And has also become a cradle for nurturing life.
A sudden system notification appeared.
[You feel deeply about human history, realizing that individual Power ultimately reflects back on the entire civilization...]
[In the scale of time, perhaps we are all insignificant, but as long as Life can continue, the Fire of Civilization will remain eternal...]
[SS-level Talent: Human Emperor’s Destiny has been loaded...]
Seeing this system notification, Han Xing was stunned for a moment.
Speaking of which, it’s not the first time he’s heard the name Human Emperor’s Destiny.
Including back on the Path of the Giant Dragon, where a group of Giant Dragons also said they would leave the opportunities to those with the Human Emperor’s Destiny.
It’s just that the Human Emperor’s Destiny talent was on Zhou Huang.
Han Xing checked the Attributes Introduction of this new talent.

[Talent: Human Emperor’s Destiny (SS), the activator of this talent becomes a candidate for this generation’s Human Emperor, Luck Value increases by 50, Experience Acquisition Speed increases by 30%, each time approaching Cloud Sky Island, can see the internal conditions through the clouds.]
"This thing... is Zhou Huang’s talent?"
Han Xing was surprised for a moment, then shook his head and said, "It’s very strong, but unfortunately, it’s too late..."
"This talent might have been very helpful to me in the early stages, but now, only the Luck Value +50 is useful to me."
It can be imagined, if Han Xing had simultaneously possessed two talents at the start, his development speed would have skyrocketed like a rocket.
However, now its effect on him is not significant.
The system probably wouldn’t have thought that Zhou Huang, who had been greatly anticipated, would eventually become an ordinary person and even remain missing to this day.
But looking at the four years since the Human Race descended into this world.
If it weren’t for Han Xing, Zhou Huang might not have been able to lead the Human Race to survive until now.
Especially considering the first Blood Tide disaster, if it weren’t for Han Xing’s heavy firepower bombardment and his sacrifice to stop the Legendary Level Evil God Commander.
The number of human casualties would definitely not have been just this amount.
"Forget it, thinking about these things now doesn’t serve any purpose.
Han Xing shook his head and continued walking towards the city center of Xingyu City.
Soon, he arrived at a skyscraper, hundreds of meters high, its surface made of black explosion-proof glass, warships flying in the air, exuding a sense of Technology.
There was a star logo above it.
Here used to be the Lord’s Mansion of Xingyu City.
After being transformed by Lanlan and others, it became a landmark building of Xingyu City.
"That little girl, she’s really quickly turning Xingyu City into another Blue Star."
Han Xing chuckled, then walked into the Lord’s Mansion.
Upon entering, he saw a dense crowd of people.
Inside, it was bustling with noises, and there were various service windows.
Groups of Survivors wearing all sorts of Equipment were lining up here, feeling quite out of place.
They were all handling various procedures, such as house property rights, shop transfer procedures, and so on...
Most of Xingyu City’s affairs are processed here.
Of course, as it was too busy here, there were no spare reception personnel.
Even with Han Xing’s presence, no one noticed.
However, Han Xing didn’t mind this.
He thought to himself, "Lanlan’s office seems to be on the seventy-something floor."
"I’ll go find her myself then."
Then, Han Xing directly walked to the Witch Race lift device nearby.
This was the Lord’s Mansion’s elevator, and inside the elevator there were buttons for over a hundred floors.
However, only the lower thirty-something floors are open to the public.
And from the 35th floor upwards, access requires authorization.
As the owner of Xingyu City, Han Xing naturally has the highest authorization.

[Talent: Human Emperor’s Destiny (SS), the activator of this talent becomes a candidate for this generation’s Human Emperor, Luck Value increases by 50, Experience Acquisition Speed increases by 30%, each time approaching Cloud Sky Island, can see the internal conditions through the clouds.]
"This thing... is Zhou Huang’s talent?"
Han Xing was surprised for a moment, then shook his head and said, "It’s very strong, but unfortunately, it’s too late..."
"This talent might have been very helpful to me in the early stages, but now, only the Luck Value +50 is useful to me."
It can be imagined, if Han Xing had simultaneously possessed two talents at the start, his development speed would have skyrocketed like a rocket.
However, now its effect on him is not significant.
The system probably wouldn’t have thought that Zhou Huang, who had been greatly anticipated, would eventually become an ordinary person and even remain missing to this day.
But looking at the four years since the Human Race descended into this world.
If it weren’t for Han Xing, Zhou Huang might not have been able to lead the Human Race to survive until now.
Especially considering the first Blood Tide disaster, if it weren’t for Han Xing’s heavy firepower bombardment and his sacrifice to stop the Legendary Level Evil God Commander.
The number of human casualties would definitely not have been just this amount.
"Forget it, thinking about these things now doesn’t serve any purpose.
Han Xing shook his head and continued walking towards the city center of Xingyu City.
Soon, he arrived at a skyscraper, hundreds of meters high, its surface made of black explosion-proof glass, warships flying in the air, exuding a sense of Technology.
There was a star logo above it.
Here used to be the Lord’s Mansion of Xingyu City.
After being transformed by Lanlan and others, it became a landmark building of Xingyu City.
"That little girl, she’s really quickly turning Xingyu City into another Blue Star."
Han Xing chuckled, then walked into the Lord’s Mansion.
Upon entering, he saw a dense crowd of people.
Inside, it was bustling with noises, and there were various service windows.
Groups of Survivors wearing all sorts of Equipment were lining up here, feeling quite out of place.
They were all handling various procedures, such as house property rights, shop transfer procedures, and so on...
Most of Xingyu City’s affairs are processed here.
Of course, as it was too busy here, there were no spare reception personnel.
Even with Han Xing’s presence, no one noticed.
However, Han Xing didn’t mind this.
He thought to himself, "Lanlan’s office seems to be on the seventy-something floor."
"I’ll go find her myself then."
Then, Han Xing directly walked to the Witch Race lift device nearby.
This was the Lord’s Mansion’s elevator, and inside the elevator there were buttons for over a hundred floors.
However, only the lower thirty-something floors are open to the public.
And from the 35th floor upwards, access requires authorization.
As the owner of Xingyu City, Han Xing naturally has the highest authorization.

chapters.title: Chapter 828 - 449: SS-level Talent: Human Emperor’s Destiny Loaded..._2
paragraphs: He directly pressed the button for the 79th floor.
The Witch Race elevator device quickly lifted Han Xing into the air.
Soon, the elevator door reopened.
In front of Han Xing appeared a beautifully decorated corridor.
And at the end of the corridor, there was the door to an office.
Han Xing walked straight over.
He pushed open the office door and saw a familiar figure inside, it was Lanlan.
At this moment, Lanlan was wearing a black uniform, with glasses, buried in a pile of documents.
She seemed to be in a focused working state.
Even when Han Xing came in, she didn’t notice.
Han Xing noticed that after so long without seeing, Lanlan had gained a unique aura.
It was a cold and mature aura.
At this moment, sensing someone approaching, Lanlan put down the documents in her hand.
Without lifting her head, she said: "Don’t you know you should knock before coming in?"
Those who can reach this level of Xingyu City are all her close acquaintances.
Here, Lanlan does not feel that an outsider would intrude into her office and try to harm her.
Han Xing still said nothing, looking at this little girl who had now become so mature, a smile of interest appeared on his face.
At this moment.
Seeing the other party still not speaking, Lanlan slightly frowned.
She lifted her head, somewhat complaining.
"Mu Qing, you..."
Halfway through her speech, when she noticed the man’s figure, her initial confusion instantly turned into intense surprise.
"Ah! Lord!!!" Lanlan suddenly exclaimed.
She suddenly stood up from her office chair and excitedly rushed to Han Xing’s front.
"Tap tap tap!"
The high heels clattered on the floor, making a tapping sound.
Lanlan instinctively opened her arms, seemingly wanting to make a hugging action.
However, when she was still a meter away from Han Xing, Lanlan stopped.
Because she suddenly realized that her relationship with Han Xing was not yet this intimate.
Her outstretched hands halted in mid-air, appearing somewhat at a loss.
Especially her youthful little face, it was as red as an apple.
Lanlan shyly said: "Lord... Lord... I’m too excited, I, I’m sorry..."
Han Xing smiled at this, and proactively opened his arms to hug Lanlan.
Suddenly being hugged, Lanlan’s brain went completely blank.
Lanlan, standing at a height of over 160 cm, seemed somewhat petite being held in Han Xing’s arms.
This was a scene she had fantasized about countless times.
Now it had actually come true!
At this moment, Lanlan felt like she was in a dream.
She lifted her dazed eyes, looked at Han Xing and said: "Lord... Lord... Am I not awake yet?"
"Although I often dream of such a scene."
"But I never thought there would actually be a day like this..."
Han Xing, embracing her, feeling the slight trembling of the petite body in his arms, chuckled: "You’re not dreaming."
Lanlan, upon hearing this, softly said: "Then could you hold me a little longer?"
She tentatively asked.
Han Xing chuckled: "Of course, this time I plan to stay a few extra days."
"That’s wonderful..."
Lanlan murmured, the arms around Han Xing’s waist hugged him tighter.
A few minutes later.
Han Xing could clearly sense that the body of the beautiful woman before him was gently heating up.
Moments later,
She lifted her head, gazing at Han Xing with a dazed look in her eyes.
Seeing the longing in the girl’s eyes.
Han Xing felt like something was stirring within his heart.
Then, he directly kissed her.
At this moment, Lanlan’s body twitched like she was being electrocuted.
The temperature in the whole office gradually rose.
More than ten minutes later, Han Xing directly picked her up in a princess carry, his eyes somewhat fiery.
Lanlan seemed to understand what was about to happen next, and she buried her head deeply into Han Xing’s chest.
At this moment, she spoke like a mosquito: "Lord... Lord..."
"There’s a sofa in the office..."
Han Xing, upon hearing this, also saw the spacious sofa next to them.
Then, Han Xing gently placed her on the sofa.
Before long, the office was filled with the sounds of breathing.
This was Lanlan’s private office, very few people came here ordinarily.
Two hours later...
Lanlan, soft and boneless, nestled in Han Xing’s arms.
Her young face showing unprecedented satisfaction and blush.
"Lord..." Lanlan sighed softly.
"Hmm."
Han Xing stroked her delicate and smooth back.
Seemingly the first time being in such close contact with a man, each time Han Xing stroked her she would tremble slightly.
At this time Han Xing said: "You’ve worked hard during this period, Lanlan."
Lanlan, upon hearing this, lifted her dreamy eyes, and said seriously: "It’s not hard at all!"
"Serving the Lord is my honor."
"Although, sometimes it’s quite tiring, hehe..."
"However, whenever I think about the Lord seeing the fruits of my efforts, I feel very satisfied."
Han Xing, upon hearing this, hugged her tightly.
"Thank you."
Lanlan shook her head, "Lord... In the future, when you have time, could you visit Lanlan more often?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment then nodded: "No problem, I’ll build a teleportation array near the Lord’s Mansion later, that way I can come by anytime."
Lanlan, upon hearing this, instantly laughed happily.
"Any other requests?"
"Hmm hmm!" Lanlan nodded like a pecking chick.
She looked at Han Xing, then showing a little demon-like smile, said: "That is, to do it again."
Han Xing, hearing this request, was taken aback.
"Ah? Are you sure?"
"It’s your first time..."

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - 449: SS-level Talent: Human Emperor’s Destiny Loaded..._3
paragraphs: Lanlan chuckled, "Don’t worry, my Lord..."
"No matter what, I’m a level 40 Fourth Transformation powerhouse, you know, my constitution is really strong."
Han Xing listened and a smile appeared on his face.
Then nodded and said, "Alright."
For nearly the whole day, the two of them stayed in the office without going out.
Han Xing was surprised by the young girl’s desire.
It was as if she was releasing all her emotions from the past few years.
Her repeated demands seemed tireless.
If Han Xing hadn’t already been a High-tier Legend,
with an ordinary person’s constitution, he really couldn’t have withstood it.
Even so, Han Xing felt waves of paleness on his face.
It wasn’t until the next day that Lanlan reluctantly left Han Xing after receiving a message.
Watching the girl’s back, Han Xing couldn’t help but feel a bit dazed.
At this moment, Lanlan, fully dressed, turned around with a sly smile and said, "My Lord, quickly get dressed~"
"Sister Mu Mu is coming over in a bit."
Upon hearing that Tangxin Mumu was coming, Han Xing hurriedly sat up from the couch and quickly dressed.
Then swiftly tidied up their chaotic battlefield.
A few minutes later.
The sound of knocking came from outside the door.
Lanlan slightly raised her head, and softly said, "Come in, Sister Mu Mu."
The office door slowly opened.
Then, a familiar silhouette walked in from outside.
It was indeed Tangxin Mumu.
Today, Tangxin Mumu wore a red dress, with an emerald necklace around her neck, exuding elegance.
Although, it had been three years since the last meeting with Tangxin Mumu.
But Han Xing discovered, that this woman’s appearance was as unchanged as before,
as if her beauty remained eternal.
This was because, after humans in this world began accessing Extraordinary Power, they also gained longer lifespans.
Even a Tier Two Professional could easily live over two hundred years without accidents.
The lifespan of Tier Four Professionals had already exceeded eight hundred years.
And for Legendary Professionals like Han Xing, living for several millennia was no exaggeration.
As previously mentioned.
Even though this world was dangerous, bringing pain to humans, even an existential crisis.
But likewise, it brought opportunities to the surviving humans.
Longevity was just one of them.
After seeing Han Xing, a look of delight appeared in Tangxin Mumu’s eyes.
"Star God."
Han Xing nodded and said, "I heard from Lanlan that you wanted to see me, is there something you need?"
Upon hearing this question, Tangxin Mumu blushed slightly.
In fact, she sought out Han Xing without any particular reason, just simply wanting to meet him.
But of course, she couldn’t just say that directly now.
So, Tangxin Mumu softly said, "It’s like this, because now the All Gods Daily has been merged into Xingyu City, I wanted to interview the Star God again, to increase the publication’s popularity."
"May I?"
Han Xing nodded, "Of course, no problem. Tomorrow, I’ll find some time to go to your All Gods Daily."
Tangxin Mumu was immediately overjoyed.
"That’s great, Star God!"
She excitedly said, "The All Gods Daily always welcomes the Star God."
Lanlan also showed an expression of joy.
Then, the atmosphere suddenly grew a bit silent.
The three present didn’t speak, not knowing what to say.
At this moment, Lanlan’s face inexplicably turned red.
Tangxin Mumu looked at the two with curiosity.
After a moment, she softly said, "Lanlan little sister, Star God, the All Gods Daily still has work awaiting me, so I won’t stay much longer."
Before Han Xing could speak.
Lanlan promptly said, "Alright!"
She seemed eager to have Tangxin Mumu leave quickly.
And Tangxin Mumu, noticing Lanlan’s unusual state today, didn’t think much of it.
After all, she was still immersed in the joy of seeing Han Xing.
With a delighted expression, Tangxin Mumu left Lanlan’s office.
As the door closed, a passionate fire rekindled in Lanlan’s eyes.
She eagerly said, "My Lord, let’s continue~"
Han Xing was genuinely impressed by this young girl.
It was like she had flipped some kind of switch!
She wouldn’t stop until she drained Han Xing dry!
However, driven by his male pride, Han Xing couldn’t give up so easily.
So, Han Xing nodded and said, "Bring it on."
Soon, the office was filled with the sound of heavy breathing again.
Meanwhile, Tangxin Mumu had just arrived at the elevator.
With the hearing of a level 45 Professional, no matter how good the office’s soundproofing was, she could clearly hear what was happening inside.
At this moment, Tangxin Mumu’s heart quivered.
She thought in disbelief, "That sound..."
"It can’t be... Lanlan and the Star God..."
"Impossible... Impossible..."
Tangxin Mumu shook her head hastily, even instinctively wanting to move away from there.
But the curiosity inside her made her stay.
After a few more seconds, Tangxin Mumu confirmed her suspicions.
"Oh my god, it’s actually true!"
"When did Lanlan..."
Tangxin Mumu stood in place.
The more she listened, the more her face reddened, even causing her legs to feel weak.
Realizing what was happening, she quickly took the elevator and left.
Two days later...
Han Xing dazedly left Lanlan’s office.
Although they initially agreed on just one day, the young girl persistently wouldn’t let Han Xing leave.
He even had to postpone the promised interview with Tangxin Mumu.
If Han Xing hadn’t found an excuse, saying Cheng Jianyong and the others needed him.
The young girl might still have refused to let go of him,
As the door finally closed, Lanlan’s unsatisfied gaze lingered in Han Xing’s memory.

chapters.title: Chapter 830 - 450: Awakening the World Tree Again
paragraphs: After leaving the office on the 79th floor.
Han Xing arrived at the central residential area of Xingyu City.
Here stood a luxurious villa district with elaborate designs.
Nearby, numerous Wolf Cavalry units were patrolling.
Although it’s impossible for anyone to cause trouble in Xingyu City, this place is also the safest.
The families of Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others were settled here.
Han Xing entered the villa district entrance.
Several Wolf Cavalry members at the gate respectfully saluted Han Xing.
"Greetings, Lord!"
Han Xing nodded, then walked straight in.
Once inside, an ancient and elegant scene unfolded.
Various pavilions and gardens exuded an Oriental charm.
The villas inside were all structures similar to courtyards.
The houses here had reached astronomical prices.
Even many leaders of large teams couldn’t afford them.
Only business magnates who had quickly expanded their businesses to a certain scale in a few years were qualified to move in here.
Entering this villa district was also a symbol of status.
When discussing business with others, it gave more confidence,
Along the way, Han Xing saw many survivors’ families leisurely strolling inside.
Of course, those living here were all high-quality people.
It’s impossible for someone not to recognize Han Xing and come out to embarrass themselves.
However, when they looked at Han Xing, there was a peculiar look in their eyes.
They felt he looked familiar.
But because it was too astounding, they found it hard to believe.
Han Xing remained low-key and continued walking through the garden area.
Soon, he arrived at a spacious yard.
People were coming and going at the entrance.
At this moment, Shen Yun had long been waiting there.
Seeing Han Xing, Shen Yun excitedly came up to him: "Brother Xing, you finally made it!"
"Everything is ready, just waiting for you."
Han Xing smiled, "Well, here I am."
Hearing this, Shen Yun also smiled.
Then he led Han Xing inside.
After entering the yard, a large table of sumptuous feast was already set.
Sitting inside were all familiar faces.
Among them were the families of Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun.
There were also the families of Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
Shen Yun had specifically gathered them together to express gratitude to Han Xing.
This was the consensus of all of them.
Now, seeing Han Xing arrive,
everyone stood up simultaneously, eyes filled with gratitude.
Shen Yun’s father, a middle-aged man looking around forty to fifty years old with a classic square face,
stood up first upon seeing Han Xing and said: "Let me say a few words first. Today, for everyone to be able to gather here, it’s all thanks to Xiao Xing’s efforts!"
"If it weren’t for Xiao Xing, we might have already perished in the mouths of those monsters."
"And now, we can peacefully sit here, living a life even better than on Blue Star."
"Let’s all raise a glass to Xiao Xing!"
As he finished speaking, everyone stood up one after another, raising their glasses high.
Han Xing was somewhat stunned by their formality.
He hadn’t realized that when Shen Yun invited him for a meal, this was the intention.
Shaking his head, Han Xing lifted his glass and smiled, "No need to be so formal, uncles and aunties."
After some exchanges of niceties, everyone began toasting.
The atmosphere around the table became increasingly lively.
The elders took turns toasting Han Xing.
Han Xing didn’t refuse any of them.
The banquet lasted for more than two hours.
After everyone had their fill, they gradually dispersed.
Leaving only Han Xing, Cheng Jianyong, and Shen Yun.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong, drunkenly leaning on Shen Yun’s shoulder, kept mumbling nonsense.
Shen Yun patted his face and said, "Don’t mind him, Brother Xing. This guy hasn’t seen his daughter in a long time, and he’s too excited this time."
Han Xing laughed, "Of course I know."
"This guy is pretending. He’s almost breaking through to Demigod, and there’s no way any alcohol could actually get him drunk."
Being exposed in public, Cheng Jianyong wasn’t angry but instead laughed and said, "Brother Xing, you don’t understand, this is what we call getting drunk without alcohol."
"This time, seeing my daughter has grown taller, you can’t imagine how gratified this old father’s heart is."
Everyone else laughed as they heard this.
Then, Shen Yun suddenly asked, "Speaking of which, Brother Xing, do you have any plans next?"
Han Xing nodded.
"Next, we need to go to the Elf Realm once, this time Lanlan has collected more than forty thousand pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood for me, which will allow me to power up again."
"Then, I’ll ask that Old Tree if there is any quick way to increase Divine Power Value."
"We must also put breaking through to Demigod on our agenda as soon as possible, otherwise, there’s no way to deal with True God level beings."
Han Xing’s tone involuntarily carried a bit of heaviness.
Although he always acted nonchalant,
the True God level’s formidable combat power, as spoken by that Old Tree last time, indeed placed great pressure on Han Xing.
Based on his current Powers, even with Ten Thousand Stars City, he was still some distance from True God.
The more terrifying thing is, a True God also has the trait of infinite resurrection.
Therefore, he urgently needs to break through to Demigod, and for the entire team to break through to Demigod!
Otherwise, if a True God descends, not only Han Xing and the others could not withstand it.
The Holy Spirit Realm and even the Human Race would face an existential threat.
Currently, within the Human Race, besides Han Xing and the others, there is hardly anyone noteworthy.

sentences.text: After leaving the office on the 79th floor.
Han Xing arrived at the central residential area of Xingyu City.
Here stood a luxurious villa district with elaborate designs.
Nearby, numerous Wolf Cavalry units were patrolling.
Although it’s impossible for anyone to cause trouble in Xingyu City, this place is also the safest.
The families of Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others were settled here.
Han Xing entered the villa district entrance.
Several Wolf Cavalry members at the gate respectfully saluted Han Xing.
"Greetings, Lord!"
Han Xing nodded, then walked straight in.
Once inside, an ancient and elegant scene unfolded.
Various pavilions and gardens exuded an Oriental charm.
The villas inside were all structures similar to courtyards.
The houses here had reached astronomical prices.
Even many leaders of large teams couldn’t afford them.
Only business magnates who had quickly expanded their businesses to a certain scale in a few years were qualified to move in here.
Entering this villa district was also a symbol of status.
When discussing business with others, it gave more confidence,
Along the way, Han Xing saw many survivors’ families leisurely strolling inside.
Of course, those living here were all high-quality people.
It’s impossible for someone not to recognize Han Xing and come out to embarrass themselves.
However, when they looked at Han Xing, there was a peculiar look in their eyes.
They felt he looked familiar.
But because it was too astounding, they found it hard to believe.
Han Xing remained low-key and continued walking through the garden area.
Soon, he arrived at a spacious yard.
People were coming and going at the entrance.
At this moment, Shen Yun had long been waiting there.
Seeing Han Xing, Shen Yun excitedly came up to him: "Brother Xing, you finally made it!"
"Everything is ready, just waiting for you."
Han Xing smiled, "Well, here I am."
Hearing this, Shen Yun also smiled.
Then he led Han Xing inside.
After entering the yard, a large table of sumptuous feast was already set.
Sitting inside were all familiar faces.
Among them were the families of Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun.
There were also the families of Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
Shen Yun had specifically gathered them together to express gratitude to Han Xing.
This was the consensus of all of them.
Now, seeing Han Xing arrive,
everyone stood up simultaneously, eyes filled with gratitude.
Shen Yun’s father, a middle-aged man looking around forty to fifty years old with a classic square face,
stood up first upon seeing Han Xing and said: "Let me say a few words first.
Today, for everyone to be able to gather here, it’s all thanks to Xiao Xing’s efforts!"
"If it weren’t for Xiao Xing, we might have already perished in the mouths of those monsters."
"And now, we can peacefully sit here, living a life even better than on Blue Star."
"Let’s all raise a glass to Xiao Xing!"
As he finished speaking, everyone stood up one after another, raising their glasses high.
Han Xing was somewhat stunned by their formality.
He hadn’t realized that when Shen Yun invited him for a meal, this was the intention.
Shaking his head, Han Xing lifted his glass and smiled, "No need to be so formal, uncles and aunties."
After some exchanges of niceties, everyone began toasting.
The atmosphere around the table became increasingly lively.
The elders took turns toasting Han Xing.
Han Xing didn’t refuse any of them.
The banquet lasted for more than two hours.
After everyone had their fill, they gradually dispersed.
Leaving only Han Xing, Cheng Jianyong, and Shen Yun.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong, drunkenly leaning on Shen Yun’s shoulder, kept mumbling nonsense.
Shen Yun patted his face and said, "Don’t mind him, Brother Xing.
This guy hasn’t seen his daughter in a long time, and he’s too excited this time."
Han Xing laughed, "Of course I know."
"This guy is pretending.
He’s almost breaking through to Demigod, and there’s no way any alcohol could actually get him drunk."
Being exposed in public, Cheng Jianyong wasn’t angry but instead laughed and said, "Brother Xing, you don’t understand, this is what we call getting drunk without alcohol."
"This time, seeing my daughter has grown taller, you can’t imagine how gratified this old father’s heart is."
Everyone else laughed as they heard this.
Then, Shen Yun suddenly asked, "Speaking of which, Brother Xing, do you have any plans next?"
Han Xing nodded.
"Next, we need to go to the Elf Realm once, this time Lanlan has collected more than forty thousand pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood for me, which will allow me to power up again."
"Then, I’ll ask that Old Tree if there is any quick way to increase Divine Power Value."
"We must also put breaking through to Demigod on our agenda as soon as possible, otherwise, there’s no way to deal with True God level beings."
Han Xing’s tone involuntarily carried a bit of heaviness.
Although he always acted nonchalant,
the True God level’s formidable combat power, as spoken by that Old Tree last time, indeed placed great pressure on Han Xing.
Based on his current Powers, even with Ten Thousand Stars City, he was still some distance from True God.

Otherwise, if a True God descends, not only Han Xing and the others could not withstand it.
The Holy Spirit Realm and even the Human Race would face an existential threat.
Currently, within the Human Race, besides Han Xing and the others, there is hardly anyone noteworthy.

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - 450: Awakening the World Tree Again (Part 2)
paragraphs: Once Han Xing and others are defeated.
By then, the Xingyu City he painstakingly built, and even the Witch Race Continent, will be easily destroyed.
The familiar people he was just joking with here will also die like ants.
So, beneath the seemingly peaceful surface,
Han Xing and others are actually bearing the pressure of the Human Race and Witch Race.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun both heard the seriousness in Han Xing’s tone.
Shen Yun patted Han Xing’s shoulder and said, "Don’t worry, Brother Xing, we’re here."
"If a True God-level being really descends, we’ll face it together, and if we can’t handle it, we’ll go down together."
Cheng Jianyong also patted his chest and said, "That’s right, Brother Xing!"
"When people die, birds fly to the sky!"
"I, Old Cheng, have lived a fulfilling life these four years."
"If I can take down a True God before dying, it wouldn’t be for nothing!"
Hearing this, Han Xing shook his head with a smile and said,
"It’s not that serious, although we can’t deal with a True God now, the Old Tree also said it’s not that easy for them to come over."
"However, next, we must seize the time to crazily enhance our strength."
The three nodded solemnly together.
Next.
Han Xing first went to the All Gods Daily.
After a simple interview, Han Xing took his team and returned to the Elf Realm.
With a flash, everyone returned to the Ten Thousand Stars.
[You have arrived in the Elf Realm.]
Seeing the system prompt, the team members knew that the rare holiday was over.
The first thing to do upon returning was naturally to consume the Ancient Spirit Wood and convert it into battle power.
Then, Han Xing glanced at his backpack.
[Ancient Spirit Wood]: 42132.
Han Xing pondered, "With this much Spirit Wood, calculating one Blessing per ten thousand Spirit Wood, it means I can increase 800,000 Life Value and 4000 Divine Power points.
Han Xing looked again at his Divine Power Value attributes.
[Divine Power Value]: 24781.
"Still too far from 200,000, it seems after this Blessing, I need to visit the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots."
"That guy has lived so long, he should know some quick ways to increase Divine Power Value."
Thinking of this.
Han Xing headed straight to the center of the Elf Realm.
The current Elf Realm was filled with many extremely powerful auras.
And these auras were very ancient.
They were all top-tier warriors hidden among various races, all emerged after the last Ten Thousand Races Conference.
Now, these warriors were all guarding the central area of the Elf Realm, ready at any time for the appearance of Demon Gods from the Abyss Realm.
Han Xing found one among them whose aura seemed slightly younger and full of sanctity.
From this aura, everyone knew that it was the Elf King.
Then, Han Xing flew directly to where the Elf King was.
The current Elf King was reviewing various materials in his Royal Palace, including recent Elf Race battle losses and Abyss Realm intelligence.
Feeling Han Xing’s aura, the Elf King seemed a bit surprised.
But he still waved out a Divine Power to bring Han Xing over.
Since the last time demonic gods invaded the royal capital, the Elf Race had learned a lesson.
Now all the civilians in the royal capital have been moved to safe places, and layers of restrictions covered the top.
Even middle-tier Demigods coming in could not escape.
Han Xing and his group naturally also felt the Power of Restriction around them.
Cheng Jianyong marveled, "The Elf Race has some skills, to be able to set such a level of restriction, even encompassing the entire royal capital.
"As long as it’s not a Demon God-level enemy invading, the royal capital basically won’t encounter unexpected situations."
Everyone nodded.
After a while, they found the Elf King sitting amidst a forest.
"Saint Master Han Xing, long time no see."
"How’s the battle situation in the area you are responsible for recently?"
Han Xing nodded, "Not bad, recently the Abyss Realm invasions have not been that frequent, my subordinates have suppressed them all."
"Your Majesty the Elf King, I came this time with something to ask of you."
Hearing Han Xing’s purpose, the Elf King’s handsome features suddenly showed surprise.
He said with some uncertainty, "Saint Master Han Xing, are you saying you have gathered over forty thousand pieces of Spirit Wood again and need to awaken the World Tree?"
"Yes."
The Elf King’s eyes showed intense shock!
How long has it been since the last awakening of the World Tree?
Not even two months, right?
In such a short time, he managed to collect over forty thousand pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood again!
At this rate, it wouldn’t take long for the World Tree to fully recover!
Seemingly seeing the thoughts in the Elf King’s mind, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Your Majesty the Elf King, you misunderstood."
"This kind of Spirit Wood is already very difficult to collect now, to let the World Tree absorb a large amount again might take a very long time."
He was telling the truth.
Currently among human Survivors, the vast majority of Ancient Spirit Wood has been collected by Han Xing.
And the production of Ancient Spirit Wood only appears in the Bright Moon Treasure Chest.
In the absence of a battle merit ranking currently, for human Survivors to obtain new Ancient Spirit Wood, they must explore wild Sky Islands and rely on luck to find it.
The Elf King listened, thoughtfully nodding his head.
He also knew that such precious Spirit Wood could be encountered but not sought after.
It is impossible to fully restore the World Tree in such a short time.
But forty thousand Ancient Spirit Wood is already worth him holding another revival ritual.

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - 450: Awakening the World Tree Again (3)
paragraphs: Then, the Elf King said, "Alright, Saint Master Han Xing, please follow me."
After saying this, the Elf King led Han Xing directly out of the Royal Capital.
A group of six was swiftly flying through the air, and soon arrived at the forbidden land of the Elf Race.
The forbidden land remained shrouded by a cloud layer.
Passing through the cloud layer, their vision was once again filled with that sacred and dazzling golden light.
They couldn’t help but raise their heads, gazing in awe at the holy golden tree.
Regardless of how many times they’ve seen it.
Each time they came before this Golden Holy Tree, an undeniable sense of reverence arose within.
"Saint Master Han Xing, please wait for a moment. I’ve already asked my daughter to start preparing for the awakening ceremony," the Elf King said.
Han Xing nodded and stood still with the other team members, waiting.
Because not long ago, they had just awakened the World Tree once.
Therefore, this awakening ceremony wasn’t too complicated.
In the sky, a stunningly beautiful silhouette flew out from the sea of clouds.
Following her were groups of elves.
Leading them was Elinora.
The Elf Goddess still exuded a holy aura.
Her simple attire enveloped an impressive figure.
Elinora softly sang, "Merciful Mother Tree~"
The other elves joined in singing.
The familiar song rang out again...
After a simple ceremony, the branches and leaves of the World Tree gently swayed.
This indicated that the will of the World Tree had awakened.
Seeing her task completed successfully, a gentle smile appeared on Elinora’s face.
"Saint Master Han Xing, you may proceed," the voice of the Elf King sounded once again.
Han Xing nodded and then adeptly walked towards the World Tree.
However, as he passed by Elinora, the woman radiating sacred aura couldn’t help but lower her head.
Apparently feeling quite shy facing Han Xing.
Han Xing paid no mind and went straight to the side of the World Tree.
After placing down pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood, the World Tree quickly absorbed them.
Once ten thousand pieces were absorbed, a golden blessing force appeared on Han Xing’s body.
[Due to receiving the World Tree’s life blessing, Life Force +20000, Divine Power Value +100...]
[Due to receiving the World Tree’s life blessing, Life Force +20000, Divine Power Value +100...]
When the first blessing ended, his aura significantly increased again.
After four times.
Han Xing’s Divine Power Value had already reached 29000, about to break through the thirty-thousand threshold!
The rise in Divine Power Value is extremely difficult, a fact acknowledged by everyone.
For most high-tier legends, Divine Power Value hardly reaches 5000.
Initial-tier demigods usually have Divine Power Value of over ten thousand.
Middle-tier demigods generally range from twenty to thirty thousand.
As for high-tier demigods and those like the Elf King, top demigods, it rarely exceeds one hundred thousand.
It’s known that powerhouses like the Elf King have been stuck in the Demigod Realm for at least centuries or even millennia.
Even so, their Divine Power Value is only at these figures.
So, what the ancient tree said about having a twenty thousand Divine Power Value at the Legendary Realm is indeed absurd.
However, Han Xing has already resolved that he must condense his own Divine Format to breakthrough to demigod!
Compared to the pressure in Han Xing’s heart.
The elves, looking at the increasingly vigorous World Tree, couldn’t help but show expressions of relief.
The Elf King flew to Han Xing’s side and laughed, "Saint Master Han Xing, thanks to you again."
"I’ll have someone go to the Elf Race treasury to check the materials."
"See what’s needed most, and I’ll have someone help prioritize collecting them."
Due to a previous agreement with the Elf King.
One Spirit Wood exchanged for corresponding materials, such as the Philosopher’s Stone, Shimmering Terra Stone, etc.
At this moment, Han Xing wanted to say, I lack everything.
Ever since the last construction of the Divine Demon Battleship and the large-scale erection of Defense Towers, his material reserves have almost run dry.
If not for regaining some resources in the Monsoon Islands.
Han Xing’s dream of stockpiling would have long since shattered.
So, Han Xing directly said, "Elf King, just collect them according to the previous ratio for me."
The Elf King listened and nodded, "Okay."
The matter here concluded.
Han Xing directly bid farewell to the Elf King and Elinora.
Then, he led his team to search for the location of the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots in the Elf Realm.
After inquiring about the coordinates from other powerful beings from different races, Han Xing directly led his group flying there.
From afar, they saw a vast Sky Island brimming with green.
Towering ancient trees soaring tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands of meters high were growing atop.
These giants, undoubtedly Legendary Ancient Trees of the Sky Island Forest.
This time, the Sky Island Forest came to support, bringing with them half of the legendary powerhouses of their tribe.
Amidst this cluster of ancient trees, there stood one which soared tens of thousands of meters, with its top unseen.
This ancient tree was naturally the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
Han Xing and his group controlled their divine power to fly over, directly across this Sky Island’s sky.
As if passing through patches of primitive forest.
Those Legendary Level ancient trees naturally sensed Han Xing and his group’s presence.
Although curious, they recognized Han Xing, hence no ancient tree came out to stop them.
Soon, Han Xing’s group arrived at the center of the Sky Island.
At the same time, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots had long discovered them.
Seeing Han Xing approaching, this towering ancient tree slowly turned.
The entire Sky Island began a slight trembling once more.
Then, they saw an elderly human face on the trunk of that ancient tree.
This was the embodiment of the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
Compared to the last time they saw it, it looked much better now.
Those originally decaying parts, buzzing with flies and mosquitoes, had all been cleared by the ancient tree.
However, there remained patches of black spots on the trunk...

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - 451: Secrets of the Dark Age
paragraphs: These black spots are the aftermath of the last curse.
"Saint Master Han Xing, what brings you to this old creature?"
Laughter echoed from afar.
Everyone saw a human face with a smile on the trunk of the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was suddenly taken aback and said, "Old Tree, how did you know that I came to see you with a purpose?"

The Ancient Tree chuckled lightly, "Saint Master Han Xing’s ambitions are noble and aimed at accomplishing a feat that could be recorded in history; you surely don’t have time to chat idly with this old creature."
"Indeed, one does not visit unless there’s a particular reason."
Han Xing also laughed, "You’re right."
"Old Tree, I have come to you this time precisely for this matter."
The branches of the Ancient Tree swayed gently.
Han Xing continued to speak.
"Old Tree, according to what you said at the time, my power level is still quite a long way off."
"Seeing it now, how much do you think I still lack?"
The Ancient Tree, upon hearing this, began to seriously observe the aura on Han Xing’s body.
The next moment, the Ancient Tree’s brows showed a look of astonishment.
"Saint Master Han Xing, you are truly remarkable!
"The last time I observed your aura, it was at about one-eighth of the level.
"In just a month, you have reached one-seventh."
Upon hearing the Ancient Tree’s response, Han Xing nodded quietly.
This figure is not far from what he had estimated.
Hence, Han Xing continued to ask, "Old Tree, do you know of any ways to rapidly enhance divine power value?"
"I need to reach the standard divine power value as quickly as possible, the sooner the better!"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s request, the Ancient Tree furrowed its brows slightly, seemingly deep in thought.
"Saint Master Han Xing, let me be frank, your rate of improvement is the most astounding this old creature has ever seen."
"In just four short years, you have grown from an ordinary mortal to your current height, even transforming towards that legendary realm."
"At this rate, even to achieve your target power strength, it would only take a few decades at most."
"Saint Master Han Xing, you can fully accumulate slowly, there’s no need to be this impatient."
A few decades is truly insignificant for those demigod-level strong ones,
especially for something like the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots, whose lifespan is counted in the tens of thousands.
A few decades is just a matter of one sleep.
However, upon hearing this number, Han Xing shook his head, "I know, accumulating slowly can indeed reach the required divine power value."
"But, I can’t wait that long."
"What I need is a method to massively increase the divine power value in a short time."
"Ideally, I could complete it within a few months!"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s request, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots was shocked.
A moment later, it shook its head, "Saint Master Han Xing, you are too impatient."
"You must understand that due to the Holy Spirit Realm’s rule limitations, breaking through the limits cannot be completed overnight."
"Even those two took at least several hundred, if not a thousand years to achieve it."
Han Xing nodded, "I know, Old Tree, but I cannot wait that long."
"Why?" The Ancient Tree inquired in confusion.
Han Xing took a deep breath and instead of answering, asked, "Old Tree, let me ask a question."
"With the current power of the Holy Spirit Realm, dealing with one or two divine spirit-level creatures is no problem."
"But what if a true god descended during this time?"
"What power or existence does the Holy Spirit Realm have to stop a true god?
Upon hearing this question, the Ancient Tree frowned.
A moment later, the branches of the Ancient Tree swayed gently, "To my knowledge, there should be none."
"Some ancient presences cannot act freely due to their age."
Han Xing nodded, "So, if a true god descended at this time, what would the Holy Spirit Realm use to resist?"
This question also plunged the Ancient Tree into contemplation.
"Old Tree, you should know, the strength of the defense towers in my territory can handle divine spirit-level beings."
"But as you said, the power of a true god is dreadfully more terrifying than that of a divine spirit."
"If I cannot possess enough power to deal with them before those true gods arrive, then the Holy Spirit Realm is doomed!"
Han Xing’s expression revealed genuine emotion.
In truth, most of Han Xing’s desire to quickly break through to demigod was for his own and the Human Race’s safety.
Protecting the Holy Spirit Realm was just incidental.

The Ancient Tree fell silent for a moment, then spoke with a heart full of admiration, "Saint Master Han Xing, at such a young age, you’re concerned with the safety of the entire Holy Spirit Realm, you truly are a role model for us all."
"Compared to you, Saint Master Han Xing, this old creature truly feels ashamed!"
The Ancient Tree sighed and then said slowly, "Very well, I will tell you a method. However, this method is extremely risky, Saint Master Han Xing must be fully prepared."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
Does this ancient tree really have one?
It’s truly worthy of a being who has lived for tens of thousands of years, knowing so much.
Thinking of this, Han Xing hastily patted his chest, "Old Tree, go ahead, as for the risks, I’ll weigh them myself."
The Ancient Tree said, "Saint Master Han Xing, being able to break through to this level of divine power value, you must have also mastered many methods of enhancing divine power value."
"Such as cultivation on your own, gradual progress, or absorbing divine power from slaying enemies, just like the demons of the Abyss Realm, directly refining the souls of beings."
Han Xing nodded, he was indeed aware of these methods.
The Ancient Tree continued, "So you should also know, there’s one method that is the quickest to improve, and it’s straightforward and brutal."
"What is it?" Han Xing asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - 451: Dark Age Secrets_2
paragraphs: "Directly devour the Power of Rules on the Divine Format!"
Rumble!
A bolt of thunder crashed down from the sky.
But it was absorbed by the Ancient Tree’s massive branches.
After going through this many times, everyone was already used to the Holy Spirit Realm’s jumpy thunder.
They simply ignored it.
Han Xing frowned slightly.
He of course knew that devouring a Divine Format gave a massive boost in Divine Power.

After all, even a weak God’s Divine Format like the God of Tricks could provide 2000-3000 Divine Power Value. With a few dozen more of those, Han Xing would have already reached a strength of 200,000 Divine Power Value.
The problem was: where was he supposed to find that many Divine Formats to absorb?
The Ancient Tree seemed to see the doubt in Han Xing’s heart.
It continued, "I know a place where there are a great number of Divine Formats, and even complete Power of Rules."
Hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up as they stared straight at the Ancient Tree.
Because the amount of information hidden in that one sentence was enormous.
What are Divine Formats? Things that can let a Legend break through to Demigod!
And complete Power of Rules is enough to let a Demigod break through to Divine Spirit Level!
You have to know how many High-tier Legends and High-tier Demigods in the Holy Spirit Realm are stuck waiting to break through.
All because they haven’t found Divine Formats or complete Power of Rules.
So how terrifying the Ancient Tree’s words were went without saying.
Han Xing couldn’t help asking, "Old Tree, where is that place?"
The team members also pricked up their ears to listen.
The Ancient Tree slowly exhaled. "Saint Master Han Xing, don’t rush. Before I tell you where it is, I need to tell you one more thing."
"And that is the risk that comes with absorbing Divine Formats."
"Risk?" Han Xing was baffled.
This he really didn’t know, because the system hadn’t annotated it either.
"Old Tree, explain it carefully. What’s the risk in absorbing Divine Formats?
"I can."
The Ancient Tree’s eyelids twitched, then it said, "Saint Master Han Xing should know that Divine Formats are carriers of Rules."
"Every Divine Format contains a portion of the Power of Rules."
Han Xing nodded. That part he did know.
The Ancient Tree went on, "So if you absorb it, it’s equivalent to damaging the Rules themselves, and you’ll be marked by the Rules."
"In other words, you will be subjected to the judgment of Divine Spirits."
Hearing this, Han Xing asked in confusion, "You mean if I absorb their Divine Formats, those Divine Spirits will charge into the Holy Spirit Realm to come after me?"
The Ancient Tree shook its head. "No, they can’t come to the Holy Spirit Realm."
"However, outside the Holy Spirit Realm, you might be hunted down by those beings."
Hearing that, Han Xing nodded and said, "That’s fine then. Divine Spirits aren’t much of a threat to me anyway."
The Ancient Tree said, "Saint Master Han Xing, you’re mistaken."
"The owners of those Divine Formats aren’t just Divine Spirits. Among them there are even True Gods, and beings above True God."
"So if you really plan to absorb Divine Formats, you must distinguish them carefully."
"If you absorb Divine Formats with a weak aura, at most you’ll provoke a Divine Spirit’s pursuit."
"But if you absorb those with a powerful aura, you could very well draw the pursuit of a True God."
"Even if those True Gods don’t want to act, under the push of the Rules, they will still treat you as an enemy."
At this point, the nearby team members all felt a chill in their hearts.
They understood what the Ancient Tree meant.
That was: don’t just see a Divine Format and rush to absorb it.
After all, if you devour someone else’s Power of Rules, it’s basically the same as forming a blood feud.
Han Xing asked, "Old Tree, are there many True God Level Divine Formats?"
The Ancient Tree replied, "There aren’t many. In any case, there were never that many True God Level beings to begin with.
"Their Divine Formats can allow the user to no longer be restricted by Rules, and at most break through to the Divine Realm."
"Divine Spirit Level Divine Formats can only let the user reach the limit of Demigod."
This was yet another piece of knowledge about Divine Spirits.
Everyone couldn’t help sighing at how much the Old Tree knew.
"I get it. So what you mean is that the number of True God Level Divine Formats isn’t large, but I still have to carefully tell them apart and not casually devour their Power of Rules."
"The main focus is to absorb Divine Spirit Level Divine Formats, right?"
The Ancient Tree nodded. "Saint Master Han Xing is correct."
Han Xing then asked again, "Old Tree, I understand the risk you’re talking about now."
"So, tell me where that place is."
The Ancient Tree replied, "Alright."
Hearing that, everyone’s eyes lit up at once, and they focused all their attention, waiting for the Ancient Tree’s next words.
However, the Ancient Tree chuckled. "But Saint Master Han Xing, if some heavenly thunder comes down later, remember to protect this old one!"
Hearing this, Han Xing understood immediately. He nodded directly. "Don’t worry, Old Tree. With me here, the Holy Spirit Realm’s thunder won’t be hitting you."
As he spoke, Han Xing summoned Ten Thousand Stars City and had it hover a hundred thousand kilometers away.
That distance was within Ten Thousand Stars City’s fire coverage range.
The moment Ten Thousand Stars City appeared, not just the team members, even the Old Tree felt a wave of reassurance.
"Old Tree, you can talk now.
The Ancient Tree heard him and stopped keeping them in suspense, directly saying, "That place is called the Land of Divine War..."
Rumble!
Just as the Ancient Tree had expected, the moment it spoke that name, it seemed to have triggered some severe Rule again.
A massive bank of dark clouds immediately gathered in the sky.
But everyone was already used to it.
After neutralizing that bolt of thunder—
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots continued, "The Land of Divine War lies within the Endless Void. It’s said that a terrifying battle once took place there!"
"Countless Divine Spirits fell, and even True God Level beings died more than one. Among them, there are even corpses of Ancient Fierce Beasts."

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - 451: Dark Age Secrets_3
paragraphs: "Below the High-tier Demigod Level, approaching spells certain death!"
The Old Tree glanced at the sky and continued, "However, though it’s dangerous there, it also holds astonishing opportunities."
"When those Divine Spirits fall, even True Gods, the shattered rules of theirs condense into orbs of Divine Format."
"If you’re lucky, perhaps you might find a complete rule among them."
"A complete rule could even grant you direct access to the Divine Realm."
At this moment, the sky still rumbled with rolling thunder.
Yet, the dark clouds above didn’t strike again, as if knowing such an attack was no longer effective against Han Xing and the others.
Han Xing asked, "Old Tree, the Land of Divine War you mentioned is located in the Endless Void, but how do we find it?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots replied, "I naturally have a way to search for it."
Then, he handed Han Xing a broken arrow, still stained with mottled blood.
From this arrow, Han Xing felt an extremely familiar aura.
In front of him, the attribute introduction of this arrow appeared.
[Bloodstained Hunting Arrow]: A special item that can detect its fallen location in the Void through this arrow.
Upon seeing this arrow, Han Xing’s pupils instantly constricted.
"Is this?!"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots noticed Han Xing’s reaction, "Saint Master Han Xing guessed correctly."
"This is that person’s Broken Arrow."
"In that divine war back then, he was also involved."
"Or rather, he initiated that battle."
However, after seeing the remark information on the arrow, Han Xing was filled with surging waves of doubt.
Han Xing asked in shock and uncertainty, "Old Tree, was it in that war that Hunter died?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots looked at Han Xing in confusion, "That, I am not very clear about."
"I only know that after Hunter went to participate in that war, he indeed never returned."
Hearing the tree’s reply, Han Xing was already certain of his guess.
As it turns out, Hunter really died there.
What exactly did he experience in that battle?
What terrifying enemy did Hunter encounter?
Why did even a being like him perish?
A host of questions arose in Han Xing’s mind.
"Old Tree, can you tell me why Hunter went to participate in that battle?"
The tree pondered for a moment, then slowly spoke.
"Why exactly, I am not very clear either."
"Back then, though I had Demigod Level combat power, you must know, the era when Hunter rose was the era of Beasts of Calamity!"
"Demigods in front of those Beasts of Calamity could only die like ants!"
At this point, the tree seemed to recall something terrifying and trembled violently.
"That era was horrendous..."
"Every day, I would hear of which Sky Island was devoured by the Beast of Calamity, the entire Race destroyed in an instant!"
"I dreaded the day when such a fate would suddenly befall me!"
"History records the Dark Age as lasting four hundred years."
"But in truth, it lasted over two thousand years!"
"In those two thousand years, the entire Holy Spirit Realm became a feeding ground for those Beasts of Calamity, which appeared whenever they were hungry, initiating massive feeding sessions."
"Living beings were utterly defenseless and could only become food, swallowed alive."
"I transformed into a tiny sapling, sealing all my energy, not daring to reveal a single bit."
"For over two thousand years, nearly ninety percent of the intelligent Races in the Holy Spirit Realm faced extinction!"
"It wasn’t until that person’s rise that those terrifying Beasts of Calamity were expelled from the Holy Spirit Realm, finally ending the Dark Age."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing couldn’t help but ask, "Hunter accomplished so much, why are there so few records of Hunter in the Holy Spirit Realm?"

The tree slowly explained, "It’s not that the records are few, but that too many beings in the Holy Spirit Realm died back then; those who survived were mostly members of Races without full intelligence."
"Moreover, that person was always very low-key, which is why the Holy Spirit Realm knows so little about him."
Han Xing nodded in understanding.
He asked again, "And after the Dark Age? Why did Hunter want to engage in that battle?"
The tree looked up, seeing the thundercloud above not intending to attack it.
As if deciding something, the tree sighed after a while, "Very well, today I will tell you everything I know.
"After the Dark Age, another several thousand years passed."
"In these thousands of years, Hunter remained active in the Holy Spirit Realm, searching for geniuses to inherit his power."
"Those who inherited his power called themselves the inheritors of the Wild Ranger."
"All Wild Rangers through the ages were the most outstanding beings of those times, and back then, the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm were not so strict."
"Thus, even Divine Level Wild Rangers were not uncommon."
"Later, these Wild Rangers, along with Hunter, founded a special organization known as the Supreme Hall."
Hearing this, a look of realization appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
So, when Hunter mentioned it, that’s the kind of place the Supreme Hall was.
An organization founded by generations of Wild Rangers, it indeed held great significance.
Unfortunately, Han Xing had no idea where the Supreme Hall was or how to find other Wild Rangers.
The tree continued, "However, in the three-thousandth year after the Dark Age, something special happened."
"There seemed to be some internal conflict within the Supreme Hall."
"Conflict?" Han Xing asked in confusion.
The tree replied, "Yes, I don’t know what it was about."
"I only know there was a being called the Master of War Ghosts, who apparently disagreed with Hunter’s philosophy, and they fought fiercely..."
