"Old Tree, can you tell me why Hunter went to participate in that battle?"
The tree pondered for a moment, then slowly spoke.
"Why exactly, I am not very clear either."
"Back then, though I had Demigod Level combat power, you must know, the era when Hunter rose was the era of Beasts of Calamity!"
"Demigods in front of those Beasts of Calamity could only die like ants!"
At this point, the tree seemed to recall something terrifying and trembled violently.
"That era was horrendous..."
"Every day, I would hear of which Sky Island was devoured by the Beast of Calamity, the entire Race destroyed in an instant!"
"I dreaded the day when such a fate would suddenly befall me!"
"History records the Dark Age as lasting four hundred years."
"But in truth, it lasted over two thousand years!"
"In those two thousand years, the entire Holy Spirit Realm became a feeding ground for those Beasts of Calamity, which appeared whenever they were hungry, initiating massive feeding sessions."
"Living beings were utterly defenseless and could only become food, swallowed alive."
"I transformed into a tiny sapling, sealing all my energy, not daring to reveal a single bit."
"For over two thousand years, nearly ninety percent of the intelligent Races in the Holy Spirit Realm faced extinction!"
"It wasn’t until that person’s rise that those terrifying Beasts of Calamity were expelled from the Holy Spirit Realm, finally ending the Dark Age."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing couldn’t help but ask, "Hunter accomplished so much, why are there so few records of Hunter in the Holy Spirit Realm?"

The tree slowly explained, "It’s not that the records are few, but that too many beings in the Holy Spirit Realm died back then; those who survived were mostly members of Races without full intelligence."
"Moreover, that person was always very low-key, which is why the Holy Spirit Realm knows so little about him."
Han Xing nodded in understanding.
He asked again, "And after the Dark Age?
Why did Hunter want to engage in that battle?"
The tree looked up, seeing the thundercloud above not intending to attack it.
As if deciding something, the tree sighed after a while, "Very well, today I will tell you everything I know.
"After the Dark Age, another several thousand years passed."
"In these thousands of years, Hunter remained active in the Holy Spirit Realm, searching for geniuses to inherit his power."
"Those who inherited his power called themselves the inheritors of the Wild Ranger."
"All Wild Rangers through the ages were the most outstanding beings of those times, and back then, the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm were not so strict."
"Thus, even Divine Level Wild Rangers were not uncommon."
"Later, these Wild Rangers, along with Hunter, founded a special organization known as the Supreme Hall."
Hearing this, a look of realization appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
So, when Hunter mentioned it, that’s the kind of place the Supreme Hall was.
An organization founded by generations of Wild Rangers, it indeed held great significance.
Unfortunately, Han Xing had no idea where the Supreme Hall was or how to find other Wild Rangers.
The tree continued, "However, in the three-thousandth year after the Dark Age, something special happened."
"There seemed to be some internal conflict within the Supreme Hall."
"Conflict?" Han Xing asked in confusion.
The tree replied, "Yes, I don’t know what it was about."
"I only know there was a being called the Master of War Ghosts, who apparently disagreed with Hunter’s philosophy, and they fought fiercely..."

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - 452: Beyond True God, What Awaits?
paragraphs: The Ancient Tree said, "Among them, there was an entity called the Master of War Ghosts, who seemingly disagreed with Hunter’s philosophy and engaged in a fierce battle with him..."
"That battle sent powerful energy fluctuations throughout the entire Holy Spirit Realm."
"Only then did people realize that the power these two possessed was so terrifying, even surpassing the extent of the Beast of Calamity at the time."
"Vaguely, I heard War Ghost mention ’total seal’ and ’Era of Extinct Gods’."
War Ghost...
Han Xing heard a familiar name again.
His Holy Artifact Set, the Master of War Ghosts Wrist Guard, was related to this entity.
Han Xing seemed to see the history of the Holy Spirit Realm, sealed for tens of thousands of years, slowly revealing itself to him.
"What is the total seal, and what is the Era of Extinct Gods?"
"And what happened after that?" Han Xing continued to ask.
The Ancient Tree said, "Afterwards, I am not particularly clear about the specific situation."
"All I know is that after that battle, War Ghost detached from the Supreme Hall, and then never appeared before people again."
"And after that, the Supreme Hall, including that individual, remained silent for a long, long time..."
"The beings in the Holy Spirit Realm even thought that the organization had disbanded."
"Until over two thousand years later, Hunter suddenly spoke out across the entire Holy Spirit Realm."
"I still clearly remember his words back then."
"Everyone, the arrival of the rules is unstoppable, I will try my best to prevent those entities from descending; after this battle, I may never appear again."
"I hope the Holy Spirit Realm can see more existences that break the rules, and may sentient beings be free from shackles!"
The Old Tree sighed as it said, "It was indeed as he said, after that, this entity never appeared again."
"Even the Supreme Hall vanished without a trace."
"Later, more and more rules emerged in the Holy Spirit Realm, almost plugging all loopholes, and Divine Spirit level experts rarely appeared."
"A thousand years after that, the rules were completely locked down, and Divine Spirits became extinct."
"And then..."
Upon saying this, the Ancient Tree seemed at a loss for how to continue and paused.
Han Xing asked in confusion, "And then what happened, Old Tree?"
All the other team members also cast their gazes on the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
It was like listening to a story and reaching the most critical part, only for the phone to suddenly shut off.
Each of them felt incredibly itchy, as if a cat were scratching at their hearts.
The Ancient Tree sighed, "After that, something extremely terrifying occurred!"
"I found out that the strong ones of my generation were silently dying one by one."
"Even those invincible Divine Spirits and top Demigods died in the most mysterious ways!"
"What’s even more terrifying is that the records of these dead Divine Spirits and Demigods rapidly vanished from the entire Holy Spirit Realm."
"It was as if an invisible hand was targeting all the Divine Spirits and Demigods, erasing all traces of their existence."
"I was filled with immense fear back then, dreading that I might be the next to die!"
"So I adopted the survival method from the Dark Age, sealing everything about myself and turning into a sapling."
"In this way, I barely managed to prolong my life and hid for thousands of years!"
The Ancient Tree finished speaking, continuously gasping for breath.
It seemed that revealing the deepest fears hidden within its heart caused its massive body to begin trembling slightly.
This was a scene it never dared reveal to the world.
Now, it seemed to have found an audience worthy of confiding in, and it laid everything bare.
Han Xing and others could clearly perceive the fear in its words.
They also understood the Ancient Tree’s mindset at the time.
After all, if it were a visible enemy, it would be easier to deal with.
But the terrifying thing was that those top powers all died silently, with even the records disappearing with them.
It was as if they had never come to this world.
Death is not the scariest thing; the frightening part is that after you die, the world doesn’t even know you were ever here.
At this point, Han Xing seemed to think of something and asked, "Is this why you told me that you might suddenly disappear?"
The Ancient Tree blinked its eyelids, seemingly not quite recovered from that state of fear,
Han Xing then comforted, "Old Tree, you did the right thing."
"No matter what, staying alive is the most important."
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots chuckled bitterly, "Let’s see it that way then."
"Living long certainly has its advantages too."
"After that, fewer and fewer strong individuals emerged in the Holy Spirit Realm, and even Demigod-level experts no longer appeared."
"One day, I discovered that an ordinary Demigod like me had surprisingly become the strongest of that era.
"It truly makes me feel both sad and amused!"
"It was during that year that I saw two arrows floating back from the Void..."
"At that moment, I realized that the strong ones from my era were all gone."
"I was the last survivor and the only one who knew of these secrets."
The five on the scene felt a heavy heart after hearing this.
They understood the meaning behind the Ancient Tree’s words; the Demigods and even the Divine Spirits of Hunter’s era had all died silently.
There were not even records of that era left in the world.
That’s why the Dark Age was missing two whole millennia of history.
This truly is a frightening matter.
After parting ways with the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots, Han Xing returned to Ten Thousand Stars City.
Not only Han Xing but the other team members too felt deeply troubled.

chapters.title: Chapter 837 - 452: What Lies Beyond the True God? (2)
paragraphs: Before leaving, the ancient tree with entwined roots spoke earnestly.
"Saint Master Han Xing, and a few Human Race friends, this old tree knows that my time is running short, maybe tomorrow, I will suddenly disappear."
"When that time comes, I will be erased just like those entities, even the traces of existence completely gone."
"But I don’t want these secrets to dissipate with me, so I choose to reveal everything to all of you."
"Saint Master Han Xing, I sincerely wish you success."
"To become the one who breaks the rules, as mentioned."
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong frowned and said, "Brother Xing, is what the ancient tree said true?"
"Is it really going to die?"
Han Xing shook his head, "I don’t know..."
It is precisely because of this unknown that evokes fear in people.
This was the first time they heard a sense of powerlessness from Han Xing’s mouth.
The ancient tree did not speak without aim, a month ago, when conversing with Han Xing, it had subtly hinted at this matter.
But back then, it didn’t dare to completely voice it.
And now, the ancient tree laid everything bare, possibly sensing its time is indeed running out.
Han Xing sighed, "Let’s not worry about the ancient tree, it is already a top demigod, one of the strongest in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"If even it can’t stop it, then we have no way too."
"What we can do is, as quickly as possible, enhance our strength."
The team members all nodded together.
Through the conversation with the ancient tree, Han Xing finally comprehended the reason for Hunter’s death.
Clearly, Hunter died in the final battle back then.
According to the ancient tree, Hunter’s power had already surpassed the Beast.
And what level of existence is the Beast?
That’s a True God!
Which means, Hunter’s power had reached above True God.
But what is the realm above True God, Han Xing simply didn’t know.
Even so powerful, Hunter perished in that battle.
Han Xing couldn’t help but ponder a question.
How many enemies did Hunter face on that day?
And how strong must his opponents have been?
However, the records concerning that day have entirely vanished from the Holy Spirit Realm.
Shen Yun too was contemplating the ancient tree’s words from the side.

He seemed to think of something, suddenly saying, "Brother Xing, then it means, the enemies Hunter faced back then were likely those Divine Spirits who left the Holy Spirit Realm during the Age of Ten Thousand Gods?"
Cheng Jianyong seemed puzzled, "Xiaoyunzi, how do you know?"
Shen Yun rolled his eyes at him, saying, "Did you not hear what the old tree said? Rules come into the world, cannot be stopped."
"Who holds the rules, of course, it’s those Divine Spirits."
"Those departing Divine Spirits might collectively return to the Holy Spirit Realm, representing the coming of rules."
"For some reason, Hunter couldn’t allow their return, hence a great battle ensued."
"It means Hunter single-handedly carried the mission of the entire Holy Spirit Realm, ambushing that group of Divine Spirits in the Void!"
After Shen Yun finished speaking, everyone fell into deep thought publicly.
However, Han Xing at this moment felt somewhat different.
He recalled the Blood Tide period.
Also, Hunter alone, at the cost of his life, took that Evil God.
This man truly...
Han Xing couldn’t express with words.
Perhaps, Hunter is just such a person, silently bearing everything, even saving the world is done quietly behind the scenes.
"Alas..."
"Shouldn’t have listened to the old tree so much, damn it, now I’m somewhat lacking confidence."
"Such a powerful being like Hunter died, how am I supposed to fight?"
The team members detected a hint of powerlessness in Han Xing’s words.
But they were right.
Initially, they only wanted to find the ancient tree, seeking a stable, speedy way to raise the Divine Power Value to deal with True Gods.
Yet now the ancient tree tells them, even beings like True Gods and above can die.
This instilled great pressure in their little legendary hearts.
Shen Yun patted Han Xing’s shoulder and said, "Brother Xing, don’t overthink it."
"Remember what we said before?"
"No matter what happens, no matter how strong the enemies are, we will stand by your side."
Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng also walked over, both women firmly said at this moment, "That’s right."
"Brother Han Xing, I support you!"
Cheng Jianyong, upon hearing this, exclaimed excitedly, "What’s there to fear, Brother Xing, just go for it!"
"As we said before, birds face the sky when they die, no matter how strong the enemies are, taking a True God down before dying isn’t a loss!"
After hearing this, Han Xing smiled as well.
He nodded and said, "Alright, let’s fight them!"
"The things Hunter accomplished, I must achieve!"
"The things Hunter couldn’t accomplish, I still must achieve!"
"If True God falls short, then become above True God, if even above True God falls short, then just blast the Holy Spirit Realm apart, and let’s all finish together!"
Upon hearing this, smiles appeared on team members’ faces.
This is the Han Xing they were familiar with.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, what is our next move?"
"Should we continue guarding here, or first go elsewhere?"
Han Xing, upon hearing this, "Let me think it over first."
He fell into contemplation.
The team members, upon hearing, waited silently aside.
Clearly, the urgent matter now is to quickly break through to Demigod.
After all, only by breaking through to Demigod can he equip the three Holy Artifact Sets in hand.
The strength can get a substantial boost.
And to break through to Demigod, he must venture into the Void and find the Land of Divine War to test his luck.

chapters.title: Chapter 838 - 452: What Lies Beyond True God?_3
paragraphs: Han Xing now has many things related to the Void.
First is the Dark Night Goddess’s longbow, which requires finding the goddess’s palace in the Void.
Then there is the Barbaric God’s palace key, which concerns whether Cheng Jianyong can break through to the supreme hidden profession.
And the beast’s corpse, inside of which hides a Divine Spirit.
Now there’s an addition of the Land of Divine War.
Thinking of this, Han Xing took a deep breath and said, "It seems that the Void is a place I must go."
He made up his mind and decided to head to the Void promptly.
However, what worried Han Xing a bit was,
if he goes to the Void, he must take Ten Thousand Stars City with him.
Without Ten Thousand Stars City, their safety in the Void would greatly decrease.
And by then, without Ten Thousand Stars City’s suppression, if the Abyss Realm produces one or two Demon Gods, it would be fine.
But if more Demon Gods appear, it would be a huge problem.
Moreover, Ten Thousand Stars City cannot teleport like the Divine Demon Battleship.
So Han Xing had no way to rush back immediately.
"So, is there a way to let Ten Thousand Stars City keep its firepower while also having teleportation capabilities?"
Han Xing couldn’t help but contemplate this problem.
Moments later, Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
There is indeed a way!
That is to combine Ten Thousand Stars City with the Divine Demon Battleship!
How to combine them?
Of course, by transferring all the energy cannons and Calamity Towers from Ten Thousand Stars City, while leaving other unimportant buildings behind.
The Divine Demon Battleship can carry over eight hundred cannons on its sides.
Han Xing can completely transfer the Frozen Star Cannon, the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon, the Dark Energy Cannon, and others aboard.
As for the Holy Artifact Sun Crown Stele, he could place the territory core and the Sun Crown Stele inside the ship’s hold.
Although the Calamity Defense Towers can neither be mounted on the ship’s sides nor put into the hold,
some of them can be placed on the deck!
Due to the battleship’s size, it’s impossible to bring all the Calamity Towers,
but even bringing just a portion makes them quite formidable.
At least it allows him to face and defeat five or six Divine Spirits.
Having thought of this, Han Xing decided to put it into practice immediately!
"Boom!"
Amid the surprised gazes of his team, Ten Thousand Stars City began to shake.
Then they saw oversized energy cannons moving in the air,
as the loading area of the Divine Demon Battleship’s cannons fully opened, the Dark Energy Cannon, the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon, were all loaded inside.
Before long, all energy cannons from Ten Thousand Stars City were completely loaded.
And the once empty sides of the Divine Demon Battleship’s hull now boasted cannons with exaggerated barrel diameters and varying colors.
Just one look was enough to feel the terrifying firepower.
"Brother Xing is...?"
The team thought of a possibility but still gazed in disbelief.
Then, Han Xing continued transporting Ten Thousand Stars City’s core territory and the two Sun Crown Steles.
At this moment, the ship’s hatch was wide open.
The two steles radiating holy light flew inside the battleship.
Meanwhile,
more Sky Island fragments flew over, covering the entire deck.
Although it only formed a thin ten-layer, ten-meter-thick layer, it was enough to place the Calamity Defense Towers!
Soon after, Han Xing also transferred the Calamity Defense Towers onto the ship.
Although few in number, about half, totaling 530 Calamity Defense Towers,
it was more than enough.
As for the remaining Calamity Defense Towers, Han Xing took out a core territory from his backpack, temporarily forming a Sky Island.
Having completed all this, the integration of the Divine Demon Battleship and Ten Thousand Stars City was initially finished.
Seeing this, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Brother Xing truly is a genius, to even conceive such a method!"
Shen Yun marveled, "Yes, this way, we can enjoy both the Sun Crown Stele’s enhancement and the Divine Demon Battleship’s teleportation feature; it’s awesome!"
Even the two girls watched Han Xing’s actions with excitement.
Han Xing smiled and said, "Time is of the essence; let’s head to the Void immediately."
"With this amalgamation of the Divine Demon Battleship and Ten Thousand Stars City, we have more confidence in that so-called Land of Divine War."
"This time, let’s see if we can grasp a few complete rules and strive to have us all break through to Demigod status!"
It’s worth knowing that complete rules aren’t bound by rule limitations and allow a direct breakthrough to Divine Spirit.
The team exchanged glances, then raised their hands excitedly, "Alright!"
Having said that, they all entered the Divine Demon Battleship’s hold together.
However, before leaving, Han Xing still needed to report to the Elf King briefly.
The Elf King, upon learning that Han Xing would leave for some time, was slightly surprised.
But when Han Xing gave him a communication device, instructing him to reach out if any issues arose,
the Elf King smiled relievedly, "Go without worry, Saint Master Han Xing. If anything happens, I’ll contact you promptly."
Han Xing felt slightly reassured.
Then, he directly activated the Divine Demon Battleship’s teleportation function on the spot.
"Buzz!"
The Demon God’s Heart operated at full power.
Just then, Han Xing noticed the entire Divine Demon Battleship suddenly enveloped in a white light.
It was the effect caused by the two Sun Crown Steles.
Han Xing was shocked, "Could this be...?"
Before he could react,
the next moment, the battleship entered into a teleportation state directly.
Their figures vanished from their original location.
After a series of space waves more terrifying than before,
the Divine Demon Battleship had traversed an incredibly long distance.
As the scene returned, Han Xing looked at the map coordinates, his eyes filled with amazement!

sentences.text: Han Xing now has many things related to the Void.
First is the Dark Night Goddess’s longbow, which requires finding the goddess’s palace in the Void.
Then there is the Barbaric God’s palace key, which concerns whether Cheng Jianyong can break through to the supreme hidden profession.
And the beast’s corpse, inside of which hides a Divine Spirit.
Now there’s an addition of the Land of Divine War.
Thinking of this, Han Xing took a deep breath and said, "It seems that the Void is a place I must go."
He made up his mind and decided to head to the Void promptly.
However, what worried Han Xing a bit was,
if he goes to the Void, he must take Ten Thousand Stars City with him.
Without Ten Thousand Stars City, their safety in the Void would greatly decrease.
And by then, without Ten Thousand Stars City’s suppression, if the Abyss Realm produces one or two Demon Gods, it would be fine.
But if more Demon Gods appear, it would be a huge problem.
Moreover, Ten Thousand Stars City cannot teleport like the Divine Demon Battleship.
So Han Xing had no way to rush back immediately.
"So, is there a way to let Ten Thousand Stars City keep its firepower while also having teleportation capabilities?"
Han Xing couldn’t help but contemplate this problem.
Moments later, Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
There is indeed a way!
That is to combine Ten Thousand Stars City with the Divine Demon Battleship!
How to combine them?
Of course, by transferring all the energy cannons and Calamity Towers from Ten Thousand Stars City, while leaving other unimportant buildings behind.
The Divine Demon Battleship can carry over eight hundred cannons on its sides.
Han Xing can completely transfer the Frozen Star Cannon, the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon, the Dark Energy Cannon, and others aboard.
As for the Holy Artifact Sun Crown Stele, he could place the territory core and the Sun Crown Stele inside the ship’s hold.
Although the Calamity Defense Towers can neither be mounted on the ship’s sides nor put into the hold,
some of them can be placed on the deck!
Due to the battleship’s size, it’s impossible to bring all the Calamity Towers,
but even bringing just a portion makes them quite formidable.
At least it allows him to face and defeat five or six Divine Spirits.
Having thought of this, Han Xing decided to put it into practice immediately!
"Boom!"
Amid the surprised gazes of his team, Ten Thousand Stars City began to shake.
Then they saw oversized energy cannons moving in the air,
as the loading area of the Divine Demon Battleship’s cannons fully opened, the Dark Energy Cannon, the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon, were all loaded inside.
Before long, all energy cannons from Ten Thousand Stars City were completely loaded.
And the once empty sides of the Divine Demon Battleship’s hull now boasted cannons with exaggerated barrel diameters and varying colors.
Just one look was enough to feel the terrifying firepower.
"Brother Xing is...?"
The team thought of a possibility but still gazed in disbelief.
Then, Han Xing continued transporting Ten Thousand Stars City’s core territory and the two Sun Crown Steles.
At this moment, the ship’s hatch was wide open.
The two steles radiating holy light flew inside the battleship.
Meanwhile,
more Sky Island fragments flew over, covering the entire deck.
Although it only formed a thin ten-layer, ten-meter-thick layer, it was enough to place the Calamity Defense Towers!
Soon after, Han Xing also transferred the Calamity Defense Towers onto the ship.
Although few in number, about half, totaling 530 Calamity Defense Towers,
it was more than enough.
As for the remaining Calamity Defense Towers, Han Xing took out a core territory from his backpack, temporarily forming a Sky Island.
Having completed all this, the integration of the Divine Demon Battleship and Ten Thousand Stars City was initially finished.
Seeing this, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Brother Xing truly is a genius, to even conceive such a method!"
Shen Yun marveled, "Yes, this way, we can enjoy both the Sun Crown Stele’s enhancement and the Divine Demon Battleship’s teleportation feature; it’s awesome!"
Even the two girls watched Han Xing’s actions with excitement.
Han Xing smiled and said, "Time is of the essence; let’s head to the Void immediately."
"With this amalgamation of the Divine Demon Battleship and Ten Thousand Stars City, we have more confidence in that so-called Land of Divine War."
"This time, let’s see if we can grasp a few complete rules and strive to have us all break through to Demigod status!"
It’s worth knowing that complete rules aren’t bound by rule limitations and allow a direct breakthrough to Divine Spirit.
The team exchanged glances, then raised their hands excitedly, "Alright!"
Having said that, they all entered the Divine Demon Battleship’s hold together.
However, before leaving, Han Xing still needed to report to the Elf King briefly.
The Elf King, upon learning that Han Xing would leave for some time, was slightly surprised.
But when Han Xing gave him a communication device, instructing him to reach out if any issues arose,
the Elf King smiled relievedly, "Go without worry, Saint Master Han Xing.
If anything happens, I’ll contact you promptly."
Han Xing felt slightly reassured.
Then, he directly activated the Divine Demon Battleship’s teleportation function on the spot.
"Buzz!"
The Demon God’s Heart operated at full power.
Just then, Han Xing noticed the entire Divine Demon Battleship suddenly enveloped in a white light.
It was the effect caused by the two Sun Crown Steles.
Han Xing was shocked, "Could this be...?"
Before he could react,
the next moment, the battleship entered into a teleportation state directly.
Their figures vanished from their original location.
After a series of space waves more terrifying than before,
the Divine Demon Battleship had traversed an incredibly long distance.
As the scene returned, Han Xing looked at the map coordinates, his eyes filled with amazement!

chapters.title: Chapter 839 - 453: Journey to the Void, Conversation with the Divine Spirit
paragraphs: "Wow, this time the warp jump distance isn’t ten million, but has increased to thirty million kilometers!"
Han Xing exclaimed.
The team members also looked at this scene in shock.
Cheng Jianyong said in surprise, "Isn’t this terrifying?"
"A single warp jump is farther than our three days of travel before. What happened?"
Han Xing also fell into deep thought.
However, after a moment, Han Xing understood the reason.
Because the benefits of the Sun Crown Stele are comprehensive.
In other words, even the warp jump distance of the Divine Demon Battleship received a threefold increase!
And that’s not all.
Han Xing discovered that the cooldown time for each warp jump used to be 500 seconds.
After this jump, it was reduced to just over 160 seconds!
Even the cooldown time has been shortened so much!
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but be amazed.
"No wonder it’s called the Holy Artifact Stele; this power is truly terrifying!"
According to Han Xing’s initial plan, their void journey could have taken several months.
Now it seems they could be at least one or two months ahead of schedule.
The eyes of the team members also showed surprise and joy.
They all marveled at the power of the Holy Artifact Stele being incredibly formidable!
When the cooldown time was up,
Han Xing initiated the teleportation again.
"Buzz!"
The space in the Holy Spirit Realm constantly fluctuated.
In less than an hour,
Han Xing had already returned from the Elf Realm to the Witch Race Territory.
They needed to enter the void from there and proceed to the location of the beast’s corpse.
Before long, they saw a region ahead where the space was fractured.
The massive Divine Demon Battleship slowly sailed into the endless void until it completely vanished from the Holy Spirit Realm.
A few minutes later,
The system prompt appeared.
"You have entered the endless void..."
"Please be aware that the endless void contains extremely chaotic energy, and you need to carefully identify the coordinates on the mini-map. If you get lost, you may be trapped in the void forever."
Seeing this prompt, everyone nodded.
Because the last time they ventured into the void, this prompt appeared as well.
Then, Han Xing initiated the first warp jump.
Whoosh!
The surrounding energy surged like ocean waves.
In an instant, the chaotic energy within the entire void plunged into an extremely violent state.
Han Xing even heard violent shaking sounds coming from the deck, emanating from the Calamity Defense Towers above.
This sound was so intense that it seemed as if the ship was about to disintegrate.
Fortunately, they had entered the warp state by then.
Unlike the warp state in the Holy Spirit Realm, there were no black lines surrounding them.
Instead, there appeared particles that looked like black dots.
These black particles seemed to be compressed chaotic energy at its extreme, imbued with immense power of destruction.
Nevertheless, in warp state, the speed of the Divine Demon Battleship was comparable to instant movement.
The destructive energy couldn’t catch up with them at all.
At this moment, the Divine Demon Battleship resembled a submarine diving into the deep sea, breaking through water barriers, charging forward relentlessly.
A few seconds later,
As the Divine Demon Battleship reappeared, the chaotic power of the void surged toward them!
Han Xing and the others felt the terrifying power of the void.
If hit by this energy bombardment, the Divine Demon Battleship would likely disintegrate instantly.
At the critical moment, Han Xing commanded, "Everyone, release the Divine Power Shield to cover the entire Divine Demon Battleship."
The team members instinctively complied and simultaneously activated the Divine Power Shield.
"Buzz!"
Outside the Divine Demon Battleship, five layers of Divine Power Shields appeared, varying in depth and color.
Whoosh!
The surging power of the void struck.
It riddled the Divine Power Shields with countless cracks.
"Crack!"
"Crack!"
Layer upon layer of Divine Power Shields shattered.
But fortunately, they had five layers of shields.
The bottommost layer was Han Xing’s golden shield.
Although the Divine Demon Battleship was shaking violently,
they managed to withstand this wave of void power bombardment with minimal peril.
"Wow...was that close?"
Seeing this, Cheng Jianyong wiped the sweat off his forehead.
Han Xing also frowned, as he realized that although they survived this wave of attacks, the warp jump function of the Divine Demon Battleship was now unusable.
The notes indicated that ’the spatial power in this area is too chaotic to enter warp state.’
Han Xing said, "Damn, this is a bit troublesome."
"The energy in the void is too chaotic, with spatial power being extremely unstable within."
"The warp principle of the Divine Demon Battleship is likely through compressing space."
"And our current warp action is akin to a nuclear bomb thrown into already chaotic seawater, causing severe spatial fluctuations and energy chaos."
After listening, everyone nodded in understanding.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, does that mean we can’t use the warp function anymore?"
Han Xing shook his head, "We should be able to, but just not consecutively."
"At the very least, the spatial power in this area needs to stabilize, or we need to actively leave this region to continue warp jumps."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded.
"Then Brother Xing, let’s navigate the Divine Demon Battleship a safe distance away and then resume the warp jumps."
Han Xing nodded.
The Divine Power Shields of the five members were fully activated to withstand the surrounding violent energy.
The Divine Demon Battleship proceeded at high-tier legendary level speed, enduring the energy storm as it moved away from this chaotic region.
About 20 minutes later, they gradually felt the chaotic energy around them subside.

chapters.title: Chapter 840 - 453: Journey to the Void, Dialogue with the Divine Spirit (2)
paragraphs: Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, should we be able to continue the teleportation here?"
Han Xing surveyed the surrounding situation and then nodded, "We can proceed."
Everyone let out a sigh of relief upon hearing this.
Compared to their previous expectations, teleporting once every 160 seconds.
But now, they had twenty minutes to travel.
This amounted to an additional 20-minute cooldown time for each teleportation.
The movement efficiency took a significant hit.
Moreover, Han Xing discovered that normally, he could advance 30 million kilometers in one teleportation.
Now, due to the influence of chaotic energy in the Void, he could only advance over 10 million kilometers, the distance directly halving.
If it weren’t for the Sun Crown Stele, the teleportation distance might not even reach 5 million kilometers.
Nevertheless, it was still many times faster than moving unaided.
When the second teleportation commenced, the void energy surrounding them became even more violent.
As they entered that terrifying teleportation state.
In an instant, they crossed over 10 million kilometers within the Void.
The screen flickered.
They had already reached the depths of the Void.
The chaotic energy here reached a critical point.
Raging energy waves surged toward the Divine Demon Battleship.
Fortunately, they had preemptively activated the Divine Power Shield.
"Splash!"
These energy waves continuously battered their Divine Power Shields.
Crack! Crack!
A series of shield-breaking sounds kept emerging.
The team members’ Divine Power Shields shattered one after another.
However, after their shields weakened the waves.
The damage from these energy waves was minimized.
Landing on Han Xing’s golden shield, it only created ripples, then dissipated.
Seeing this, everyone felt relieved.
"Great! With this, we can safely teleport through the Void!" Shen Yun exclaimed with joy.
Han Xing also nodded.
Compared to when they first entered the Void, the power of the five had undergone a qualitative change.
Previously at the Legendary Level, it was only through united effort that the team managed to endure.
But now, Han Xing’s Divine Power alone was sufficient to withstand the chaotic energies here.
"Let’s continue moving forward."
Han Xing’s words fell, and the Divine Demon Battleship maintained a high-speed advance, rushing forward.
Based on the previous scene, they confirmed that combined power was enough to resist the violent energy deep within the Void.
Thus, the subsequent teleportations carried much less concern.
"Buzz!"
The Demon God’s Heart started operating at full capacity once again.
Even within the Void, it quickly absorbed the energy needed for teleportation.
Then commenced the repetitive teleportation process.
Following the previously recorded coordinates, the team continued moving forward.
Three hours later, they arrived near the coordinates.
The area where the beast’s corpse lay.
Prior to this, they spent roughly a month reaching here, but now it only took several hours.
The speed had clearly achieved a qualitative leap.
"So fast..."
Everyone stared at the scene before them, feeling amazed.
Meanwhile.
After reaching this area, the chaotic void energy ceased.
It seemed everything was forcibly suppressed by a colossal beast resembling a star.
From afar, they spotted the enormous beast silhouette.
This marked the second time they saw the beast’s corpse.
Even though everyone had reached High-tier Legend, with Zhang Lianmeng breaking through to Demigod.
The beast’s corpse still exuded a powerful oppressive aura.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but comment, "Wow, this Beast of Calamity was truly a True God Level being in its lifetime, it’s terrifying!"
Han Xing nodded.
Moreover, the Dark Age was said to have more than one Beast of Calamity.
Such terrifying monsters were all dealt with by Hunter alone.
How he did it remains unknown.
Shaking his head, Han Xing continued to maneuver the Divine Demon Battleship forward.
Gradually, they approached the beast’s body.
Heading straight towards its head region.
Having already searched the surface of the beast’s body, they had no reason to waste time searching again.
Besides, Han Xing’s goal was the mysterious presence within the beast’s body.
Facing the beast’s giant maw.
Han Xing and his companions once again felt the intense tearing sensation.
"Damn! This hurts!"
"This tearing sensation is impacting our divine power?"
Cheng Jianyong grimaced in pain.
Shen Yun patted his back and said, "It’s alright, much better than last time."
Everyone nodded together.
Compared to the last time, where only Han Xing could approach, now all five could forcefully approach with the Power of Laws high resistance, a significant improvement.
Soon, they arrived about ten kilometers from the beast’s massive, toothed mouth.
Everyone bore the pain from the Tearing Law.
Focusing intently, they gazed into the beast’s mouth.
According to Han Xing, possibly there lay an entire civilization inside, perhaps complete with a sun and moon.
However, after observing for a while, they found the beast’s mouth remained pitch black, seemingly desolate.
This contrasted sharply with their last encounter.
Cheng Jianyong voiced his doubts, "Huh? Seems like there’s nothing?"
"Could it be that, the divine spirit hiding inside fled after we discovered it?"
Hearing this, everyone was suddenly alarmed.
Cheng Jianyong’s suspicion wasn’t unreasonable.
However, Han Xing felt the situation wasn’t simple.
After all, the beast’s teeth possessed a rule akin to ’tearing.’

chapters.title: Chapter 841 - 453: Journey to the Void, Dialogue with the Divine Spirit (Part 3)
paragraphs: All creatures that approach will suffer that kind of tearing damage.
Under the demigod level, it’s basically impossible to resist.
Last time Han Xing discovered, there was a vast civilization inside, with many creatures living.
If this divine spirit wants to escape, unless he takes the entire civilization with him.
Or, he personally eradicates this civilization.
Otherwise, there can’t be no movement at all.
Thinking of this, Han Xing shouted inside, "Friends inside, could you come out and meet us?"
Moments passed, and there was still no response from inside.
Han Xing frowned.
Based on speculation, he has judged that the divine spirit is most likely still inside.
Only that the opponent seems to be pretending to be dead, unwilling to come out.
Or, is he attracting Han Xing to go in actively?
Of course, Han Xing isn’t that foolish.
He knows his trump card is the combination of the Divine Demon Battleship and Ten Thousand Stars City.
If he went inside, wouldn’t that be like the Tang Monk entering the Silk Cave—left at others’ mercy?
Thus, Han Xing directly said, "Friends inside, if you don’t come out, I’ll have to use some coercive measures."
"It would be bad if innocent creatures inside were harmed."
Though Han Xing said this.
On the Divine Demon Battleship, those Calamity Defense Towers and Dark Energy Cannons were already in a state of energy accumulation.
From this perspective, it could directly blast into the mouth of the beast.
At that time, it would definitely cause great damage to the civilization inside.
Seemingly sensing Han Xing and his companions’ threat.
Moments later, a white light gradually appeared from the mouth of the beast.
Seeing this white light appear, everyone knew Han Xing’s guess was right.
The guy inside was still here and had not left.
Cheng Jianyong laughed, "Damn, this guy still wants to play a trick with us!"
"Luckily Brother Xing discovered him!"
After speaking, the white light swiftly moved to the mouth of the beast.
Then, it stopped at the oral region.
They faintly saw that it seemed to be a human figure formed by a light mass.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Is it you! Light Superhero?"
They felt an extremely powerful aura from the white light.
This aura is no less than the Demon God’s Terrifying Limbs!
Indeed, this guy is a divine spirit!
Everyone instantly entered a combat state.
Moments later, a divine power wave emanated from that body of light.
"Human race... and demigod level, are you the group that searched the beast’s corpse last time?"
Seeing that the opponent showed no intent to attack, the team members gradually breathed a sigh of relief.

Han Xing threw out three questions in one breath.
The God of Radiance after hearing, slowly shook its head, "Cannot say..."

chapters.title: Chapter 842 - 454: The God of Light Descends
paragraphs: Han Xing threw out three questions in one breath.
The God of Radiance listened and slowly shook his head: "I cannot say, here in the Void, they will sense it."
"I’ve managed to hide here for so many years without being discovered, I don’t want to lose everything now."
Han Xing listened, and didn’t insist, instead nodding: "Alright then."
"Apart from those three questions, can you tell me who defeated you?"
This question intrigued the team members as well.
After all, the God of Radiance’s strength is even more formidable than the Fearful Limb Demon God.
Among the Divine Spirits, he is not a weak one.
So they are very curious to know who could push the God of Radiance to such a state, hiding here for thousands of years without daring to show face.
The God of Radiance smiled bitterly: "That one, you probably know as well."
"It is the God of Light."
Hearing this name, everyone on scene was shocked.
"Him?" Han Xing said in surprise.
Speaking of this God of Light, everyone has had a few encounters with him.
In the Knight Judgment Arena, within this Cloud Secret Realm, they learned that the God of Light was a mastermind controlling that generation of Human Race.
Later, they arrived at the Witch Race Territory, where on one of the Sky Islands, they also found the God of Light’s Divine Hall.
Finally, they even summoned the will of that powerful existence.
That was also the most dangerous experience they have had so far.
"Why did that guy target you, and how did you come to blows?" Shen Yun couldn’t help but ask.
The God of Radiance opposite hesitated a bit, as if unsure whether to speak.
Han Xing then said: "You can rest assured, that God of Light is already our enemy."
"Last time, he attacked us and the score hasn’t been settled yet!
Hearing this, the God of Radiance was stunned, "You also have a grudge with the God of Light?"
Cheng Jianyong replied from the side: "Indeed, that guy shamelessly tried to attack us last time."
The God of Radiance laughed: "I see, I thought the current Human Race had all fallen under the God of Light’s control."
Han Xing replied: "That was hundreds to thousands of years ago."
"The Human Race controlled by the God of Light is probably extinct by now; we rose from the Land of the Abandoned Gods, a new batch of Human Race."
The God of Radiance nodded in realization.
He could tell that Han Xing was not lying.
Thus, the God of Radiance spoke: "The grudge between me and the God of Light is nothing much, mainly due to the contest over rules."
"I control the Power of Radiance, and like Light, Dawn, belong to a major faction, all three gods rely on the Rule of Light to breakthrough as Divine Spirits."
"But the complete Rule of Light was almost completely controlled by that one, and the remaining Power of Rules gave birth to us three Divine Spirits."
"So it resulted in the light element’s Power of Rules being insufficient, we three gods are stuck in the Divine Realm, unable to progress further."
"If any of us wants to break through to True God, we must devour the rules from the other two."
At this point, the God of Radiance glanced at everyone, then continued: "However, the God of Light acted fastest."
"He plotted behind the scenes for many years, before this, none of us knew his plan."
"Until that day, he suddenly attacked the Dawn Goddess, I realized the ambition of the God of Light."
Shen Yun asked: "When the God of Light attacked the Dawn Goddess, didn’t you try to stop him?"
The figure opposite helplessly glanced at him and said: "Not that easy."
"The God of Light planned for countless years for this move."
"By the time I found out, Dawn was already defeated."
"The God of Light devoured Dawn, his power surged dramatically, then he took the initiative to start the deity battle against me.
"Later, as you saw, I naturally lost that deity battle."
"In the end, I could only sever my tail to escape, hiding here."
After the God of Radiance finished, everyone fell into contemplation.
Shen Yun expressed regret: "It seems that the God of Light is really not typically formidable."
"And he’s also scheming, preparing to strike against you all thousands of years ago."
"It’s not unjust for you to lose, my cheap teacher."
The figure opposite nodded, "Indeed it wasn’t unjust, the God of Light is much more insidious than me, stopping at nothing to breakthrough to True God."
The God of Radiance shook his head: "Enough, I’ve told you what you wanted to know."
"If there’s nothing else, let’s not disturb me further, in case the God of Light comes looking."
Shen Yun couldn’t help but disdainfully say: "Come on, you’re that cowardly, so afraid of being found by the God of Light?"
The God of Radiance helplessly replied: "Otherwise, I can’t defeat the God of Light, can’t stand and wait for death, right?"
Shen Yun said: "What about your friends? Surely you have friends among the circle of Divine Spirits, right? Call them to join together against the God of Light!"
"Friends..."
Hearing that word, the God of Radiance said: "There are, indeed."
"However, there’s a rule among us Divine Spirits."
"In fights between gods of the same rule system, gods of other rules are not allowed to intervene."
"So, the God of Light didn’t invite external aid, neither can I have other gods help."
Upon hearing this strange rule, everyone felt a bit puzzled.
In their view, if someone wants to fight them, the first thing to do is contact their friends and strike first with a thunderous hand."
Shen Yun was speechless: "Alright, looks like relying on you against the God of Light is really hopeless."

chapters.title: Chapter 843 - 454: Descent of the God of Light (2)
paragraphs: "This task, leave it to us."
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance became interested.
"Oh? Are you saying you can handle the God of Light?"
The group exchanged glances but did not answer.
Of course, they wouldn’t tell the God of Radiance that Han Xing’s territorial firepower already had godslaying power.
As long as it’s not a True God, basically one shot is enough.
Shen Yun asked, "That’s none of your business."
"By the way, my cheap master, do you have any Divine Format? Give me one so I can break through to Demigod."
Upon hearing this request, the team members’ eyes also lit up.
Shen Yun inherited the power of the God of Radiance.
Without a doubt, breaking through with the God of Radiance’s Divine Format is most suitable for him.
At this point, they found the right person, so naturally, they wanted the God of Radiance to give them a Divine Format.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but give him a thumbs up.
The God of Radiance, however, was amused and annoyed, "You kid, you really dare to ask, coming straight to me for a Divine Format."
"Do you know the importance of a Divine Format to us?"
Shen Yun shook his head, "I don’t know, so that’s why I’m asking you?"
The God of Radiance replied helplessly, "A Divine Format is the Power of Rules we control."
"And as fellow divine spirits, the more Power of Rules you control, the stronger you are."
"So, those Divine Formats are portions of our Power of Rules that we cut out."
"However, by doing so, my strength will decrease partially."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in realization.
It turns out a Divine Format is formed this way; it can’t appear out of thin air and must obey the law of energy conservation.
Only by cutting out a portion from existing rules can it be used by newcomers to break through to Demigod.
Shen Yun asked, "So can you cut out a Divine Format for me now?
"After all, I’m half a disciple of yours; a disciple gift should be given."
"Besides, you’re hiding here now, and you don’t usually need to fight, so why not give me a Divine Format first as an investment for the future."
Shen Yun started to use his persuasive tongue.
The more the God of Radiance listened, the more amused he became.
"You kid, you’re quite the smooth talker."
"You’re right, I can indeed give you a Divine Format as future investment."
Upon hearing these words, the team’s faces lit up with joy.
The God of Radiance continued, "But, you better think this through, because I am only at the Divine Realm."
"Even if you use my Divine Format, you can only break through to the Demigod Level at most."
"At that time, don’t think of targeting me."
The God of Radiance saw through them; these humans were audacious.
If they were stuck at the Demigod Realm for hundreds or thousands of years, they might truly try something.
Though he was not afraid of these humans.
Shen Yun shook his head and said, "You don’t need to worry, my cheap master."
"I understand what you mean by the rules."
"The God of Light devoured the Power of Rules you control, breaking through to the True God Realm."
"Conversely, if we take down the God of Light and devour his Light Element Rules, we can also break through to the Divine Realm, right?"
These words made the God of Radiance shudder.
"Are you sure you’re not joking?"
"That’s the God of Light who, after devouring the dawn, has reached the peak of the Divine Realm,"
"If he devours me, he can break through to the True God Realm!"
"Against such an enemy, you can’t be his opponent!"
However, Shen Yun nodded, "I can’t defeat the God of Light, but it doesn’t mean Brother Xing can’t, right?"
Upon hearing this, the team members laughed along.
At this moment, the God of Radiance focused back on Han Xing.
The last time Han Xing came, the God of Radiance sensed his aura.
In two years, he reached the Legendary Limit, an impressive speed.
However, compared to an enemy like the God of Light, there’s still too much of a gap.
The God of Radiance shook his head, "It’s not that I don’t believe you, but let me advise you, don’t mess with the Light without breaking through to the Divine Realm."
"No, even if you break through to the Divine Realm, you won’t be a match for the Light."
Yet Han Xing chuckled, "You need not worry about that; you just need to give us the Divine Format, and I’ll deal with the God of Light."
Han Xing said it very simply.
But the God of Radiance stared at Han Xing as if he’d seen a ghost.
Because he found it hard to believe that these words were spoken by a human at the Legendary Level.
Moreover, even his teammates looked like it was only natural.
Are these humans extremely confident or just crazy?
The God of Radiance even wondered if they were spellbound.
Shen Yun, seeing his silence, impatiently said, "Radiance, stop stalling."
"Share some of your Power of Rules with me, and we’ll help you take out the God of Light, it’s a worthwhile deal."
The God of Radiance fell into hesitation.
But before he could speak, the God of Radiance’s expression suddenly changed.
He unleashed his full Divine Power, covering millions of miles around.
"Buzz!"
The team members were startled by the God of Radiance’s sudden action, thinking he was about to attack them.
Han Xing almost prepared to fire a cannon.
However, the God of Radiance looked extremely frightened, "Leave here immediately, quick!"
The group was still unaware of what was happening.
The next moment, a terrifying presence suddenly descended into this void.

"Share some of your Power of Rules with me, and we’ll help you take out the God of Light, it’s a worthwhile deal."
The God of Radiance fell into hesitation.
But before he could speak, the God of Radiance’s expression suddenly changed.
He unleashed his full Divine Power, covering millions of miles around.
"Buzz!"
The team members were startled by the God of Radiance’s sudden action, thinking he was about to attack them.
Han Xing almost prepared to fire a cannon.
However, the God of Radiance looked extremely frightened, "Leave here immediately, quick!"
The group was still unaware of what was happening.
The next moment, a terrifying presence suddenly descended into this void.

chapters.title: Chapter 844 - 454: Descent of the God of Light (Part 3)
paragraphs: The entire Void, even including the beast’s corpse, was completely illuminated.
"Just now... who said they wanted to kill me?"
A gloomy male voice rang out, the sound seemingly carrying a certain magic, reaching the deepest part of everyone’s heart.
At this moment, besides Han Xing, everyone else seemed to be in a trance, standing blankly in place.
The God of Radiance’s face changed drastically, "Damn it! We’ve mentioned the Light God’s name too many times, and he’s sensed my presence!"
"This guy has already found us!"
In the endless light.
The deep voice sounded again, "Radiance, so you’re hiding here after all."
"All these years, you really made it hard for me to find you!"
At this moment, the shocked crowd raised their heads to look.
Above the beast’s head stood a figure shining with boundless light, as if it were a star.
Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and the others could not clearly see his figure at all.
At the same time, a slew of system prompts appeared.
[You have looked directly at an existence outside the rules, vision has been forcibly deprived by 80%!]
[You have been enveloped by the aura of an existence outside the rules, all attributes reduced by 80%.]
[You are under the divine might of an existence outside the rules, action ability reduced by 80%.]
At this moment, except for the God of Radiance and Han Xing, everyone else’s combat power was suppressed to the lowest.
And at this time, the golden Divine Power within Han Xing burst forth.
[All Things in the Forest] passive skill activated, the team members instantly recovered from that terrifying state.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong were gasping heavily.
Their vision still hadn’t recovered.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Damn, is that the true form of the Light God? This is way stronger than we expected."
"Crap, Xiaoyun, didn’t you say you were going to take him on just now? Go for it!"
Shen Yun closed his eyes, speechless, "Damn it, I said after I break through to the Divine Spirit, then I’ll take him on."
"What can I do now?"
At this moment, the figure shining with boundless light also turned its gaze towards Han Xing and the others.
"Interesting, so it’s you few human rats, who last time intruded into my altar and barely escaped with your lives."
"So quickly, you’ve grown to this level."
"It seems you are the so-called favorites of destiny."
At this moment, the God of Radiance within the beast’s mouth suddenly rushed out.
He also emitted a strong light, shouting, "You guys, hurry and escape!"
In the next moment, the powers of the same origin began to struggle and oppose each other.
"Buzz!"
However, in less than two seconds, the God of Radiance spat blood and was sent flying, the light on him dimming instantly.
The Light God chuckled lightly, "After so many years, you still haven’t improved at all, Radiance."
The God of Radiance, upon seeing the Light God appear, also knew what his fate would be today.
He spread open his palm, and vaguely, a glowing object similar to leaf veins appeared above his head.
The Light God questioned in confusion, "Radiance, what are you doing?"
At this moment, the God of Radiance seemed to be enduring great pain.
He directly tore one of the veins from the mass.
Moments later, a rhombic crystal emitting brilliant light appeared before the God of Radiance.
The Light God remarked in surprise, "You’re actually cutting your own power of rules? Are you tired of living?"
The God of Radiance ignored him, casually flicking his hand.
The rhombic crystal flew directly towards Shen Yun.
At the same time, the God of Radiance’s aura decreased significantly.
He looked at the crowd behind him and said, "I’ll block the Light; you all escape first, quickly escape back to the Holy Spirit Realm."
"Only in the Holy Spirit Realm can we divine spirits not reach you!"
Then, the God of Radiance looked at Shen Yun and smiled.
"That little guy, you’re arrogant, but I like it. It seems I didn’t choose wrong in placing my power with you."
"Go, use my Divine Format to break through to a Demigod!
"One day, when you break through to the Divine Realm, avenge me!"
At this point, the God of Radiance had already resolved to die.
After the initial surprise, the Light God returned to being composed.
He chuckled lightly, "Oh? You’ve already arranged your affairs?"
"However, expecting a few little humans to deal with me, isn’t that a bit naïve?"
"The Era of Extinct Gods is about to begin. Do you think these little humans still have a chance to grow up?"
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance, whose expression was already pale, suddenly became alarmed.
He questioned, "The Era of Extinct Gods is about to begin again? Why?"
"The one in the Abyss Realm won’t let you start it."
The Light God sneered coldly, "That’s something you don’t need to know."
"You just need to know to contribute your power of rules so that I can break through to a True God."
"And I will become truly unkillable and eternal."
The two divine spirits were about to engage in a fierce battle.
At this time, Han Xing suddenly spoke up, "Light, how long until the Era of Extinct Gods you mentioned begins?"
"Back then, did Hunter die trying to prevent the advent of the Era of Extinct Gods?"
The Light God inquired in confusion, "Oh? You actually know about Hunter."
"But why should I answer the question of an ant like you?"
Han Xing shrugged, "If you don’t want to say, then don’t."
The Light God smirked coldly, "Well, since you ants are about to meet the same fate as Radiance shortly, I suppose I can answer your question."
"The Era of Extinct Gods is about to descend, and the multitude of gods are about to return. I don’t know the exact timing."
"It could be as soon as four or five years, as long as several decades."
"As for Hunter, that guy was indeed a genius, but compared to us multitude of gods, he was still too insignificant."

chapters.title: Chapter 845 - 455: The Fall of a God
paragraphs: The God of Light finished speaking, and Han Xing nodded in realization.
Is there only so little time left?
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly said, "Radiance, how about making a deal?"
The God of Radiance asked in confusion, "What kind of deal?"
"I’ll help you get rid of the God of Light, and you can absorb half of the Power of Rules."
"In exchange, you need to fight for me in the next hundred years, how about it?"
The God of Radiance was stunned, "You mean you want me to be your hitman?"
Han Xing nodded, "That’s pretty much what I mean."
On the scene, the God of Radiance and the God of Light were both stunned.
Moments later, the God of Light couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
The entire Void shook with his laughter.
"Interesting... A little fellow at the Legendary Level actually says he wants to get rid of me."
"This is the funniest thing I’ve heard in thousands of years."
"Radiance, do you really believe this little fellow can take me down?"
The God of Radiance looked at Han Xing on the side.
Han Xing didn’t provide much explanation, instead standing calmly with a serene look in his eyes.
The God of Radiance had waves of concern in his eyes.
After a moment, he seemed to make a difficult decision.
The God of Radiance said, "If you can indeed get rid of the God of Light, then it’s no problem for me to be your hitman for some time."
A hundred years is but a fleeting moment to them.
Hearing the God of Radiance agree, Han Xing smiled, "Do we need to make a contract?"
The God of Radiance was amused by him, "You kid, I really see now, each of you is more arrogant than the other, even daring to ask me, a Divine Spirit, to sign a contract with you."
"Alright then, I shall swear to the Rule today!"
"If you can get rid of the God of Light today, I, Radiance, will obey your commands unconditionally for the next hundred years!
With that said, suddenly a neural network appeared in the Void, long beyond measure, wide and boundless.
It was a Power of Rules, but compared to the rules of the God of Radiance, it was immensely larger.
A system prompt appeared in Han Xing’s ear.
[The God of Radiance swears to the Rule, should you kill the God of Light, become your exclusive Divine Spirit from today.]
[Trigger mission: Slay the God of Light.]
[Mission reward: In the next hundred years, the God of Radiance will unconditionally obey your commands.]
Seeing the system prompt, Han Xing knew the oath had come into effect.
He immediately laughed.
"That’s good, rest assured, the God of Light is definitely dying today, no one can save him."
The God of Light was amused hearing this.
"Human kid, really not afraid to make your tongue slip with such bold words."
"Come on, human kid, let me see how you will take me down?"
The God of Light, as one who controls the Rules, although not as excessively worried as the God of Tricks, still has the ability to foresee crises.
However, so far, although he felt a faint threat from this human, it was not strong.
Therefore, the God of Light didn’t take him seriously at all.
Han Xing glanced at him and said, "Taking you down is really a simple affair."
"Speaking of which, I haven’t officially slain a Divine Spirit who controls the Rules."
"Today, you should be the first."
The God of Light didn’t speak, but released all his Divine Power.
The dense Light Divine Power completely covered the entire Void.
At this moment, even within Han Xing’s Divine Power Domain, everyone felt a terrifying pressure.
It was as if fate was being controlled in someone else’s hands, that feeling of helplessness and insignificance.
"Kid, weren’t you going to deal with me?"
"Weren’t you going to slay me?
"Come on, let me see, I really can’t wait~"
Han Xing was also enduring that formidable pressure.
[You have been enveloped by the Divine Power Domain of the God of Light, all attack skills have been forcibly sealed, all Passive Skills have been forcibly sealed.]
[You have been suppressed by the Power of Rules of the God of Light, all Divine Power is unavailable.]
[You have been suppressed by the aura of the God of Light, five senses have been forcibly stripped, action capability decreased by 100%.]
[All Things in the Forest activated, due to the enormous difference, immunity effect reduced by 50%...]
Seeing this system prompt, Han Xing felt a sinking heart.
One must admit, Divine Spirit Level creatures are truly terrifying.
Just the suppression of Divine Power, for those below the Divine Spirit Level, there is no chance of resistance at all.
Even his Divine Skill: All Things in the Forest effect was reduced.
Let alone, other team members who don’t have All Things in the Forest, at this moment, they are completely in a state of daze.
In this state, the God of Light can easily harvest the lives of everyone, and even they would be utterly unaware of how they died.
Fortunately, Han Xing is not relying on his own combat power to deal with the God of Light.

The next moment, on the entire Divine Demon Battleship, all Calamity Defense Towers, Dark Energy Cannons, Godslaying Cannons, and even one main cannon of the Divine Demon Battleship, were all in charging mode!
Meanwhile, the light of two stone tablets enveloped the entire Divine Demon Battleship.
In this Divine Power Domain covered by the God of Light, forcibly opened up a brand-new world.
"To think you broke open my Divine Power Domain, interesting, you all..."
Before the words finished.
When the God of Light felt the aura of those defense towers on the Divine Demon Battleship, his expression instantly changed wildly.
"How is it possible?"
Even the God of Radiance on the side felt incredibly shocked.
An unprecedented sense of crisis enveloped!

This is something he has never experienced before, even when the Hunter fought into the depths of the Void and waged a great war with the All Gods, Light never felt such a strong sense of impending doom!

chapters.title: Chapter 846 - 455: The Fall of the God! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Especially with that main cannon, the God of Light felt an extremely fatal sensation directly!
Even the rules are urging him to escape quickly.
"The aura of the Holy Artifact..."
"I see, is this your reliance? It truly is terrifying!"
"Human boy, I misjudged you, you actually possess the power to slay gods!"
However, at this moment, the God of Light was not frightened but rather exhilarated, saying, "Excellent, as long as I take you down, the Holy Artifact above will be mine!"
At this moment, all the defense towers were in a charged state.
With the empowerment of the Holy Artifact Stele, the charging time for these defense towers was minimized!
But for a divine-level existence, even a fleeting second is enough for them to clash thousands of times!
Han Xing chuckled lightly, "Do you think you could withstand a shot?"
However, the God of Light disdainfully replied, "Boy, underestimating the power of a divine spirit is not wise!"
"These defense towers of yours are indeed powerful, even I can’t withstand a concentrated fire."
"However, I can completely merge into the rules in an instant and escape from here."
Han Xing was somewhat surprised, "Merging into the rules to escape? Is there such a method?"
A contemptuous smile appeared in the eyes of the God of Light, "Of course, before your attack is launched, I can instantly appear thousands of kilometers away."
"You simply cannot capture my silhouette."
At this point, the God of Radiance also said, "This human friend, he’s telling the truth."
"Your defense towers indeed have godslaying attack power, but divine spirits are really not as simple as you imagine."
"You should escape quickly, I’ll hold off the light."
"With the Holy Artifact plus these defense towers, I believe you will soon have truly godslaying power."
Upon hearing this, the God of Light sneered coldly, "Radiance, you think this boy exposed all his power, and I’ll still let him escape?"
"Aren’t you both a bit too naive?"
The God of Radiance felt deeply regretful.
He never thought that this human was serious, that he truly could slay divine spirits.
But, he exposed too early.
If he could have discussed with me beforehand, with both cooperating, perhaps there was an opportunity to truly take down the God of Light.
But now, it’s already too late.
However, at this moment Han Xing remained unfazed.
He nodded, saying, "Indeed, the movement ability of the divine-level is indeed terrifying."
"Then, when I bring out this item, how will you respond?"
The God of Light was momentarily stunned, "What are you bringing out?"
As soon as the words fell, a green gem appeared in Han Xing’s hand.
This was precisely the Holy Artifact of the tree spirit race!
And Han Xing didn’t hesitate at all, directly activating the Endless Entanglement special effect of the Heart of the Endless Tree Sea.

[Endless Entanglement]: Instantly releases countless vines, forcibly controlling the enemy for 3 to 100 seconds, and siphoning 30 to 100 divine power value, with a cooldown of 12 hours. (Can cause control effect on True God.)
The entire area was suddenly enveloped in endless green.
It even dispersed the power of light from the two divine spirits.
"The aura of a Holy Artifact... Damn, you actually have another creature!"
At this moment, unprecedented panic appeared in the eyes of the God of Light.
He completely did not expect this human to have so many treasures!
The aura of the Holy Artifact on that battleship had already surprised him enough.
And this human could produce another!
It’s noteworthy that even he, the God of Light, hasn’t obtained a single Holy Artifact in thousands of years of being a divine spirit.
That is a power that surpasses the rules.
At this moment, the God of Light just wanted to struggle desperately, burst out terrifying divine power, and envelop the entire area.
However, Endless Entanglement can indeed cause a control effect on True Gods with terrifying special effects!
No matter how fast the God of Light’s divine power burst, it’s no match for the speed at which those vines regenerate.
Moreover, even more terrifying, those vines not only control his body but also limit the power of rules.
This instantly rendered the method for the God of Light to merge into the rules and escape invalid.
"Damn it! How is this possible?"
The God of Light already had a sense of impending death in his heart, his mind foggy.
"Could it be, I, the God of Light, am truly going to fall here?"
At this moment, on the Divine Demon Battleship, more than a thousand defense towers, plus the Divine Demon Main Cannon had already completed brewing.
The entire void began to erupt into a frenzied energy turbulence.
Even the beast’s corpse could hardly contain it!
This would be the strongest strike Han Xing has ever launched!
The power of just one Divine Demon Main Cannon, after the enhancement of the Sun Crown Stele, is enough to instantly kill ordinary divine spirits!
"Buzz!"
First, a dramatic blood-colored energy beam burst from the Divine Demon Main Cannon, crossing hundreds of kilometers in an instant, accurately striking the God of Light.
Then, it was a combined energy beam formed by hundreds of Spiritual Godslaying Cannons, blasting that area,
Next, hundreds of Frozen Star Cannon and Dark Energy Cannon missiles simultaneously crashed down.
Even more terrifying were the Calamity Defense Towers on the battleship deck.
Blizzards scattered, thunder fell like rain...
Just the energy fluctuations from that region alone made the God of Radiance feel his scalp tingle!
Even divine spirits like him, if caught in that energy wave, would basically meet certain death.
"Damn it!"
"I am the God of Light! How can I die here!"
"Humans, I curse you!"
Inside came the desperate roar of the God of Light.
