At this point, the God of Radiance also said, "This human friend, he’s telling the truth."
"Your defense towers indeed have godslaying attack power, but divine spirits are really not as simple as you imagine."
"You should escape quickly, I’ll hold off the light."
"With the Holy Artifact plus these defense towers, I believe you will soon have truly godslaying power."
Upon hearing this, the God of Light sneered coldly, "Radiance, you think this boy exposed all his power, and I’ll still let him escape?"
"Aren’t you both a bit too naive?"
The God of Radiance felt deeply regretful.
He never thought that this human was serious, that he truly could slay divine spirits.
But, he exposed too early.
If he could have discussed with me beforehand, with both cooperating, perhaps there was an opportunity to truly take down the God of Light.
But now, it’s already too late.
However, at this moment Han Xing remained unfazed.
He nodded, saying, "Indeed, the movement ability of the divine-level is indeed terrifying."
"Then, when I bring out this item, how will you respond?"
The God of Light was momentarily stunned, "What are you bringing out?"
As soon as the words fell, a green gem appeared in Han Xing’s hand.
This was precisely the Holy Artifact of the tree spirit race!
And Han Xing didn’t hesitate at all, directly activating the Endless Entanglement special effect of the Heart of the Endless Tree Sea.

[Endless Entanglement]: Instantly releases countless vines, forcibly controlling the enemy for 3 to 100 seconds, and siphoning 30 to 100 divine power value, with a cooldown of 12 hours. (Can cause control effect on True God.)
The entire area was suddenly enveloped in endless green.
It even dispersed the power of light from the two divine spirits.
"The aura of a Holy Artifact...
Damn, you actually have another creature!"
At this moment, unprecedented panic appeared in the eyes of the God of Light.
He completely did not expect this human to have so many treasures!
The aura of the Holy Artifact on that battleship had already surprised him enough.
And this human could produce another!
It’s noteworthy that even he, the God of Light, hasn’t obtained a single Holy Artifact in thousands of years of being a divine spirit.
That is a power that surpasses the rules.
At this moment, the God of Light just wanted to struggle desperately, burst out terrifying divine power, and envelop the entire area.
However, Endless Entanglement can indeed cause a control effect on True Gods with terrifying special effects!
No matter how fast the God of Light’s divine power burst, it’s no match for the speed at which those vines regenerate.
Moreover, even more terrifying, those vines not only control his body but also limit the power of rules.
This instantly rendered the method for the God of Light to merge into the rules and escape invalid.
"Damn it!
How is this possible?"
The God of Light already had a sense of impending death in his heart, his mind foggy.
"Could it be, I, the God of Light, am truly going to fall here?"
At this moment, on the Divine Demon Battleship, more than a thousand defense towers, plus the Divine Demon Main Cannon had already completed brewing.
The entire void began to erupt into a frenzied energy turbulence.
Even the beast’s corpse could hardly contain it!
This would be the strongest strike Han Xing has ever launched!
The power of just one Divine Demon Main Cannon, after the enhancement of the Sun Crown Stele, is enough to instantly kill ordinary divine spirits!
"Buzz!"
First, a dramatic blood-colored energy beam burst from the Divine Demon Main Cannon, crossing hundreds of kilometers in an instant, accurately striking the God of Light.
Then, it was a combined energy beam formed by hundreds of Spiritual Godslaying Cannons, blasting that area,
Next, hundreds of Frozen Star Cannon and Dark Energy Cannon missiles simultaneously crashed down.
Even more terrifying were the Calamity Defense Towers on the battleship deck.
Blizzards scattered, thunder fell like rain...
Just the energy fluctuations from that region alone made the God of Radiance feel his scalp tingle!
Even divine spirits like him, if caught in that energy wave, would basically meet certain death.
"Damn it!"
"I am the God of Light!
How can I die here!"
"Humans, I curse you!"
Inside came the desperate roar of the God of Light.

chapters.title: Chapter 847 - 455: Fall of the God! (Part 3)
paragraphs: Above his head, there appeared a luminous object, stretching over a million kilometers long, resembling the nerve endings,
as the energy in that region fell into a state of frenzy!
At this moment, Han Xing vaguely saw that above the luminous object, cracks began to appear.
"Crack!"
With the sound of shattering,
the luminous object instantly shattered into pieces.
Then, a system notification appeared beside Han Xing’s ear.
[Successfully killed the Rule Master: God of Light. Since the kill was made by the Defense Tower, no Experience Value was obtained.]
[Automatically absorbed the Divine Power Value from the God of Light, Divine Power Value +3000!]
[Due to your excellent performance, the Holy Spirit Realm’s will rewards you—World Will +20 layers, Legendary Points +500, and gained Ownerless Power of Rules *1.]
[Obtained God of Light’s Hammer of Authority (Red) *1]
After the long system notification.
A slight smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
Because this meant that the God of Light was already obliterated by his strike.
At this moment, the God of Radiance also sensed that the aura of the God of Light had completely vanished.
At the site, fragments of the Power of Rules appeared.
He murmured, "Light... really died..."
The God of Radiance felt as if he were dreaming.
The one who pursued him for thousands of years, shrouding him in nightmares daily, actually died so easily.
And died at the hands of this human.
Surely, he didn’t even anticipate he would fall in such a place.
Meanwhile, the system notification of task completion appeared beside Han Xing’s ear.
Han Xing laughed at this moment, "See, Radiance, I told you killing the God of Light was a simple matter, right?"
The God of Radiance nodded reluctantly.
"This human friend of mine, you have done it. As promised, in the next hundred years, I will heed your commands."
At this moment, the God of Radiance placed one hand on his chest and then bowed to Han Xing.
A Divine Spirit saluting a Legend, something possibly every Divine Spirit has never experienced.
If any Divine Spirit truly did this, they might even face contempt from other Divine Spirits.
However, the God of Radiance felt no impropriety.
After all, this human just displayed a power far beyond the divine level limits.
Too terrifying!
Han Xing nodded, accepting the allegiance of the God of Radiance.
The vow was formally completed.
At this moment, a trace of a light smile appeared on the God of Radiance’s face as well.
The great foe troubling him for thousands of years had died,
The God of Radiance said, "Saint Master Han Xing, those rhombic crystals are the Divine Format of the God of Light and also the Power of Rules he possessed."
Through the vow, he also learned Han Xing’s name.
Han Xing saw as well, at the place where the God of Light had died, appeared several rhombic crystals, currently emitting dazzling light.
These rhombic crystals were the carriers of the rules.
Han Xing had seen their complete form, a pattern resembling a leaf, also similar to nerve endings.
Han Xing recalled that the system had just rewarded him with a rule.
[Power of Rules]: Special item.
[Attribute]: Snake

[Effect]: By mastering this Power of Rules, one can reach the limit of demigod, breakthrough to the divine realm, becoming the new Snake God, or directly absorb, increasing Divine Power Value by 10000 points.
Seeing the note behind it, Han Xing’s pupils instantly shrank.
Good heavens, it’s the Rule of the Snake?
Unexpectedly able to directly increase Divine Power Value by ten thousand points, that’s even comparable to Han Xing collecting a hundred thousand Ancient Spirit Woods!
However, Han Xing also remembered the words spoken by that old tree.
To break rules and condense Divine Format, one needs ten complete Powers of Rules.
This [Rule of the Snake], Han Xing can keep it for future breakthroughs.
Then, Han Xing led his team to the front of those few rhombic crystals.
Han Xing glanced, there were a total of 8 Divine Formats.
[Divine Format: Light]: Special item. (Different usage methods can achieve different usage effects.)

[Effect 1]: Legendary Powerhouses, by absorbing the divine power contained in the Divine Format, can greatly enhance their own Divine Power Value, the enhancement range is 3000~4000. (Absorption will cause Divine Format breakage.)
[Effect 2]: Any profession, at level 60, can use this Divine Format to breakthrough as a demigod, mastering part of the ’Light’ law.
Similar to ’Trick’ and ’Justice’.
Divine Formats can at least increase Han Xing’s Divine Power Value by twenty-four thousand!
Counting the three thousand points of Divine Power Value gained when killing the God of Light.
The harvest from this trip is downright terrifying!
Team members looked at these Divine Formats, with joy appearing in their eyes!
The God of Radiance on the side said, "Saint Master Han Xing, these Divine Formats can be combined into one, splicing into a complete rule."
Han Xing nodded.
Then he combined these eight Divine Formats,
they did indeed turn back into that existence resembling a neural network.
In front, the attributes of this rule appeared.
[Power of Rules]: Special item.
[Attribute]: Light

[Effect]: By mastering this Power of Rules, one can reach the limit of demigod, breakthrough to the divine realm, becoming the new Snake God, or directly absorb, increasing Divine Power Value by 25000 points.
Good heavens, directly increasing Divine Power Value by twenty-five thousand.
This also indirectly shows that the God of Light was many times more formidable than the Snake God.
The God of Radiance on the side, seeing this luminous Power of Rules, his eyes showed longing.
Being of the Light Element Divine Spirit himself, such Power of Rules held a deadly allure for him.
Han Xing naturally noticed the expression on the God of Radiance.
Furthermore, Han Xing remembered the promise he made to him.
That was to share half of the rules of the God of Light with him.
The God of Radiance at this time also seemed to recall this...

chapters.title: Chapter 848 - 456: World Inside the Beast
paragraphs: The God of Radiance dared not mention it actively.
After all, this Saint Master Han Xing was ruthless enough to kill the God of Light without hesitation.
If he was displeased and attacked, there would be no place to seek justice.
Thinking of this, the God of Radiance suddenly shivered inside!
Damn! It’s very possible!
Now, in the Light Faction, only one Divine Spirit remains.
As long as Radiance is destroyed, the Light Element Rules in Saint Master Han Xing’s hands will grow again, possibly allowing a Divine Spirit to break through to a True God!
After all, there is a companion by his side who also follows the Light System.
Thinking of this, the God of Radiance felt a chill on his scalp.
He put on a forced smile and said, "Saint Master Han Xing, I can also do without half of the Power of Rules."
"You helped me eliminate the number one enemy, and helping you fight in the next hundred years is justifiable."
Radiance wisely gave up the benefits promised by Han Xing.
However, Han Xing seemed to see through the God of Radiance’s thoughts and smiled, "No need to worry, since I promised you, I’ll naturally give it to you."
"But, I have a new question now."
The God of Radiance heard this and quickly said politely, "Saint Master Han Xing, please go ahead."
Han Xing nodded, "I want to know, if my friend Shen Yun, who inherited your power, is given another Rule, will it have any impact?"
"For example, if he breaks through to Divine Spirit in the future, will his combat power decrease?"
The God of Radiance thought for a moment, then shook his head, "This won’t have much impact."
"After all, the Rule of Light, although part of my faction, is merely an energy carrier,"
"I observe your friend doesn’t usually use rules like we do in battle."
"You can completely give him other rules like Life or Guardian series, which suit him better than Light Element Rules."
After hearing the God of Radiance’s explanation, Han Xing nodded with understanding.
If that’s the case, then he’s relieved.
Previously, he worried that if Shen Yun inherited the God of Radiance’s power and could only use Light Element’s Divine Format to break through, it would be troublesome.
In that case, if Shen Yun breaks through to True God, he’d also have to eliminate the God of Radiance.
Now, according to the God of Radiance,
absorbing the Power of Rules from other factions could similarly break through to Demigod, even Divine Spirit.
However, this also means they need to eliminate more Divine Spirits to obtain the Power of Rules.
Thinking of this, Han Xing nodded, "Radiance, if you absorb all the Power of Rules on these five Divine Formats, are you confident about breaking through to the True God Realm?"
The God of Radiance was stunned for a moment upon hearing this, he seemed to understand Han Xing’s implication.
So he softly said, "Absorbing all of it won’t immediately allow a breakthrough to True God."
"However, give me three to five years and more Power of Rules, and I should break through to the True God Realm."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing suddenly laughed.
"Then, all this Power of Rules is yours."
The God of Radiance was suddenly stunned, surprised, and asked, "Saint Master Han Xing, are you serious?"
Even the team members beside him were somewhat surprised by Han Xing’s decision.
After all, these Divine Formats were also very important to him.
Even using them for absorption would significantly elevate his Divine Power Value.
However, Han Xing handed them over like this.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, but as previously agreed, for the next hundred years, you’ll need to fight for me."
The God of Radiance, hearing this, still found it hard to believe.
At this point, Han Xing said, "Radiance, you should know that general Divine Spirits are no longer a threat to me."
"My enemies are those True Gods."
"Therefore, I need you to break through to the True God Realm as soon as possible."
After hearing Han Xing’s explanation, everyone, including the God of Radiance, understood Han Xing’s intent.
He wanted the God of Radiance to break through to True God and help him fight stronger enemies,
However, if they truly had another True God level warrior, that would indeed be excellent.
At this moment, the God of Radiance was more at ease, "I can absorb it and promise to break through to True God within five years."
"But, are you sure you only need me to fight for you for a hundred years?"
"Why not add a bit more, I’m feeling a bit uneasy taking this."
Han Xing laughed upon hearing this, "No need, a hundred years is a hundred years."
He’s already heard from the God of Light that the so-called ’Era of Extinct Gods’ would arrive in at most several decades.
In these decades, Han Xing would either achieve ultimate power and suppress everything.
Or perish without a trace.
Therefore, a hundred years is more than enough.
The God of Radiance listened and nodded heavily, "Alright, then I’ll swear once again towards the Supreme Rule!"
"For the next hundred years, I will fight for this Human Race friend with all my might, even at the cost of my life!"
At this moment, it seemed to acknowledge the God of Radiance’s vow.
In the Endless Void, four lines resembling a neural network suddenly appeared.
Covering the heads of everyone present.
This meant that the vow had taken effect.
Han Xing nodded, "Absorb this Power of Rules as soon as possible."
"I need you to break through to the True God Realm quickly."
The God of Radiance nodded.
He stepped forward, and the Power of Radiance on him began to overflow.
This was the first time everyone saw another Divine Spirit level being absorb Power of Rules.

chapters.title: Chapter 849 - 456: The World Inside the Beast (2)
paragraphs: There was a curious look in his eyes.
In the next moment, a luminous nerve network also appeared above the head of the God of Radiance.
Although it’s much smaller compared to the nerve network of the God of Light.
But the God of Light is already dead, so this nerve network is in an ownerless state.
Soon, all the power of rules above was absorbed by the God of Radiance into his own rules.
His power of rules became more immense.
At this moment, the aura of the God of Radiance began to rise rapidly.
In just a few seconds, it surpassed the pressure brought by the Fearful Limb Demon God.
Soon, it even surpassed the God of Light!
As the thick power of rules quickly dimmed.
In Han Xing’s perception, the God of Radiance seemed to have reached another realm.
His aura reached a state of returning to simplicity.
When the power of rules above was completely devoured.
Then, before everyone, appeared a handsome man, richly dressed in white, wearing a white crown, as elegant as jade.
Cheng Jianyong was astonished, "Wow, Radiance, do you look like this?"
Opposite, the handsome man nodded with a slight chuckle.
Shen Yun also couldn’t believe it and said, "This can’t be your real appearance, right? You look so handsome, I don’t believe it!"
The God of Radiance laughed and said, "My young friends, this was my appearance before I became a divine spirit, thousands of years ago."
However, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun still looked unconvinced.
The God of Radiance gently shook his head.
Han Xing checked his attributes.
[God of Radiance:]
[Level]: ???
[Attributes]: ???
[Skills]: ???
[Divine Power Value]: ???
It’s still a bunch of question marks.
Han Xing said, "Radiance."
The God of Radiance turned around and respectfully said, "Saint Master Han Xing, please speak."
Han Xing nodded, "Was the civilization within the beast nurtured by you?"
He still remembered that when he used his divine power to explore last time, he saw many life forms within.
The number of living beings there is at least akin to a large clan within the Holy Spirit Realm.
The God of Radiance shook his head and said, "I didn’t nurture it; when I found the beast’s corpse, I discovered signs of life already within, even a complete Sky Island Continent."
"However, those life forms were still in a primitive, blood-drinking state then."
"After I entered, I accelerated their civilizational evolution, which is why such a vast civilization was born."
Han Xing asked doubtfully, "A complete Sky Island Continent? Does anyone know who placed it inside?"
The God of Radiance said, "I’m not really sure."
"I’ve been trying to find the traces of that one for many years, but it all ended in failure."
Han Xing, hearing this, didn’t inquire further and nodded, "Take us inside to see."
The God of Radiance did not refuse, "Of course, everyone, please follow me over."
With these words, a vast burst of divine power from the God of Radiance enveloped all five people completely.
He then charged directly into the mouth of the beast.
As for the [Divine Demon Battleship], it was left outside.
However, Han Xing and the others weren’t worried about encountering unexpected incidents within the beast’s body.
After all, the God of Radiance had sworn to the Supreme Rule to unconditionally obey Han Xing’s orders.
Such an oath was also acknowledged by the system.
This means that the God of Radiance couldn’t break his oath and turn against them.
Even if there’s an unforeseen situation, Han Xing and the others could use the [Oracle Throne] to escape.
At this moment, wrapped in the divine power of the God of Radiance, all five safely passed through the beast’s mouth.
The tearing-like power of rules was completely blocked outside.
Everyone looked around curiously and then ventured into the beast’s oral cavity.
Inside, it was dim, and a rotten smell faintly emanated.
After passing through the beast’s throat that stretched for tens of thousands of kilometers.
Han Xing and the others finally arrived inside the beast.
It was like an entirely new world.
Above, a pale yellow sky, which was the inside of the beast’s body.
In the distance, three planets rotated in a fixed trajectory.
A vast light sphere, a green planet.
And beside the green planet, a small asteroid orbited.
This combination looked like the relationship between the sun, moon, and earth.
The five were shocked at this sight.
"Whoa..."
This environment resembles their living Earth too closely.
Even though, compared to the solar system, this celestial structure is quite simple.
It still made everyone feel a chill run up their spine.
Were it not for this planet’s diameter being dozens of times larger than their living Earth.
They might really have suspected they were witnessing Earth after humanity had departed.
Moreover, through more detailed observation, they noticed even more differences.
The planet was covered in many towering trees.
Various primitive forests, giant volcanoes, and icy terrains surrounded by environments.
Wherein, they could see giant beasts roaming...
Because the three spheres rotated mutually.
The planet also experienced day and night.
Han Xing couldn’t help but ask, "Radiance, did you place that glowing sphere?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes, I placed it."
"Before I came, this world was in complete darkness, these creatures hadn’t even evolved to have sight."
"Later, I used my power to create this energy sphere and altered the planet’s rotation speed."
"It was then I discovered that after receiving energy from this light, all life on this planetary continent evolved at a terrifying speed."

In the next moment, a luminous nerve network also appeared above the head of the God of Radiance.
Although it’s much smaller compared to the nerve network of the God of Light.
But the God of Light is already dead, so this nerve network is in an ownerless state.
Soon, all the power of rules above was absorbed by the God of Radiance into his own rules.
His power of rules became more immense.
At this moment, the aura of the God of Radiance began to rise rapidly.
In just a few seconds, it surpassed the pressure brought by the Fearful Limb Demon God.
Soon, it even surpassed the God of Light!
As the thick power of rules quickly dimmed.
In Han Xing’s perception, the God of Radiance seemed to have reached another realm.
His aura reached a state of returning to simplicity.
When the power of rules above was completely devoured.
Then, before everyone, appeared a handsome man, richly dressed in white, wearing a white crown, as elegant as jade.
Cheng Jianyong was astonished, "Wow, Radiance, do you look like this?"
Opposite, the handsome man nodded with a slight chuckle.
Shen Yun also couldn’t believe it and said, "This can’t be your real appearance, right?
You look so handsome, I don’t believe it!"
The God of Radiance laughed and said, "My young friends, this was my appearance before I became a divine spirit, thousands of years ago."
However, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun still looked unconvinced.
The God of Radiance gently shook his head.
Han Xing checked his attributes.
[God of Radiance:]
[Level]: ???
[Attributes]: ???
[Skills]: ???
[Divine Power Value]: ???
It’s still a bunch of question marks.
Han Xing said, "Radiance."
The God of Radiance turned around and respectfully said, "Saint Master Han Xing, please speak."
Han Xing nodded, "Was the civilization within the beast nurtured by you?"
He still remembered that when he used his divine power to explore last time, he saw many life forms within.
The number of living beings there is at least akin to a large clan within the Holy Spirit Realm.
The God of Radiance shook his head and said, "I didn’t nurture it; when I found the beast’s corpse, I discovered signs of life already within, even a complete Sky Island Continent."
"However, those life forms were still in a primitive, blood-drinking state then."
"After I entered, I accelerated their civilizational evolution, which is why such a vast civilization was born."
Han Xing asked doubtfully, "A complete Sky Island Continent?
Does anyone know who placed it inside?"
The God of Radiance said, "I’m not really sure."
"I’ve been trying to find the traces of that one for many years, but it all ended in failure."
Han Xing, hearing this, didn’t inquire further and nodded, "Take us inside to see."
The God of Radiance did not refuse, "Of course, everyone, please follow me over."
With these words, a vast burst of divine power from the God of Radiance enveloped all five people completely.
He then charged directly into the mouth of the beast.
As for the [Divine Demon Battleship], it was left outside.
However, Han Xing and the others weren’t worried about encountering unexpected incidents within the beast’s body.
After all, the God of Radiance had sworn to the Supreme Rule to unconditionally obey Han Xing’s orders.
Such an oath was also acknowledged by the system.
This means that the God of Radiance couldn’t break his oath and turn against them.
Even if there’s an unforeseen situation, Han Xing and the others could use the [Oracle Throne] to escape.
At this moment, wrapped in the divine power of the God of Radiance, all five safely passed through the beast’s mouth.
The tearing-like power of rules was completely blocked outside.
Everyone looked around curiously and then ventured into the beast’s oral cavity.
Inside, it was dim, and a rotten smell faintly emanated.
After passing through the beast’s throat that stretched for tens of thousands of kilometers.
Han Xing and the others finally arrived inside the beast.
It was like an entirely new world.
Above, a pale yellow sky, which was the inside of the beast’s body.
In the distance, three planets rotated in a fixed trajectory.

And beside the green planet, a small asteroid orbited.
This combination looked like the relationship between the sun, moon, and earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 850 - 456: The World Inside the Beast’s Body (3)
paragraphs: "Other forms of Life that would need tens of thousands of years to complete their evolution can finish it here within just a few years."
"It didn’t take long before all kinds of strange and bizarre species appeared up above."

"However, after observing them for a while, I discovered that these species only possessed primitive survival instincts and hadn’t evolved any form of civilization, so I stopped paying attention to them."
After the God of Radiance finished speaking, everyone nodded in sudden realization.
Then, the five figures flickered and directly appeared on the surface of this colossal planet.
When they opened their eyes again, they were already standing in a Primitive Forest.
All sorts of bizarre plants grew here, and the dense canopy overhead blocked out the sunlight.
With curiosity in their eyes, everyone looked around.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng beside them exclaimed, "Brother Xing, I think I’m seeing some plants here that have already gone extinct on Earth."
Hearing this, Han Xing turned his head over in confusion.
Zhang Lianmeng pointed at a tree in the distance that was several hundred meters long and entirely gray, saying, "That one is called Marrow Wood. It already went extinct back in the Triassic period."
"And that one is called Scale Wood, it’s also been extinct for many years."
"And those ferns over there..."
The more Zhang Lianmeng spoke, the more surprised everyone felt.
Because the environment they were in now looked far too much like prehistoric Earth.
And just then, a rustling sound came from the jungle beside them.
Han Xing and the others had, of course, noticed it long ago.
However, they didn’t sense any threatening aura, so they didn’t care.
As the Grass was pushed aside, a beast’s head poked out from within.
Then, a dinosaur about 10 meters long, around 2 meters tall, its whole body covered in bulging muscle lines, appeared before everyone.
[Velociraptors: Tier Two ordinary Life]
[Level]: 23
[Attributes]: Power 470, agility 543, Spirit 432, Constitution 477
[Skills]: Rapid Assault, Tearing Bite!
[Talent]: Velociraptors Group (When the number of Velociraptors appearing at the same time reaches 10 or more, all Velociraptors’ Attack Power increases by 20%).
Everyone’s expressions shifted in surprise.
Good grief, it really is a Velociraptor!
Cheng Jianyong cried out, "Did we just travel back to prehistoric Earth?"
"Even Velociraptors have shown up—does that mean we’ll also see Tyrannosaurus, Thunder Dragon, Winged Dragon here?"
Everyone was filled with curiosity.
However, this Velociraptors was much larger than the ones they’d seen on television.
Just its length alone exceeded ten meters.
At this moment, after seeing everyone, this Velociraptors parted its jaws slightly, a light like that of seeing prey appearing in its eyes.
However, it also seemed to understand that the few before it were extremely terrifying existences.
For a moment, it stayed rooted in place, not daring to act rashly.
Han Xing and the others didn’t pay it much mind either.
For a Tier Two creature like this, just a hint of their aura would be enough to kill it so thoroughly it couldn’t be more dead.
So everyone simply watched this Velociraptors with a curious mindset.
At this time, the God of Radiance said, "The creatures here are still very savage. Their way of growing stronger is through eating and Devouring the Energy within other Life."
"At present, the strongest creature on this continent is a White Bear of Legendary Level."
"Oh? There’s a Legendary Level creature?" Han Xing said in surprise.
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes, but there’s only one."
"Aside from that White Bear, the other creatures at most only have Tier Four strength."
Han Xing nodded after hearing this.
They continued their exploration of this gigantic planet.
With their current speed, it would take them only a single minute to circle this planet once.
And if it were the God of Radiance, a single thought would be enough to bring them to any corner of this planet.
However, Han Xing didn’t let the God of Radiance make a move.
He kept searching for clues.
Or rather, he wanted to know who it was that had put this planet in here in the first place.

After wandering around for a while, the God of Radiance seemed to have seen through Han Xing’s intentions and couldn’t help saying, "Master, when I first entered the interior of the Beast, I searched this place just like you."
"But after all these years, I still haven’t found any information here left behind by that individual."
"That one’s methods are very secretive and very cautious."
After hearing this, Han Xing fell into thought.
The God of Radiance probed tentatively, "Master, how about I take you directly to meet the strongest creature on this planet?"
"Then let’s go take a look," Han Xing replied.
Joy flickered in the God of Radiance’s eyes.
The next moment, he waved his great hand, and Divine Power enveloped everyone.
The scene flashed, and they directly appeared on a snowfield.
The lowest temperature here could reach -60°C, so very few other creatures ever set foot here.
Han Xing and the others crossed the endless ice field, and at the foot of a ten-thousand-meter-high mountain shrouded in wind and snow, they saw a small mound roughly a thousand meters tall.
Right now, that mound was rising and falling continuously, looking as if it were sleeping.
Everyone knew that this mound was that Legendary creature.
After sensing the aura of the God of Radiance, the slumbering creature quickly awoke.
"Rumble!"
After a bout of trembling from the ground, that mound gradually stood up, taking the form of a White Bear.
It shook its body, scattering the snow on its fur.
Then it walked up to the God of Radiance and spoke in human tongue, "I greet the Divine Master."
The White Bear appeared very courteous, with even a faintly human-like expression on its face.
Han Xing and the others looked at this Great White Bear with odd expressions.
The God of Radiance explained, "I discovered this White Bear by accident."
